```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Inventory;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Connector;
using Game.Block.Blocks.OrbitalCargo;
using Game.Block.Blocks.RocketLaunchPad.Save;
using Game.Block.Blocks.RocketLaunchPad.Stage;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Game.Orbit;
using Game.SpaceElevator;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;
using static Game.Block.Interface.BlockException;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.RocketLaunchPad
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     - 進行へtick・合図・初発射を委譲
    ///     - 状態通知・セーブを担当
    ///     - 撤去時に積荷を返却
    ///     - Route ticks, commands and first-launch notifications to the sequence
    ///     - Publish and save state
    ///     - Refund cargo on removal
    /// </summary>
    public class RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent : IRocketLaunchPadComponent, IUpdatableBlockComponent, IBlockStateObservable, IBlockSaveState, IGetRefundItemsInfo
    {
        private RocketLaunchPadPhase Phase => _sequence.Stage.Phase;
        private RocketLaunchPadWaitReason WaitReason => _sequence.WaitReason;
        public float RequestPower => _sequence.RequestPower;
        public IObservable<Unit> OnChangeBlockState => _changeState;
        public string SaveKey { get; } = typeof(RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent).FullName;
        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }

        private readonly Subject<Unit> _changeState = new();
        private readonly RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout _layout;
        private readonly OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService _slots;
        private readonly RocketLaunchPadCargoLoader _cargoLoader;
        private readonly RocketLaunchPadOutputSlots _outputSlots;
        private readonly RocketLaunchPadLaunchSequence _sequence;
        private readonly CompositeDisposable _subscriptions;
        private readonly IOrbitalCargoSelectionReader _cargoSelection;
        private float _suppliedPower;

        public RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent(RocketLaunchPadBlockParam param, RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout layout, OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService slots, IBlockInventoryInserter beltOutput, IOrbitalArrivalService arrivalService, RocketLaunchHistory launchHistory, SpaceElevatorCablePool cablePool, IObservable<Unit> inventoryChanges, IOrbitalCargoSelectionReader cargoSelection, CompositeDisposable subscriptions)
        {
            _subscriptions = subscriptions;
            _cargoSelection = cargoSelection;
            _layout = layout;
            _slots = slots;
            _outputSlots = new RocketLaunchPadOutputSlots(layout, slots, beltOutput, cablePool, arrivalService);
            _cargoLoader = new RocketLaunchPadCargoLoader(layout, slots, _outputSlots, cargoSelection);
            _sequence = new RocketLaunchPadLaunchSequence(param, _cargoLoader, _outputSlots, launchHistory);

            // ワールドの初打ち上げで発射の合図待ちを解く。建造の合図待ちと打ち上げそのものは各台の次の Update が行う
            // On the world's first launch release the launch command wait; each pad's next update handles the build wait and the launch
            launchHistory.OnFirstLaunch.Subscribe(_ => OnWorldFirstLaunch()).AddTo(_subscriptions);
            // 在庫と上限の変化だけで待機条件を無効化する
            // Invalidate waiting conditions only when inventory or stack limits change
            inventoryChanges.Subscribe(_ => _sequence.InvalidateWait()).AddTo(_subscriptions);
            cablePool.OnAmountChanged.Subscribe(_ => _sequence.InvalidateWait()).AddTo(_subscriptions);
            ServerContext.GetService<IItemStackLevelLookup>().OnStackLevelUnlocked.Subscribe(_ => _sequence.InvalidateWait()).AddTo(_subscriptions);
            // 選び直しは待ち理由が同じでも状態の選択欄を変えるため、待機を解いてすぐ配信する
            // A reselection changes the published selection even with the same wait reason, so invalidate and publish at once
            cargoSelection.OnChanged.Subscribe(_ => { _sequence.InvalidateWait(); _changeState.OnNext(Unit.Default); }).AddTo(_subscriptions);

            #region Internal

            void OnWorldFirstLaunch()
            {
                var previousPhase = Phase;
                _sequence.ReleaseLaunchCommandWait();
                if (previousPhase != Phase) _changeState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
            }

            #endregion
        }

        public RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, RocketLaunchPadBlockParam param, RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout layout, OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService slots, IBlockInventoryInserter beltOutput, IOrbitalArrivalService arrivalService, RocketLaunchHistory launchHistory, SpaceElevatorCablePool cablePool, IObservable<Unit> inventoryChanges, IOrbitalCargoSelectionReader cargoSelection, CompositeDisposable subscriptions)
            : this(param, layout, slots, beltOutput, arrivalService, launchHistory, cablePool, inventoryChanges, cargoSelection, subscriptions)
        {
            // 実在品を保全してから段階を復元
            // Restore the stage only after verifying that all existing items can be retained
            var saveData = BlockComponentStateReader.Read<RocketLaunchPadSaveJsonObject>(componentStates, SaveKey);
            RocketLaunchPadSaveConverter.RestoreSlots(saveData, _layout, _slots);
            _sequence.SetStage(RocketLaunchPadStageRestorer.RestoreStage(saveData, _layout, _slots));

            // 初打ち上げ済みのワールドで発射の合図待ちのまま保存された台は、通知を受けた台と同じく打ち上げ待ちへ移す（履歴はブロックより先にロードされる）
            // Pads saved awaiting the launch command in an already-launched world move to ready-to-launch like notified pads (history loads before blocks)
            if (launchHistory.HasLaunchedOnce) _sequence.ReleaseLaunchCommandWait();
        }

        public void SupplyPower(float power)
        {
            // 複数の電力網から供給され得るため加算し、次のUpdateで使い切る
            // Accumulate since several networks may supply this pad, then consume it on the next update
            _suppliedPower += power;
        }

        public void Update()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            var previousPhase = Phase;
            var previousReason = WaitReason;
            var tickPower = _suppliedPower;
            _suppliedPower = 0f;

            // 出力口の中身を接続先へ流してから段階を進める（機械の出力と同じ順）
            // Push output contents onward before advancing the stage (same order as machine outputs)
            _outputSlots.PushToConnected();
            _sequence.Advance(tickPower);

            // 段階か待ち理由が変わったとき、進行中は毎tick状態を流す（機械の進捗と同じ）
            // Publish on a phase or reason change, and every tick while progressing (as machine progress does)
            var isProgressing = _sequence.Stage is IProgressingStage;
            if (previousPhase != Phase || previousReason != WaitReason || isProgressing) _changeState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
        }

        public RocketLaunchPadCommandResult RequestBuild()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            return PublishCommandResult(_sequence.RequestBuild());
        }

        public RocketLaunchPadCommandResult RequestLaunch()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            return PublishCommandResult(_sequence.RequestLaunch());
        }

        public BlockStateDetail[] GetBlockStateDetails()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            // 選択は次の便から、積んだ積荷は今の便の値（ADR 0106 4）
            // The selection applies from the next flight; the loaded payload is the current flight's (ADR 0106 4)
            var selected = _cargoSelection.Current.ToNullablePayloadItemId();
            var loaded = _sequence.Stage is LoadedRocketStage loadedStage ? loadedStage.Cargo.Payload.Id : (ItemId?)null;
            return new[] { RocketLaunchPadStateDetail.CreateState(Phase, WaitReason, _sequence.CalculateProgress(), selected, loaded) };
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> GetRefundItems()
        {
            // 積んだまま打ち上げていないロケットの中身を返す。出力口の成果は開けるスロットとして撤去処理が返す
            // Refund the contents of a not-yet-launched rocket; output slot contents are refunded by removal as openable slots
            return _sequence.Stage is LoadedRocketStage loaded ? loaded.Cargo.AllItems().ToList() : new List<IItemStack>();
        }

        public object GetSaveState()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            return RocketLaunchPadSaveConverter.Capture(_sequence.Stage, _layout, _slots);
        }

        public void Destroy()
        {
            IsDestroy = true;
            _subscriptions.Dispose();
        }

        private RocketLaunchPadCommandResult PublishCommandResult(RocketLaunchPadCommandResult result)
        {
            // 受け付けた合図は段階を変えるので状態を流し、拒否は理由を開発者向けに残す
            // Accepted commands change the stage so publish it; rejections leave their reason for developers
            if (result == RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.Accepted) _changeState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
            else Debug.LogWarning($"ロケット発射台への操作を拒否しました 理由:{result} 段階:{Phase} 待ち理由:{WaitReason}");
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        // 不適合な合図は呼出側が理由付きで通知する
        // The caller reports incompatible commands with their reasons
        internal override RocketLaunchPadCommandResult RequestBuild(RocketLaunchPadStageExecution execution)
        {
            return StartBuilding(execution) switch
            {
                RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.None => RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.Accepted,
                RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.OutputFull => RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.OutputFull,
                RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.MissingMaterials => RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.MissingMaterials,
                RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.MissingPayload => RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.MissingPayload,
                RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.CargoNotSelected => RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.CargoNotSelected,
                var other => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(other), other, "積載の判定が返さない待ち理由です"),
            };
        }
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Factory/BlockTemplate/Rocket/VanillaRocketLaunchPadTemplate.cs` 全文（ブループリント部品は A6 で足す）:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UniRx;
using Game.Block.Blocks;
using Game.Block.Blocks.ElectricWire;
using Game.Block.Blocks.OrbitalCargo;
using Game.Block.Blocks.RocketLaunchPad;
using Game.Block.Blocks.RocketLaunchPad.Save;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Service;
using Game.Block.Event;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Orbit;
using Game.SpaceElevator;
using Game.UnlockState;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;

namespace Game.Block.Factory.BlockTemplate.Rocket
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     - 資材・積荷・出力スロットを構成
    ///     - 積荷の選択と電力部品を構成
    ///     - Compose material, payload and output slots
    ///     - Compose the cargo selection and power components
    /// </summary>
    public class VanillaRocketLaunchPadTemplate : IBlockTemplate
    {
        private readonly BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent _blockInventoryEvent;

        public VanillaRocketLaunchPadTemplate(BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent blockInventoryEvent)
        {
            _blockInventoryEvent = blockInventoryEvent;
        }

        public IBlock New(BlockMasterElement blockMasterElement, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, BlockPositionInfo blockPositionInfo, BlockCreateParam[] createParams)
        {
            // ブループリントの選択は BlockFactory が生成直後に IBlockBlueprintSettings へ適用する
            // BlockFactory applies the blueprint selection to IBlockBlueprintSettings right after creation
            return Create(null, blockMasterElement, blockInstanceId, blockPositionInfo);
        }

        public IBlock Load(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, BlockMasterElement blockMasterElement, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, BlockPositionInfo blockPositionInfo)
        {
            return Create(componentStates, blockMasterElement, blockInstanceId, blockPositionInfo);
        }

        private IBlock Create(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, BlockMasterElement blockMasterElement, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, BlockPositionInfo blockPositionInfo)
        {
            var param = (RocketLaunchPadBlockParam)blockMasterElement.BlockParam;
            var layout = new RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout(param);
            // 選択の実体は選択部品だけへ渡し、在庫・進行部品には読む口として渡す
            // Hand the concrete selection only to the selector; inventory and processor receive it as the read port
            var cargoSelection = new OrbitalCargoSelectionState();

            // 全スロットを1つの保管に持ち、入れ口と出力口の制限はインベントリ側で掛ける
            // Keep every slot in one store and apply input/output restrictions in the inventory component
            var inventory = new RocketLaunchPadInventoryComponent(blockInstanceId, layout, _blockInventoryEvent, RocketLaunchPadCargoRecovery.SlotCount(componentStates, layout), cargoSelection);
            var subscriptions = new CompositeDisposable();
            var slots = inventory.ItemDataStoreService;
            var connector = BlockTemplateUtil.CreateInventoryConnector(param.InventoryConnectors, blockPositionInfo);
            var beltOutput = new ConnectingInventoryListPriorityInsertItemService(blockInstanceId, connector);
            var arrivalService = ServerContext.GetService<IOrbitalArrivalService>();
            var launchHistory = ServerContext.GetService<RocketLaunchHistory>();
            var cablePool = ServerContext.GetService<SpaceElevatorCablePool>();

            // 選択は段階の復元より先に読む（進行部品が選択の購読を始める前に値を確定する）
            // Read the selection before the stage restores, so the value is settled before the processor subscribes
            var inletSlots = new RocketLaunchPadCargoInletSlots(layout, slots);
            var unlockState = ServerContext.GetService<IGameUnlockStateDataController>();
            var selector = componentStates == null
                ? new OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent(cargoSelection, inletSlots, unlockState)
                : new OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent(componentStates, cargoSelection, inletSlots, unlockState);
            var processor = componentStates == null
                ? new RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent(param, layout, slots, beltOutput, arrivalService, launchHistory, cablePool, inventory.OnInventoryChanged, cargoSelection, subscriptions)
                : new RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent(componentStates, param, layout, slots, beltOutput, arrivalService, launchHistory, cablePool, inventory.OnInventoryChanged, cargoSelection, subscriptions);
            var electric = new RocketLaunchPadElectricComponent(blockInstanceId, processor);
            var wireConnector = new ElectricWireConnectorComponent(param.MaxWireConnectionCount, blockInstanceId, electric, componentStates);

            var components = new List<IBlockComponent>
            {
                connector,
                inventory,
                selector,
                electric,
                wireConnector,
                processor,
            };
            return new BlockSystem(blockInstanceId, blockMasterElement.BlockGuid, components, blockPositionInfo);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task A3: 宇宙エレベーター拠点を選ぶ方式にする（入口の分離・受け入れ・塞がり・状態）

ADR 0106 の 7（未選択は何も受け取らない・昇降中の便はそのまま・返しきれない分は入口に残り塞がる・項目なしは未選択）。
今の入口の塞がり表示（`SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.InletBlocked`）は「今のマスタで運ばない品」（`SatelliteInletState.NotCarried`）にしか出ない。選び直しで残る前の種類は「運ぶ品」なので、そのままでは1便ぶんあれば昇ってしまう。入口の状態に `NotSelectedKind` を足し、同じ `InletBlocked` を出す（クライアントの表示 `SpaceElevatorStatusInletBlocked`＝`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/Special/SpaceElevatorLogic.cs:34` を流用）。ロード時の戻し先（入口・出口・消す）は運べる全種類で決めたままにし、選択では絞らない（昇降中の便をロードで取り消さないため）。

`SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.cs` は 194 行あり、ここに足すと 200 行を超えるので、入口（スロット0）の受け入れ・中身の判定・返却を `SpaceElevatorBaseInlet` へ移す。`SpaceElevatorClimberComponent.cs` は 198 行（下の全文を数えた値）。

```csharp
        }

        // 積荷を選んだ拠点を置く。選ばない拠点が要るテストは PlaceUnselectedBase を使う

            OrbitalCargoTestUtil.SelectCargo(block, selectedCargo);
            return block;
```

```csharp
using System.Linq;

using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.SpaceElevator;

using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Game.Context;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util.OrbitalCargo;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Game.SpaceElevator.SpaceElevatorTestUtil;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Game.SpaceElevator.SpaceElevatorConnectionTest;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Game.OrbitalCargo
{
    // 宇宙エレベーター拠点の積荷の選択（ADR 0106 7）
    // Space elevator base cargo selection (ADR 0106 7)
    public class OrbitalCargoBaseSelectionTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 未選択の拠点は何も受け取らず接続の前後とも選択待ちを出す()
        {
            CreateServer();
            var elevatorBase = PlaceUnselectedBase(Vector3Int.zero);
            var inventory = Inventory(elevatorBase);
            var satellite = ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, 1);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.InsertItem(satellite).Count);
            Assert.IsFalse(inventory.InsertionCheck(new List<IItemStack> { satellite }));
            Assert.IsFalse(inventory.IsAllowedToPlace(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot, satellite));

            // 接続できるケーブルがあっても、選ぶまでは選択待ちが最優先（ADR 0106 7）
            // Even with enough cable, waiting for a selection comes first until selected (ADR 0106 7)
            LaunchCables(100);
            AssertUnselected();
            // 旧セーブ由来の「接続済み・未選択」も同じ表示になる
            // A connected-but-unselected base from an old save shows the same
            elevatorBase.GetComponent<ISpaceElevatorBase>().MarkConnected();
            AssertUnselected();

            #region Internal

            void AssertUnselected()
            {
                var detail = ReadDetail(elevatorBase);
                Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.CargoNotSelected, detail.Status);
                Assert.IsNull(detail.SelectedCargoItemId);
                Assert.IsNull(detail.ClimbingCargoItemId);
            }

            #endregion
        }

        [Test]
        public void 選んだ積荷だけを受け取り昇らせる()
        {
            var elevatorBase = SetupConnected(100f, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite);
            var inventory = Inventory(elevatorBase);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, inventory.InsertItem(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload, 3).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.InsertItem(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, 1).Count);

            // 昇っている間は今の便の積荷を状態に載せる
            // While climbing, the state carries the current flight's payload
            RunSeconds(0.5);
            var detail = ReadDetail(elevatorBase);
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.Climbing, detail.Status);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, detail.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, detail.ClimbingCargoItemId);
            RunSeconds(2);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorReward, inventory.GetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.FirstOutputSlot).Id);
        }

        [TestCase(true)]
        [TestCase(false)]
        public void 選び直すと前の種類を返し返せない分は入口を塞ぐ(bool refundHasSpace)
        {
            var elevatorBase = SetupConnected(100f, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload);
            var inventory = Inventory(elevatorBase);
            // 1便（3個）に満たない2個を置き、昇らない状態で選び直す
            // Leave two (under one launch of three) so nothing climbs, then reselect
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.InsertItem(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload, 2).Count);
            var refund = new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService((_, _) => { }, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, 1);
            if (!refundHasSpace) refund.SetItem(0, ForUnitTestItemId.ItemId1, 1);
            Assert.AreEqual(OrbitalCargoSelectionResult.Success, elevatorBase.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>().SelectCargo(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, refund));

            if (refundHasSpace)
            {
                // 返せたら入口は空き、新しい種類を待つ
                // When refunded, the inlet is empty and waits for the new kind
                Assert.AreEqual(2, refund.InventoryItems.Where(item => item.Id == ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload).Sum(item => item.Count));
                Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.WaitingSatellite, ReadDetail(elevatorBase).Status);
                return;
            }

            // 返せない分は入口に残り、取り出すまで塞がる（ADR 0106 7）
            // Leftovers stay in the inlet and block it until taken out (ADR 0106 7)
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex("選んだ積荷ではないため昇れません"));
            GameUpdater.RunFrames(1);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, inventory.GetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.InletBlocked, ReadDetail(elevatorBase).Status);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.InsertItem(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, 1).Count);

            // 取り出せば新しい種類が入り、昇る
            // Once taken out, the new kind goes in and climbs
            inventory.SetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.InsertItem(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, 1).Count);
            RunSeconds(0.5);
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.Climbing, ReadDetail(elevatorBase).Status);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 昇降中に選び直しても今の便は元の積荷のまま届く()
        {
            var elevatorBase = SetupConnected(100f, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite);
            var inventory = Inventory(elevatorBase);
            inventory.InsertItem(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, 1);
            RunSeconds(0.5);
            OrbitalCargoTestUtil.SelectCargo(elevatorBase, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload);

            // 選択だけが変わり、昇っている便は衛星のまま（ADR 0106 4・7）
            // Only the selection changes; the climbing flight stays the satellite (ADR 0106 4, 7)
            var detail = ReadDetail(elevatorBase);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload, detail.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, detail.ClimbingCargoItemId);
            RunSeconds(2);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorReward, inventory.GetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.FirstOutputSlot).Id);
            Assert.IsNull(ReadDetail(elevatorBase).ClimbingCargoItemId);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Interface.State
{
    // 拠点の今の状態。待ちの理由もここで表す。未接続は接続できるか（プールが判定）で2つに分かれ、積荷の未選択はそれより先に出る
    // The base's current state, including why it is waiting; unconnected splits by connectability (judged by the pool), and an unselected cargo comes before both
    public enum SpaceElevatorBaseStatus
    {
        ReadyToConnect,
        InsufficientCable,
        WaitingSatellite,
        Climbing,
        LowPower,
        OutputBlocked,
        InletBlocked,
        CargoNotSelected,
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using MessagePack;

namespace Game.Block.Interface.State
{
    [Serializable]
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail
    {
        public const string BlockStateDetailKey = "SpaceElevatorBase";

        [Key(0)] public bool IsConnected { get; private set; }
        [Key(1)] public int CablePoolAmount { get; private set; }
        // 昇降の進み（0〜1）。昇っていなければ0
        // Climb progress from 0 to 1; zero while not climbing
        [Key(2)] public float ClimbProgress { get; private set; }
        [Key(3)] public SpaceElevatorBaseStatus Status { get; private set; }
        // 次の便から運ぶ積荷。未選択なら null
        // The cargo carried from the next flight; null while unselected
        [Key(4)] public ItemId? SelectedCargoItemId { get; private set; }
        // 昇降中（頂上で出口待ちを含む）の便の積荷。昇っていなければ null。選び直した後は SelectedCargoItemId と違う値になる
        // The payload of the flight being carried (including waiting at the top); null otherwise, and it differs from SelectedCargoItemId after a reselection
        [Key(5)] public ItemId? ClimbingCargoItemId { get; private set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail()
        {
        }

        public SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail(bool isConnected, int cablePoolAmount, float climbProgress, SpaceElevatorBaseStatus status, ItemId? selectedCargoItemId, ItemId? climbingCargoItemId)
        {
            IsConnected = isConnected;
            CablePoolAmount = cablePoolAmount;
            ClimbProgress = climbProgress;
            Status = status;
            SelectedCargoItemId = selectedCargoItemId;
            ClimbingCargoItemId = climbingCargoItemId;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.SpaceElevator
{
    // 入口の中身
    // - MissingPayload は空か1便未満
    // - 運べない品はマスタ変更後のロードでのみ残る
    // - 選んでいない種類は返しきれなかった選び直しで残る
    // What the inlet holds
    // - MissingPayload means empty or under one launch
    // - A non-carried item remains only after a master change on load
    // - A non-selected kind remains after an incomplete reselection refund
    internal enum SatelliteInletState
    {
        MissingPayload,
        Carriable,
        NotCarried,
        NotSelectedKind,
    }
    internal enum SatelliteTakeResult
    {
        Taken,
        MissingPayload,
        NotCarried,
        NotSelectedKind,
        OutputBlocked,
    }

    // 入口の中身を昇らない理由へ写し、塞がりの理由を開発者ログへ出す
    // Maps inlet contents to wait results and logs why the inlet is blocked
    internal static class SatelliteInletWait
    {
        public static bool BlocksInlet(SatelliteInletState state) => state is SatelliteInletState.NotCarried or SatelliteInletState.NotSelectedKind;
        public static bool BlocksInlet(SatelliteTakeResult result) => result is SatelliteTakeResult.NotCarried or SatelliteTakeResult.NotSelectedKind;

        public static SatelliteTakeResult ToWaitResult(SatelliteInletState state)
        {
            return state switch
            {
                SatelliteInletState.MissingPayload => SatelliteTakeResult.MissingPayload,
                // 未接続の拠点では運べる積荷も昇らないため、積荷待ちと同じ扱いにする
                // On an unconnected base even a carriable payload does not climb, so treat it as waiting
                SatelliteInletState.Carriable => SatelliteTakeResult.MissingPayload,
                SatelliteInletState.NotCarried => SatelliteTakeResult.NotCarried,
                SatelliteInletState.NotSelectedKind => SatelliteTakeResult.NotSelectedKind,
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(state), state, "昇らない理由へ写していない入口の状態です"),
            };
        }

        public static void LogBlocked(SatelliteTakeResult result, ItemId satelliteId)
        {
            if (result == SatelliteTakeResult.NotCarried) Debug.LogWarning($"[SpaceElevatorBase] 入口の {satelliteId} は今のマスタで運ぶ積荷ではないため昇れません。入口から取り出してください");
            else Debug.LogWarning($"[SpaceElevatorBase] 入口の {satelliteId} は選んだ積荷ではないため昇れません。入口から取り出してください");
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorBaseInlet.cs`（新規・101 行）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.OrbitalCargo;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using UniRx;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.SpaceElevator
{
    // 拠点の入口（スロット0）
    // - 選んだ積荷だけを受け入れる
    // - 選んだ種類以外が残ると入口が塞がる
    // - 選び直しで外れた中身を返却先へ移す
    // The base inlet (slot 0)
    // - Accepts only the selected payload
    // - Blocks while a kind other than the selected one remains
    // - Moves contents dropped by a reselection to the refund target
    internal class SpaceElevatorBaseInlet : IOrbitalCargoInletSlots
    {
        private const int Slot = SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot;
        public IReadOnlyCollection<ItemId> CarriedPayloadItemIds => _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload.Keys;
        // 在庫か選択が変わると入口の待機条件が変わる
        // Inlet waiting conditions change with the inventory or the selection
        public IObservable<Unit> OnConditionChanged => _inventoryChanged.Merge(_selection.OnChanged);

        private readonly OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService _slots;
        private readonly Dictionary<ItemId, int> _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload;
        private readonly IOrbitalCargoSelectionReader _selection;
        private readonly IObservable<Unit> _inventoryChanged;

        public SpaceElevatorBaseInlet(OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService slots, Dictionary<ItemId, int> countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload, IOrbitalCargoSelectionReader selection, IObservable<Unit> inventoryChanged)
        {
            _slots = slots;
            _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload = countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload;
            _selection = selection;
            _inventoryChanged = inventoryChanged;
        }

        public bool Accepts(ItemId itemId) => _selection.Current.IsSelected(itemId);

        // 入口の中身を見る。運べない品はマスタ変更後のロードで、選んでいない種類は返しきれなかった選び直しで残る
        // Peek at the inlet; a non-carried item remains after a master change, a non-selected kind after an incomplete reselection refund
        public SatelliteInletState Peek(out ItemId satelliteId)
        {
            var stack = _slots.GetItem(Slot);
            satelliteId = stack.Id;
            if (stack.Count == 0) return SatelliteInletState.MissingPayload;
            if (!_countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload.TryGetValue(stack.Id, out var countPerLaunch)) return SatelliteInletState.NotCarried;
            if (!Accepts(stack.Id)) return SatelliteInletState.NotSelectedKind;
            // silent-ok: 1便に満たない積荷は通常の待機 / プレイヤーは拠点UIの積荷待ちと入口の個数で気づく
            return stack.Count < countPerLaunch ? SatelliteInletState.MissingPayload : SatelliteInletState.Carriable;
        }

        // 昇っていないときの状態。未選択・入口の塞がり・積荷待ちの順に決める
        // The status while not climbing, decided as unselected, blocked inlet, then waiting for payload
        public SpaceElevatorBaseStatus WaitStatus()
        {
            if (_selection.Current is UnselectedOrbitalCargo) return SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.CargoNotSelected;
            return SatelliteInletWait.BlocksInlet(Peek(out _)) ? SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.InletBlocked : SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.WaitingSatellite;
        }

        public ItemId? SelectedCargoItemId() => _selection.Current.ToNullablePayloadItemId();

        public IItemStack Insert(IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            // silent-ok: 選んだ積荷以外はベルト上・手元に残す通常の受け入れ拒否 / プレイヤーは拠点UIの選択と入口で気づく
            if (!Accepts(itemStack.Id)) return itemStack;
            var result = _slots.GetItem(Slot).AddItem(itemStack);
            _slots.SetItem(Slot, result.ProcessResultItemStack);
            return result.RemainderItemStack;
        }

        public bool InsertionCheck(List<IItemStack> itemStacks)
        {
            var slot = _slots.GetItem(Slot);
            foreach (var itemStack in itemStacks)
            {
                // silent-ok: 搬送の事前確認は在庫を変えない / 呼び出し側が返値で詰まりを認識する
                if (!Accepts(itemStack.Id)) return false;
                var result = slot.AddItem(itemStack);
                // silent-ok: 満杯の通常拒否 / 呼び出し側と入口UIに残数が届く
                if (0 < result.RemainderItemStack.Count) return false;
                slot = result.ProcessResultItemStack;
            }
            return true;
        }

        public void RefundUnselectedPayloads(SelectedOrbitalCargo selection, IOpenableInventory refundInventory)
        {
            var stack = _slots.GetItem(Slot);
            // silent-ok: 空か選んだ種類なら返すものは無い / 返却なしが正しい結果
            if (stack.Count == 0 || selection.IsSelected(stack.Id)) return;
            // 入らない分は入口に残り、取り出すまで塞がりとして表示される（ADR 0106 7）
            // What does not fit stays in the inlet and shows as blocked until taken out (ADR 0106 7)
            _slots.SetItem(Slot, refundInventory.InsertItem(stack));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.Orbit;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using Core.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Connector;
using Game.Block.Blocks.OrbitalCargo;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Service;
using Game.Block.Interface.Event;
using UniRx;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using System;
using Game.Block.Event;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using static Game.Block.Interface.BlockException;
namespace Game.Block.Blocks.SpaceElevator
{
    // 拠点のスロット。0は運ぶ衛星の入口、1以降は成果の出口。出口だけを隣のベルトへ押し出す
    // The base's slots: slot 0 takes satellites to carry, the rest hold results; only the outlets are pushed to adjacent belts
    public class SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent : IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent, IBlockSaveState, IUpdatableBlockComponent, ISortExcludedSlots
    {
        public const int SatelliteSlot = 0;
        public const int FirstOutputSlot = 1;
        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> InventoryItems => _itemDataStoreService.InventoryItems;
        public BlockInstanceId BlockInstanceId { get; }
        public IReadOnlyCollection<int> SortExcludedSlots => Enumerable.Range(0, _slotCount).ToArray();
        public string SaveKey { get; } = typeof(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent).FullName;
        // 入口の在庫か選択が変わったときの通知。昇降機は入口を直接触らず、在庫のこの口と下の読み取りを通す
        // Fires when the inlet inventory or the selection changes; the climber never touches the inlet directly and goes through this and the reads below
        internal IObservable<Unit> OnInletConditionChanged => Inlet.OnConditionChanged;
        // 入口の受け入れ・塞がり・選び直しの返却は入口が持つ。外から触るのはテンプレート（選択部品へ渡す）だけ
        // The inlet owns acceptance, blocking and reselection refunds; only the template touches it (to hand it to the selector)
        internal SpaceElevatorBaseInlet Inlet { get; }
        private readonly Subject<Unit> _inventoryChanged = new();
        private readonly IOrbitalArrivalService _arrivalService;
        private readonly int[] _outputSlots;
        private readonly int _slotCount;
        private readonly IBlockInventoryInserter _blockInventoryInserter;
        private readonly OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService _itemDataStoreService;
        // 積荷と1便の個数（マスタ積荷表）
        // Payloads and per-launch counts from the master table
        private readonly Dictionary<ItemId, int> _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload;
        public SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent(BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam param, IBlockInventoryInserter blockInventoryInserter, IOrbitalArrivalService arrivalService, IOrbitalCargoSelectionReader cargoSelection)
        {
            BlockInstanceId = blockInstanceId;
            _blockInventoryInserter = blockInventoryInserter;
            _arrivalService = arrivalService;
            _slotCount = FirstOutputSlot + param.OutputSlotCount;
            _outputSlots = Enumerable.Range(FirstOutputSlot, param.OutputSlotCount).ToArray();
            _itemDataStoreService = new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService(InvokeEvent, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, _slotCount);
            _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload = param.CarriedPayloadItemGuids.ToDictionary(
                guid => MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(guid),
                guid => MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.OrbitalPayloads.Single(payload => payload.PayloadItemGuid == guid).CountPerLaunch);
            Inlet = new SpaceElevatorBaseInlet(_itemDataStoreService, _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload, cargoSelection, _inventoryChanged);
            #region Internal
            void InvokeEvent(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
            {
                _inventoryChanged.OnNext(Unit.Default);
                var blockInventoryUpdate = (BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent)ServerContext.BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent;
                blockInventoryUpdate.OnInventoryUpdateInvoke(new BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEventProperties(BlockInstanceId, slot, itemStack));
            }
            #endregion
        }
        public SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam param, IBlockInventoryInserter blockInventoryInserter, IOrbitalArrivalService arrivalService, IOrbitalCargoSelectionReader cargoSelection) :
            this(blockInstanceId, param, blockInventoryInserter, arrivalService, cargoSelection)
        {
            // ロード時はまだワールドに登録されていないのでイベントを出さない。戻し先は運べる全種類で決め、選択では絞らない
            // Loading fires no events before world registration; restoration uses every carried kind, not the selection
            var itemJsons = BlockComponentStateReader.Read<List<ItemStackSaveJsonObject>>(componentStates, SaveKey);
            SpaceElevatorInventoryRestorer.Restore(itemJsons, _itemDataStoreService, _slotCount, blockInstanceId);
        }
        // 入口の受入定義を配信側と共有する
        // Share the inlet acceptance definition with the publisher
        public static IReadOnlyList<ItemId> GetCarriedPayloadItemIds(SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam param) => param.CarriedPayloadItemGuids.Select(guid => MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(guid)).ToList();
        // 昇降機からの入口の読み取りは、ここを通して壊れた後の読み取りを止める（今のコードの PeekSatellite と同じ流儀）
        // The climber reads the inlet only through these, so reads after destruction are stopped (same style as the existing PeekSatellite)
        internal SatelliteInletState PeekSatellite(out ItemId satelliteId) { CheckDestroy(this); return Inlet.Peek(out satelliteId); }
        internal SpaceElevatorBaseStatus InletWaitStatus() { CheckDestroy(this); return Inlet.WaitStatus(); }
        internal ItemId? SelectedCargoItemId() { CheckDestroy(this); return Inlet.SelectedCargoItemId(); }
        // ロード時に昇降中の積荷を1便ぶんへ正規化し、昇らせない分は入口・出口へ戻す（入らなければ消す）
        // Normalize a climbing payload to one launch on load, returning the rest to the inlet or outlets (discarding what does not fit)
        internal IItemStack TakeLaunchableClimbingPayloadOnLoad(IItemStack savedPayload) { return SpaceElevatorInventoryRestorer.TakeLaunchableClimbingPayloadOnLoad(savedPayload, _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload, _itemDataStoreService, _outputSlots, BlockInstanceId); }
        // 収納確認から取り出しまでを在庫の所有者が完結する
        // The inventory owner checks capacity and takes the satellite together
        internal SatelliteTakeResult TryTakeSatelliteForClimb(out IItemStack satellite, out ItemId satelliteId)
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            satellite = ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty();
            var inlet = Inlet.Peek(out satelliteId);
            // silent-ok: 通常の入口待機 / 呼出側が理由を状態詳細と初回ログへ反映する
            if (inlet != SatelliteInletState.Carriable) return SatelliteInletWait.ToWaitResult(inlet);
            var countPerLaunch = _countPerLaunchByCarriedPayload[satelliteId];
            // silent-ok: 成果の収納待機 / 呼出側が出口待ちをUIへ配信する
            if (!InventoryInsertItem.TryFillAllPreferringExisting(_arrivalService.PreviewArrivalOutputs(satelliteId, countPerLaunch), CopyOutlets())) return SatelliteTakeResult.OutputBlocked;
            var stack = _itemDataStoreService.GetItem(SatelliteSlot);
            _itemDataStoreService.SetItem(SatelliteSlot, stack.SubItem(countPerLaunch));
            satellite = ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(stack.Id, countPerLaunch);
            return SatelliteTakeResult.Taken;
        }
        // 一度だけ模擬し、到着成功後に同じ配置を確定する
        // Simulate once and commit that placement after arrival succeeds
        internal bool TryCompleteArrival(IItemStack climbingPayload)
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            var outputs = _arrivalService.PreviewArrivalOutputs(climbingPayload.Id, climbingPayload.Count);
            var simulated = CopyOutlets();
            // silent-ok: 容量不足では到着させない / 昇降機が出口待ちをUIと初回ログへ反映する
            if (!InventoryInsertItem.TryFillAllPreferringExisting(outputs, simulated)) return false;
            _arrivalService.Arrive(climbingPayload.Id, climbingPayload.Count);
            for (var i = 0; i < simulated.Count; i++)
            {
                var current = _itemDataStoreService.GetItem(FirstOutputSlot + i);
                // silent-ok: 不変スロットの通知を抑える / 同じ在庫値は既にUIへ通知済み
                if (simulated[i].Id == current.Id && simulated[i].Count == current.Count) continue;
                _itemDataStoreService.SetItem(FirstOutputSlot + i, simulated[i]);
            }
            return true;
        }
        public void Update()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            BlockOutputTransfer.Transfer(_itemDataStoreService, _outputSlots, _blockInventoryInserter);
        }
        // ベルト・プレイヤーからは選んだ積荷だけを入口へ受ける（ADR 0106 7）
        // Belts and players may only put the selected payload into the inlet (ADR 0106 7)
        public IItemStack InsertItem(IItemStack itemStack) { CheckDestroy(this); return Inlet.Insert(itemStack); }
        public bool InsertionCheck(List<IItemStack> itemStacks) { CheckDestroy(this); return Inlet.InsertionCheck(itemStacks); }
        // 入口は選んだ積荷だけ、出口は取り出し（空にする）だけを許す
        // The inlet accepts only the selected payload and the outlets only taking out (emptying)
        public bool IsAllowedToPlace(int slot, IItemStack itemStack) => itemStack.Count == 0 || slot == SatelliteSlot && Inlet.Accepts(itemStack.Id);
        public object GetSaveState()
        {
            CheckDestroy(this);
            var itemJson = new List<ItemStackSaveJsonObject>();
            foreach (var item in _itemDataStoreService.InventoryItems) itemJson.Add(new ItemStackSaveJsonObject(item));
            return itemJson;
        }
        private List<IItemStack> CopyOutlets()
        {
            var outlets = new List<IItemStack>();
            for (var slot = FirstOutputSlot; slot < _slotCount; slot++) outlets.Add(_itemDataStoreService.GetItem(slot));
            return outlets;
        }
        public IItemStack InsertItem(IItemStack itemStack, InsertItemContext context) { return InsertItem(itemStack); }
        public IItemStack InsertItem(ItemId itemId, int count) { return InsertItem(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, count)); }
        public List<IItemStack> InsertItem(List<IItemStack> itemStacks)
        {
            var remainders = new List<IItemStack>();
            foreach (var itemStack in itemStacks)
            {
                var remainder = InsertItem(itemStack);
                if (0 < remainder.Count) remainders.Add(remainder);
            }
            return remainders;
        }
        public void SetItem(int slot, IItemStack itemStack) { CheckDestroy(this); _itemDataStoreService.SetItem(slot, itemStack); }
        public void SetItem(int slot, ItemId itemId, int count) { CheckDestroy(this); _itemDataStoreService.SetItem(slot, itemId, count); }
        public IItemStack GetItem(int slot) { CheckDestroy(this); return _itemDataStoreService.GetItem(slot); }
        public int GetSlotSize() { CheckDestroy(this); return _itemDataStoreService.GetSlotSize(); }
        public ReadOnlyCollection<IItemStack> CreateCopiedItems() { CheckDestroy(this); return _itemDataStoreService.CreateCopiedItems(); }
        public IItemStack ReplaceItem(int slot, IItemStack itemStack) { CheckDestroy(this); return _itemDataStoreService.ReplaceItem(slot, itemStack); }
        public IItemStack ReplaceItem(int slot, ItemId itemId, int count) { CheckDestroy(this); return _itemDataStoreService.ReplaceItem(slot, itemId, count); }
        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }
        public void Destroy() { IsDestroy = true; _inventoryChanged.Dispose(); }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorClimberComponent.cs` 全文（198 行。購読先を在庫の `OnInletConditionChanged` へ、`_inletNotCarried` を `_inletBlocked` へ、未選択の状態と積荷2欄を追加。`ResolveStatus` は入口の状態を在庫の `InletWaitStatus()` で1回だけ読む。入口は在庫のメソッド（`PeekSatellite`・`InletWaitStatus`・`SelectedCargoItemId`）を通して読み、どれも在庫側の `CheckDestroy` を踏む。空行を3つ詰めて 200 行未満に収めた）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Util;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Game.Context;
using MessagePack;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.SpaceElevator
{
    // 拠点の昇降機
    // - 選んだ積荷を1便ずつ電力で昇らせる
    // - 頂上で到着サービスへ渡す
    // - 成果が入らなければ待つ
    // The base's climber
    // - Lifts one launch of the selected payload at a time with power
    // - Hands it to the arrival service at the top
    // - Waits while the result would not fit
    public class SpaceElevatorClimberComponent : ISpaceElevatorBase, IUpdatableBlockComponent, IBlockStateObservable, IBlockSaveState, IGetRefundItemsInfo
    {
        public bool IsConnected { get; private set; }
        public IObservable<Unit> OnChangeBlockState => _onChangeBlockState;
        public string SaveKey => "spaceElevatorClimber";
        // 昇っている間だけ電力を要求する。頂上で出口の空きを待つ間は使わない
        // Request power only while ascending; waiting at the top for outlet space uses none
        public float RequestPower => IsAscending ? _param.RequiredPower : 0f;
        private bool IsCarrying => _climbingSatellite.Id != ItemMaster.EmptyItemId;
        private bool IsAscending => IsCarrying && 0 < _remainingClimbTicks;
        private readonly Subject<Unit> _onChangeBlockState = new();
        private readonly SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam _param;
        private readonly SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent _inventory;
        private readonly uint _climbTotalTicks;
        private readonly IDisposable _inventorySubscription;
        private readonly IDisposable _stackLevelSubscription;
        private bool _inventoryChanged = true;
        private IItemStack _climbingSatellite;
        private uint _remainingClimbTicks;
        private bool _outputBlocked;
        private bool _inletBlocked;
        private int _cablePoolAmount;
        private bool _hasEnoughCable;
        private float _suppliedPower;
        private float _latchedPower;
        public SpaceElevatorClimberComponent(SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam param, SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent inventory)
        {
            _param = param;
            _inventory = inventory;
            _climbTotalTicks = GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(param.ClimbSeconds);
            _climbingSatellite = ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty();
            // 入口の在庫か積荷の選択が変わったら待機条件を再評価する
            // Reevaluate waiting conditions when the inlet inventory or the cargo selection changes
            _inventorySubscription = inventory.OnInletConditionChanged.Subscribe(_ => _inventoryChanged = true);
            _stackLevelSubscription = ServerContext.GetService<IItemStackLevelLookup>().OnStackLevelUnlocked
                .Subscribe(_ => _inventoryChanged = true);
        }
        public SpaceElevatorClimberComponent(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam param, SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent inventory) : this(param, inventory)
        {
            var save = BlockComponentStateReader.Read<SpaceElevatorClimberSaveJsonObject>(componentStates, SaveKey);
            IsConnected = save.IsConnected;
            (_climbingSatellite, _remainingClimbTicks) = SpaceElevatorClimberSaveRestorer.Restore(save, inventory, _climbTotalTicks);
        }

        public void Update()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            // tick内の供給を確定してから進める
            // Latch this tick's supply before advancing
            _latchedPower = _suppliedPower;
            _suppliedPower = 0f;
            var wasOutputBlocked = _outputBlocked;
            var shouldEvaluate = IsAscending || _inventoryChanged;
            var inventoryChanged = _inventoryChanged;
            _inventoryChanged = false;
            var changed = shouldEvaluate && (IsCarrying ? AdvanceClimb() : TryStartClimb());
            // 在庫・選択の通知は初回tick前の変更も含むため、キャッシュ差分に依存せず配信する
            // Inventory and selection events include changes before the first tick, so publish without relying on a cached difference
            changed |= wasOutputBlocked != _outputBlocked || inventoryChanged;
            // 出口待ちに入ったtickに1回だけ理由をログへ出す（以降はUIの状態表示で伝える）
            // Log the reason once on the tick the outlet wait begins; the UI status carries it afterwards
            if (!wasOutputBlocked && _outputBlocked) Debug.Log("[SpaceElevatorBase] 1便の成果が出口に入りきらないため、出口が空くまで待ちます");
            // 昇っている間は進みが毎tick動くので毎tick通知する（同一ペイロードはイベント側が送らない）
            // While ascending the progress moves every tick, so notify every tick (the event packet drops identical payloads)
            if (changed || IsAscending) _onChangeBlockState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
            #region Internal
            bool AdvanceClimb()
            {
                // 電力不足なら供給率に比例して遅くなる
                // A power shortage slows the climb in proportion to the supply rate
                if (0 < _remainingClimbTicks)
                {
                    var subTicks = MachineCurrentPowerToSubSecond.GetSubTicks(_latchedPower, _param.RequiredPower);
                    _remainingClimbTicks = _remainingClimbTicks <= subTicks ? 0 : _remainingClimbTicks - subTicks;
                }
                if (0 < _remainingClimbTicks) return false;
                // 頂上では成果が出口へ入りきるときだけ渡す。入らなければ頂上で待つ
                // At the top, hand over only when the result fits the outlets; otherwise wait at the top
                _inventoryChanged = true;
                _outputBlocked = !_inventory.TryCompleteArrival(_climbingSatellite);
                // 容量不足は実通知まで待つ。例外時の再試行予約は到着呼出し前に残す
                // Wait for a real event when full; reserve retries before arrival so exceptions retain them
                _inventoryChanged = !_outputBlocked;
                // silent-ok: 出口待ちは初回ログと状態詳細で通知 / プレイヤーは拠点UIで気づく
                if (_outputBlocked) return false;
                _climbingSatellite = ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty();
                return true;
            }
            bool TryStartClimb()
            {
                // silent-ok: 未選択・未接続・衛星なしは通常の待機 / プレイヤーが拠点UIの状態表示（CargoNotSelected・ReadyToConnect・WaitingSatellite 等）で気づく
                _outputBlocked = false;
                var wasInletBlocked = _inletBlocked;
                IItemStack satellite = null;
                ItemId satelliteId;
                var result = IsConnected
                    ? _inventory.TryTakeSatelliteForClimb(out satellite, out satelliteId)
                    : SatelliteInletWait.ToWaitResult(_inventory.PeekSatellite(out satelliteId));
                _inletBlocked = SatelliteInletWait.BlocksInlet(result);
                // 入口が塞がった tick に1回だけ理由を開発者ログへ出す
                // Log the reason once on the tick the inlet becomes blocked
                if (_inletBlocked && !wasInletBlocked) SatelliteInletWait.LogBlocked(result, satelliteId);
                _outputBlocked = result == SatelliteTakeResult.OutputBlocked;
                // silent-ok: 在庫が返す待機理由は状態詳細へ反映 / プレイヤーは拠点UIで気づく
                if (result != SatelliteTakeResult.Taken) return false;
                _climbingSatellite = satellite;
                _remainingClimbTicks = _climbTotalTicks;
                return true;
            }
            #endregion
        }
        internal void SupplyPower(float power)
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            // 複数の電力セグメントから供給され得るため加算する
            // Accumulate because several electric segments may supply this base
            _suppliedPower += power;
        }
        public void MarkConnected()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            IsConnected = true;
            _inventoryChanged = true;
            _onChangeBlockState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
        }
        // 接続できるかはプールが判定して渡す。拠点は判定せず状態に載せるだけ
        // The pool judges connectability and pushes it; the base only carries it in its state
        public void SetCablePoolAvailability(int poolAmount, bool hasEnoughCable)
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            _cablePoolAmount = poolAmount;
            _hasEnoughCable = hasEnoughCable;
            _onChangeBlockState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
        }

        public BlockStateDetail[] GetBlockStateDetails()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            var progress = IsCarrying ? 1f - (float)_remainingClimbTicks / _climbTotalTicks : 0f;
            var status = ResolveStatus();
            var detail = new SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail(IsConnected, _cablePoolAmount, progress, status, _inventory.SelectedCargoItemId(), IsCarrying ? _climbingSatellite.Id : null);
            return new[] { new BlockStateDetail(SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey, MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(detail)) };
            #region Internal
            SpaceElevatorBaseStatus ResolveStatus()
            {
                // 未選択は接続より先に伝える。選ぶまで何も受け取らず、接続もできないため（ADR 0106 7）。入口の状態は1回だけ読む
                // Report the missing selection before connection; nothing is accepted nor connectable until selected (ADR 0106 7). Read the inlet status once
                var inletStatus = _inventory.InletWaitStatus();
                if (!IsCarrying && inletStatus == SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.CargoNotSelected) return SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.CargoNotSelected;
                if (!IsConnected) return _hasEnoughCable ? SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.ReadyToConnect : SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.InsufficientCable;
                if (_outputBlocked) return SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.OutputBlocked;
                if (!IsCarrying) return inletStatus;
                return _latchedPower < _param.RequiredPower ? SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.LowPower : SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.Climbing;
            }
            #endregion
        }
        // 撤去時は昇降中の衛星をプレイヤーへ返す
        // On removal, return the satellite being carried to the player
        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> GetRefundItems()
        {
            return IsCarrying ? new List<IItemStack> { _climbingSatellite } : new List<IItemStack>();
        }

        public object GetSaveState()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            return SpaceElevatorClimberSaveRestorer.ToSave(IsConnected, _climbingSatellite, _remainingClimbTicks);
        }

        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }
        public void Destroy() { IsDestroy = true; _inventorySubscription.Dispose(); _stackLevelSubscription.Dispose(); _onChangeBlockState.Dispose(); }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Blocks;
using Game.Block.Component;
using Game.Block.Blocks.BeltConveyor.Connection;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Connector;
using Game.Block.Blocks.OrbitalCargo;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Service;
using Game.Block.Blocks.ElectricWire;
using Game.Block.Blocks.SpaceElevator;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Orbit;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.UnlockState;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;

namespace Game.Block.Factory.BlockTemplate.SpaceElevator
{
    public class VanillaSpaceElevatorBaseTemplate : IBlockTemplate
    {
        public IBlock New(BlockMasterElement blockMasterElement, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, BlockPositionInfo blockPositionInfo, BlockCreateParam[] createParams)
        {
            var param = (SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam)blockMasterElement.BlockParam;
            var connector = BlockTemplateUtil.CreateInventoryConnector(param.InventoryConnectors, blockPositionInfo);
            // 選択の実体は選択部品だけへ渡し、在庫（入口）には読む口として渡す
            // Hand the concrete selection only to the selector; the inventory (inlet) receives it as the read port
            var cargoSelection = new OrbitalCargoSelectionState();
            var inventory = new SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent(blockInstanceId, param, new ConnectingInventoryListPriorityInsertItemService(blockInstanceId, connector), ServerContext.GetService<IOrbitalArrivalService>(), cargoSelection);
            var selector = new OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent(cargoSelection, inventory.Inlet, ServerContext.GetService<IGameUnlockStateDataController>());
            var climber = new SpaceElevatorClimberComponent(param, inventory);
            return Assemble(null, blockMasterElement, blockInstanceId, blockPositionInfo, connector, inventory, selector, climber);
        }

        public IBlock Load(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, BlockMasterElement blockMasterElement, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, BlockPositionInfo blockPositionInfo)
        {
            var param = (SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam)blockMasterElement.BlockParam;
            var connector = BlockTemplateUtil.CreateInventoryConnector(param.InventoryConnectors, blockPositionInfo);
            var cargoSelection = new OrbitalCargoSelectionState();
            var inventory = new SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent(componentStates, blockInstanceId, param, new ConnectingInventoryListPriorityInsertItemService(blockInstanceId, connector), ServerContext.GetService<IOrbitalArrivalService>(), cargoSelection);
            // 選択は昇降機より先に読む（昇降機が購読を始める前に値を確定する）
            // Read the selection before the climber so the value is settled before it subscribes
            var selector = new OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent(componentStates, cargoSelection, inventory.Inlet, ServerContext.GetService<IGameUnlockStateDataController>());
            var climber = new SpaceElevatorClimberComponent(componentStates, param, inventory);
            return Assemble(componentStates, blockMasterElement, blockInstanceId, blockPositionInfo, connector, inventory, selector, climber);
        }

        private static IBlock Assemble(Dictionary<string, object> componentStates, BlockMasterElement blockMasterElement, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, BlockPositionInfo blockPositionInfo,
            BlockConnectorComponent<IBlockInventory, BeltInventoryConnectionContext> connector, SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent inventory, OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent selector, SpaceElevatorClimberComponent climber)
        {
            var param = (SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam)blockMasterElement.BlockParam;
            var electric = new SpaceElevatorBaseElectricComponent(blockInstanceId, climber);
            var wireConnector = new ElectricWireConnectorComponent(param.MaxWireConnectionCount, blockInstanceId, electric, componentStates);

            // 供給の受け取り(electric)を昇降機(climber)より前に並べる（前例 VanillaElectricPumpTemplate）
            // Order the supply receiver before the climber (precedent: VanillaElectricPumpTemplate)
            var components = new List<IBlockComponent> { connector, inventory, selector, electric, wireConnector, climber };
            return new BlockSystem(blockInstanceId, blockMasterElement.BlockGuid, components, blockPositionInfo);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task A4: 積荷を選んでいない拠点の接続をサーバーで拒否する

ADR 0106 の 7「まだ接続していない拠点は、積荷を選んでから接続する」。裁定 `.decisions/2026-10-23-エレベーター拠点に接続できるかはサーバーのプールが判定し画面は表示するだけ.md` は「接続できるかはサーバーが決め、画面は表示するだけ」なので、順番の決まりも画面ではなくサーバーが持つ。拒否は消費（プールからの引き算）の前に行い、拠点の状態も同じ順（A3 の `CargoNotSelected` が `ReadyToConnect` より先）にしてあるので、「接続できる」と表示しながら拒否することは起きない。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/Component/SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorConnectResult.cs`（`CargoNotSelected` を末尾に追加）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorConnectionService.cs`（全体）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Server/PacketTest/BeltRemoval/SpaceElevatorRemovalCapacityTest.cs`（25・39・56・83 行の後）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Game/SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorCablePoolTestBoundaries.cs`（93 行の後）
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Game/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoBaseConnectTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: A1 `IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent`・`UnselectedOrbitalCargo`、A3 で拠点に載った選択部品
- Produces: `SpaceElevatorConnectResult.CargoNotSelected`（`ConnectSpaceElevatorProtocol` の応答 `ConnectSpaceElevatorResponse.Result` にそのまま載る）。拒否は `[SpaceElevator] connection denied: CargoNotSelected instance=… position=…` を `Debug.Log` に1行出す（既存の `Refuse` と同じ）

```csharp
    // 選んでから接続する順をサーバーが守る（ADR 0106 7）

    public class OrbitalCargoBaseConnectTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 未選択の拠点は接続を拒否しケーブルを減らさない()
        {
            CreateServer();
            var elevatorBase = PlaceUnselectedBase(Vector3Int.zero);
            LaunchCables(100);
            var pool = ServerContext.GetService<SpaceElevatorCablePool>();
            var service = ServerContext.GetService<SpaceElevatorConnectionService>();
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.CargoNotSelected, ReadDetail(elevatorBase).Status);

            // 拒否は消費の前で、理由をログに残す
            // The refusal comes before consuming and leaves its reason in the log
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Log, new Regex("connection denied: CargoNotSelected"));
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorConnectResult.CargoNotSelected, service.Connect(elevatorBase));
            Assert.AreEqual(100, pool.Amount);
            Assert.IsFalse(elevatorBase.GetComponent<ISpaceElevatorBase>().IsConnected);

            // 選べば接続できる表示になり、同じ要求が通る
            // After selecting, the base shows it can connect and the same request succeeds
            OrbitalCargoTestUtil.SelectCargo(elevatorBase, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite);
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.ReadyToConnect, ReadDetail(elevatorBase).Status);
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorConnectResult.Connected, service.Connect(elevatorBase));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, pool.Amount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 接続済みの判定は未選択の判定より先に返る()
        {
            CreateServer();
            var elevatorBase = PlaceUnselectedBase(Vector3Int.zero);
            elevatorBase.GetComponent<ISpaceElevatorBase>().MarkConnected();
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Log, new Regex("connection denied: AlreadyConnected"));
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorConnectResult.AlreadyConnected, ServerContext.GetService<SpaceElevatorConnectionService>().Connect(elevatorBase));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.SpaceElevator
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     拠点の接続・撤去時の返却・残量と接続できるかの配信を受け持つ。拠点はプールの残量の判定も1エレベーター分の引き算も知らない
    ///     Owns connecting, the refund on removal and pushing the pool amount and connectability; bases know neither the pool check nor the per-elevator subtraction
    /// </summary>
    public class SpaceElevatorConnectionService : IBootInitializable
    {
        private readonly SpaceElevatorCablePool _pool;
        private readonly Dictionary<BlockInstanceId, TrackedSpaceElevatorBase> _bases = new();

        public SpaceElevatorConnectionService(SpaceElevatorCablePool pool)
        {
            _pool = pool;
        }

        public void Load()
        {
            // ワールドロードより前に購読し、ロードで置かれる拠点も拾う
            // Subscribe before the world loads so bases placed by the load are tracked too
            ServerContext.WorldBlockUpdateEvent.OnBlockPlaceEvent.Subscribe(properties => OnBlockPlaced(properties.BlockData.Block));
            ServerContext.WorldBlockUpdateEvent.OnBlockRemoveEvent.Subscribe(properties => OnBlockRemoved(properties.BlockData.Block));
            _pool.OnAmountChanged.Subscribe(_ => PushAvailabilityToAll());
            #region Internal
            void OnBlockPlaced(IBlock block)
            {
                if (!block.ComponentManager.TryGetComponent<ISpaceElevatorBase>(out var elevatorBase)) return;
                var cablesPerElevator = ((SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam)block.BlockMasterElement.BlockParam).CablesPerElevator;
                var tracked = new TrackedSpaceElevatorBase(elevatorBase, block.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>(), cablesPerElevator);
                _bases[block.BlockInstanceId] = tracked;
                PushAvailability(tracked);
            }
            void OnBlockRemoved(IBlock block)
            {
                if (!_bases.TryGetValue(block.BlockInstanceId, out var tracked)) return;

                // 接続済みの拠点だけが1エレベーター分をプールへ戻す。撤去イベントはDestroyより前に来るので状態を読める
                // Only a connected base returns one elevator's worth; the remove event fires before Destroy, so its state is still readable
                if (tracked.Base.IsConnected) _pool.Add(tracked.CablesPerElevator);
                // 返却の失敗は撤去を止めるため、再試行に必要な追跡は成功後に外す
                // A failed refund aborts removal, so retain tracking for a retry until the refund succeeds
                _bases.Remove(block.BlockInstanceId);
            }
            // 接続できるかはプールの HasEnough で決め、拠点へは結果だけを渡す
            // Connectability is decided by the pool's HasEnough; the base only receives the result
            void PushAvailability(TrackedSpaceElevatorBase tracked)
            {
                tracked.Base.SetCablePoolAvailability(_pool.Amount, _pool.HasEnough(tracked.CablesPerElevator));
            }
            void PushAvailabilityToAll()
            {
                foreach (var tracked in _bases.Values) PushAvailability(tracked);
            }
            #endregion
        }

        // segmentを消す前に、撤去で戻る全ケーブルの受け入れを確認する
        // Check the full cable refund before removal discards any segment items
        public bool CanRemove(IBlock block)
        {
            if (!_bases.TryGetValue(block.BlockInstanceId, out var tracked) || !tracked.Base.IsConnected) return true;
            if (tracked.CablesPerElevator <= int.MaxValue - _pool.Amount) return true;
            Debug.LogWarning($"[SpaceElevator] removal denied: cable pool overflow instance={block.BlockInstanceId} amount={_pool.Amount} refund={tracked.CablesPerElevator}");
            return false;
        }

        public SpaceElevatorConnectResult Connect(IBlock block)
        {
            if (!_bases.TryGetValue(block.BlockInstanceId, out var tracked)) return Refuse(SpaceElevatorConnectResult.NotSpaceElevatorBase);
            if (tracked.Base.IsConnected) return Refuse(SpaceElevatorConnectResult.AlreadyConnected);
            // 積荷を選ぶまで接続させない（ADR 0106 7）。拠点の状態も同じ順で選択待ちを先に出す
            // Refuse connecting until a cargo is selected (ADR 0106 7); the base status reports the selection wait first in the same order
            if (tracked.CargoSelector.Selection is UnselectedOrbitalCargo) return Refuse(SpaceElevatorConnectResult.CargoNotSelected);

            // 1基分の残量を引いて接続
            // Take one base's cable requirement and connect it
            if (!_pool.TryTake(tracked.CablesPerElevator)) return Refuse(SpaceElevatorConnectResult.InsufficientCable);
            tracked.Base.MarkConnected();
            return SpaceElevatorConnectResult.Connected;

            #region Internal

            SpaceElevatorConnectResult Refuse(SpaceElevatorConnectResult reason)
            {
                // 操作の拒否を対象とともに記録する
                // Record a rejected operation together with its target
                Debug.Log($"[SpaceElevator] connection denied: {reason} instance={block.BlockInstanceId.AsPrimitive()} position={block.BlockPositionInfo.OriginalPos}");
                return reason;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        // 追跡中の拠点と、その積荷の選択・1エレベーター分の量
        // A tracked base with its cargo selection and cables per elevator
        private class TrackedSpaceElevatorBase
        {
            public readonly ISpaceElevatorBase Base;
            public readonly IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent CargoSelector;
            public readonly int CablesPerElevator;

            public TrackedSpaceElevatorBase(ISpaceElevatorBase elevatorBase, IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent cargoSelector, int cablesPerElevator)
            {
                Base = elevatorBase;
                CargoSelector = cargoSelector;
                CablesPerElevator = cablesPerElevator;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Task A5: 積荷を選ぶ通信 `va:orbitalCargoSelection`

ADR 0106 の 5（通信は1つ・発射台と拠点で共通）。前例は `RocketLaunchPadCommandProtocol`（座標＋実体IDの照合・`InstanceMismatch`・`Fail` で警告ログ）と `MachineRecipeSelectionProtocol`（返却先に要求者の `MainOpenableInventory` を渡す）。結果の表示はブロック状態の更新を正とし、応答は成否と理由だけを返す（選択の値は返さない）。

**Files:**
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoSelectionProtocol.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponseCreator.cs`（78 行の後に1行）
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Network/API/Requests/BlockRequestApi.cs`（80 行の後に送信メソッド。122 → 130 行）
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Server/PacketTest/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoSelectionProtocolTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: A1 `IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent.SelectCargo`・`OrbitalCargoSelectionResult`、A2/A3 で両ブロックに載った選択部品、A3 `PlaceUnselectedBase`
- Produces:
  - タグ `va:orbitalCargoSelection`
  - 要求 `OrbitalCargoSelectionRequest`: `[Key(2)] Vector3IntMessagePack Position`・`[Key(3)] int? ExpectedInstanceId`・`[Key(4)] ItemId? PayloadItemId`。ctor `(Vector3Int, BlockInstanceId, ItemId)`
  - 応答 `OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse`: `[Key(2)] bool Success`・`[Key(3)] OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason FailureReason`
  - `OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason`: `None=0, InvalidRequest=1, BlockNotFound=2, InstanceMismatch=3, NotCargoSelector=4, NotCarriedHere=5, Locked=6`
  - クライアント `BlockRequestApi.SendOrbitalCargoSelection(Vector3Int position, ItemId payloadItemId, BlockInstanceId expectedInstanceId, CancellationToken ct)` → `UniTask<(OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse response, PacketWaitCompletionReason reason)>`
  - 前の種類の返却先は要求したプレイヤーの `MainOpenableInventory`

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void 選ぶと発射台の選択が変わり前の種類は要求者の手持ちへ返る()

            var selection = (SelectedOrbitalCargo)pad.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>().Selection;
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId, selection.PayloadItemId);
            var main = (IPlayerInventoryDataStore)_provider.GetService(typeof(IPlayerInventoryDataStore));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, main.GetInventoryData(PlayerId).MainOpenableInventory.InventoryItems.Where(item => item.Id == ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId).Sum(item => item.Count));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 拠点も同じ通信で選べる()
        {
            Tests.CombinedTest.Game.SpaceElevator.SpaceElevatorTestUtil.PlaceUnselectedBase(Vector3Int.zero);
            var block = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(Vector3Int.zero);
            AssertSuccess(Send(Vector3Int.zero, block.BlockInstanceId, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite));
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<SelectedOrbitalCargo>(block.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>().Selection);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 部品の拒否は理由付きで返る()
        {
            var pad = RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.PlacePoweredPad(Vector3Int.zero, 100);
            // この台が運ばない品
            // An item this pad does not carry
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex("積荷の選択を拒否しました 理由:NotCarriedHere"));
            AssertFailure(Send(Vector3Int.zero, pad.BlockInstanceId, ForUnitTestItemId.ItemId1), OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.NotCarriedHere);
            // まだ解放していない積荷（ADR 0106 3）
            // A payload not unlocked yet (ADR 0106 3)
            OrbitalCargoTestUtil.LockItem(ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId);
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex("積荷の選択を拒否しました 理由:Locked"));
            AssertFailure(Send(Vector3Int.zero, pad.BlockInstanceId, ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId), OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.Locked);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<UnselectedOrbitalCargo>(pad.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>().Selection);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 通信側の拒否は理由付きで返る()
        {
            var pad = RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.PlacePoweredPad(Vector3Int.zero, 100);
            ExpectProtocolRejection(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.BlockNotFound);
            AssertFailure(Send(new Vector3Int(50, 0, 0), pad.BlockInstanceId, ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId), OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.BlockNotFound);
            ExpectProtocolRejection(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.InstanceMismatch);
            AssertFailure(Send(Vector3Int.zero, new BlockInstanceId(pad.BlockInstanceId.AsPrimitive() + 1), ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId), OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.InstanceMismatch);

            // 選択部品の無いブロック
            // A block without a cargo selector
            Assert.IsTrue(ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.ChestId, new Vector3Int(10, 0, 0), BlockDirection.North, System.Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var chest));
            ExpectProtocolRejection(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.NotCargoSelector);
            AssertFailure(Send(new Vector3Int(10, 0, 0), chest.BlockInstanceId, ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId), OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.NotCargoSelector);

            // 積荷の欠けた要求（実 MessagePack の配列で末尾を落とす）
            // A request missing the payload, as a real MessagePack array with the tail dropped
            var bytes = MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new object[] { ProtocolTag, 42, new global::Server.Util.MessagePack.Vector3IntMessagePack(Vector3Int.zero), pad.BlockInstanceId.AsPrimitive() });
            ExpectProtocolRejection(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.InvalidRequest);
            AssertFailure(MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse>(_packet.GetPacketResponse(bytes, BoundPacketContext.Bind(PlayerId))[0]), OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.InvalidRequest);
        }

        private OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse Send(Vector3Int position, BlockInstanceId instanceId, ItemId payloadItemId)
        {
            // 実通信のタグ・接続ID・連番を検証
            // Verify tags, connection identity and sequence round-trip through real dispatch
            var request = new OrbitalCargoSelectionRequest(position, instanceId, payloadItemId) { SequenceId = 42 };
            var responses = _packet.GetPacketResponse(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(request), BoundPacketContext.Bind(PlayerId));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, responses.Count);
            var response = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse>(responses[0]);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProtocolTag, response.Tag);
            Assert.AreEqual(42, response.SequenceId);
            return response;
        }

        private static void AssertSuccess(OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse response)
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(response.Success);
            Assert.AreEqual(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.None, response.FailureReason);
        }

        private static void AssertFailure(OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse response, OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason reason)
        {
            Assert.IsFalse(response.Success);
            Assert.AreEqual(reason, response.FailureReason);
        }

        private static void ExpectProtocolRejection(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason reason)
        {
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex($"積荷の選択要求を拒否しました 理由:{reason} 座標:"));
        }
    }
}
```
