- [x] **Step 3: 実装を書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoSelectionProtocol.cs`（116 行。`Server.Protocol.asmdef` は `Game.PlayerInventory.Interface` を既に参照＝`MachineRecipeSelectionProtocol` が使っている）:

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Context;
using Game.PlayerInventory.Interface;
using MessagePack;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ロケット発射台・宇宙エレベーター拠点の積荷を選ぶ。選択の結果はブロック状態の更新を正とする（ADR 0106 5）
    ///     Selects the cargo of a launch pad or space elevator base; the block state update is the source of truth (ADR 0106 5)
    /// </summary>
    public class OrbitalCargoSelectionProtocol : IPacketResponse
    {
        public const string ProtocolTag = "va:orbitalCargoSelection";
        private readonly IPlayerInventoryDataStore _playerInventoryDataStore;

        internal OrbitalCargoSelectionProtocol(ServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            _playerInventoryDataStore = serviceProvider.GetService<IPlayerInventoryDataStore>();
        }

        public ProtocolMessagePackBase GetResponse(byte[] payload, int requesterPlayerId)
        {
            var request = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<OrbitalCargoSelectionRequest>(payload);
            if (request.Position == null || !request.ExpectedInstanceId.HasValue || !request.PayloadItemId.HasValue) return Fail(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.InvalidRequest);

            // 座標と実体IDで対象を確かめ、選択部品の無いブロックは拒否する
            // Verify the target by position and instance ID, rejecting blocks without a cargo selector
            var block = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(request.Position.Vector3Int);
            if (block == null) return Fail(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.BlockNotFound);
            if (block.BlockInstanceId.AsPrimitive() != request.ExpectedInstanceId.Value) return Fail(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.InstanceMismatch);
            if (!block.ComponentManager.TryGetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>(out var selector)) return Fail(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.NotCargoSelector);

            // 前の種類の返却先は選んだプレイヤーの手持ち（ADR 0106 4）
            // Leftovers of the previous kind go to the selecting player's inventory (ADR 0106 4)
            var refundInventory = _playerInventoryDataStore.GetInventoryData(requesterPlayerId).MainOpenableInventory;
            var result = selector.SelectCargo(request.PayloadItemId.Value, refundInventory);
            // 部品側の拒否は部品が理由をログに出している
            // Component-side rejections are already logged by the component
            return result switch
            {
                OrbitalCargoSelectionResult.Success => new OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse(true, OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.None),
                OrbitalCargoSelectionResult.NotCarriedHere => new OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse(false, OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.NotCarriedHere),
                OrbitalCargoSelectionResult.Locked => new OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse(false, OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason.Locked),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(result), result, "通信の失敗理由へ写していない積荷選択の結果です"),
            };

            #region Internal

            OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse Fail(OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason reason)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"積荷の選択要求を拒否しました 理由:{reason} 座標:{request.Position?.Vector3Int}");
                return new OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse(false, reason);
            }

            #endregion
        }

        #region MessagePack

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class OrbitalCargoSelectionRequest : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            [Key(2)] public Vector3IntMessagePack Position { get; set; }
            [Key(3)] public int? ExpectedInstanceId { get; set; }
            [Key(4)] public ItemId? PayloadItemId { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public OrbitalCargoSelectionRequest() { Tag = ProtocolTag; }

            public OrbitalCargoSelectionRequest(Vector3Int position, BlockInstanceId expectedInstanceId, ItemId payloadItemId)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                Position = new Vector3IntMessagePack(position);
                ExpectedInstanceId = expectedInstanceId.AsPrimitive();
                PayloadItemId = payloadItemId;
            }
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            [Key(2)] public bool Success { get; set; }
            [Key(3)] public OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason FailureReason { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse() { }

            public OrbitalCargoSelectionResponse(bool success, OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason failureReason)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                Success = success;
                FailureReason = failureReason;
            }
        }

        public enum OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason
        {
            None = 0,
            InvalidRequest = 1,
            BlockNotFound = 2,
            InstanceMismatch = 3,
            NotCargoSelector = 4,
            NotCarriedHere = 5,
            Locked = 6,
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

### Task A6: 積荷の選択をブループリントでコピーする

ADR 0106 の 3（未解放の種類を持つブループリントは未選択で置く）と 5（ブループリントでコピー）。前例は `MachineRecipeBlueprintSettingsComponent`（キー・GUID 文字列の JSON・設置直後に空のダミー在庫で適用）。前例は不正 GUID を無言で捨てているが、ここでは AGENTS.md の「無音の縮退は禁止」に合わせて警告を出す。設定は `BlockFactory` が `template.New` の直後に汎用で適用するため、テンプレートは `createParams` を読まない。

```csharp
        {
```

```csharp
using Core.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Context;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.OrbitalCargo
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     積荷の選択をブループリントでコピーする設定（発射台・拠点で共用。ADR 0106 5）
    ///     Blueprint settings copying the cargo selection, shared by the launch pad and the base (ADR 0106 5)
    /// </summary>
    public class OrbitalCargoBlueprintSettingsComponent : IBlockBlueprintSettings
    {
        public const string SettingsKey = "OrbitalCargoSelection";
        public string BlueprintSettingsKey => SettingsKey;

        private readonly IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent _selector;

        public OrbitalCargoBlueprintSettingsComponent(IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent selector)
        {
            _selector = selector;
        }

        public string GetBlueprintSettingsJson()
        {
            return JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new SettingsJsonObject { SelectedCargoItemGuid = _selector.Selection.ToItemGuidTextOrNull() });
        }

        public void ApplyBlueprintSettingsJson(string json)
        {
            var settings = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SettingsJsonObject>(json);
            // silent-ok: 未選択でコピーした台は未選択のまま置く / プレイヤーは台の「積荷を選んでいない」表示で気づく
            if (settings?.SelectedCargoItemGuid == null) return;
            if (!OrbitalCargoItemGuid.TryParseExistingItemGuid(settings.SelectedCargoItemGuid, out var payloadItemId))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"ブループリントの積荷 {settings.SelectedCargoItemGuid} が今のマスタに無いため、未選択のまま設置します");
                return;
            }

            // 未解放・この台が運ばない種類は SelectCargo が理由をログに出して拒否し、未選択のまま置かれる（ADR 0106 3）
            // Locked or non-carried kinds are rejected and logged by SelectCargo, leaving the block unselected (ADR 0106 3)
            // 適用は設置直後で入口が空のため返却は起きない。返却先は空きの無いダミーでよい
            // Applied right after creation with an empty inlet, so nothing is refunded; a zero-slot dummy suffices
            var noRefund = new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService((_, _) => { }, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, 0);
            _selector.SelectCargo(payloadItemId, noRefund);
        }

        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }
        public void Destroy()
        {
            IsDestroy = true;
        }

        private class SettingsJsonObject
        {
            [JsonProperty("selectedCargoItemGuid")] public string SelectedCargoItemGuid;
        }
    }
}
```

### Task A7: 旧セーブ・未解放の復元・通信の往復を通しで確かめる

ADR 0106 の 6（項目を足す・`nextPayloadIndex` は書かず読まない・版を上げない・移行を書かない・項目が無ければ未選択で1行ログ）と 3（セーブの復元は解放を見ない）。部品単体の読み込みは A1 の単体テストで見ているので、ここでは実際に保存したワールドの JSON を書き換えて、ワールドのロード経路を通す。あわせて状態に載せた `ItemId?` が MessagePack を往復することを確かめる（`ItemId` には UnitGenerator の formatter があるが、`Nullable<ItemId>` を状態に載せる前例は無い）。

版を上げない理由: 項目の追加は旧セーブを「項目なし＝未選択」として読めるので形の変換が要らず、`nextPayloadIndex` は Newtonsoft の既定（未知メンバーは無視）で読み捨てられる。AGENTS.md の「セーブ形式を変える PR は版を上げる」の例外になるため、裁定は ADR 0106 の 6 を根拠にする（要裁定には上げない）。

- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Game/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoSaveTest.cs`
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoStateWireTest.cs`
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Game/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoFirstSelectionRefundTest.cs`

- Consumes: A1 `OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent.SaveKeyName`、A2 `RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.CargoNotSelected`・`RocketLaunchPadStateDetail` の5引数 ctor・`RocketLaunchPadSaveTestUtil.CreateSavedWorld`（A2 の改名で、建造中以降の世界は「衛星の便を積んだまま電線ケーブルへ選び直した」状態で保存される）、A3 `SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail` の6引数 ctor・`PlaceBase(pos, 積荷)`
- Produces: なし（検証のみ）

```csharp
using Tests.Util;
using Tests.Util.Rocket;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Game.SpaceElevator.SpaceElevatorTestUtil;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Game.SpaceElevator.SpaceElevatorConnectionTest;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Game.OrbitalCargo
{
    // 積荷の選択のセーブ（ADR 0106 6）。版番号を上げず、項目が無い旧セーブは未選択で読む
    // Saving the cargo selection (ADR 0106 6): no version bump, and an old save without the item loads unselected
    public class OrbitalCargoSaveTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 項目の無い旧セーブの発射台は未選択で読まれ建造を拒否する()
        {
            // 今のコードで保存した世界から項目を消し、巡回位置を足して旧セーブの形にする
            // Turn a world saved by current code into the old shape: drop the item and add the rotation index
            var save = RocketLaunchPadSaveTestUtil.CreateSavedWorld(RocketLaunchPadPhase.AwaitingBuildCommand);
            Assert.IsTrue(PadBlockState(save).Remove(OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent.SaveKeyName));
            RocketLaunchPadSaveTestUtil.State(save)["nextPayloadIndex"] = 1;

            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Log, new Regex($"ブロックのセーブ状態にキー {OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent.SaveKeyName} がないため"));
            var pad = RocketLaunchPadSaveTestUtil.Load(save);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<UnselectedOrbitalCargo>(pad.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>().Selection);

            // 積み終えた段階は残り、選ぶまで建造の合図は通らない
            // The loaded stage remains, and the build command is refused until a cargo is chosen
            var processor = pad.GetComponent<RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent>();
            Assert.AreEqual(RocketLaunchPadPhase.AwaitingBuildCommand, RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.ReadState(processor).Phase);
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex("ロケット発射台への操作を拒否しました 理由:CargoNotSelected"));
            Assert.AreEqual(RocketLaunchPadCommandResult.CargoNotSelected, processor.RequestBuild());
            // 保存し直すと巡回位置は書かれない
            // Saving again does not write the rotation index
            Assert.IsNull(JObject.FromObject(RocketLaunchPadSaveTestUtil.Capture(pad))["nextPayloadIndex"]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 読み込んだ選択は未解放でも残り今の便の積荷も変わらない()
        {
            // 建造中（衛星を積んだ便）に電線ケーブルへ選び直した世界を、衛星・ケーブルが未解放の状態で読む
            // Load a world reselected to cable mid-build (satellite flight) with both payloads locked
            var save = RocketLaunchPadSaveTestUtil.CreateSavedWorld(RocketLaunchPadPhase.Building);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, LockInSave(save, ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, LockInSave(save, ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId));
            var pad = RocketLaunchPadSaveTestUtil.Load(save);
            Assert.IsFalse(ServerContext.GetService<IGameUnlockStateDataController>().ItemUnlockStateInfos[ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId].IsUnlocked);

            // 解放はセーブの復元では見ない（ADR 0106 3）
            // Unlock state is not checked when restoring a save (ADR 0106 3)
            var detail = RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.ReadState(pad.GetComponent<RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent>());
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId, detail.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId, detail.LoadedCargoItemId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 項目の無い旧セーブの拠点は未選択で読まれ入口の中身は残る()
        {
            var (_, provider) = CreateServer();
            var elevatorBase = PlaceBase(Vector3Int.zero, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite);
            Inventory(elevatorBase).SetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, 1);
            var save = JObject.Parse(SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.AssembleSaveJson(provider));
            var baseState = (JObject)save["world"].OfType<JObject>().Single(block => block["state"]?["spaceElevatorClimber"] != null)["state"];
            Assert.IsTrue(baseState.Remove(OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent.SaveKeyName));

            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Log, new Regex($"ブロックのセーブ状態にキー {OrbitalCargoSelectorComponent.SaveKeyName} がないため"));
            var (_, loadedProvider) = CreateServer();
            SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.LoadFromJson(loadedProvider, save.ToString());
            var loaded = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(Vector3Int.zero);

            // 入口の中身は消さず、選ぶまで受け取りも昇降も止まる（ADR 0106 6・7）
            // Inlet contents are kept, and accepting and climbing stop until a cargo is chosen (ADR 0106 6, 7)
            Assert.AreEqual(1, Inventory(loaded).GetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.CargoNotSelected, ReadDetail(loaded).Status);
            Assert.IsNull(ReadDetail(loaded).SelectedCargoItemId);
        }

        private static JObject PadBlockState(JObject save)
        {
            var key = typeof(RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent).FullName;
            return (JObject)save["world"].OfType<JObject>().Single(block => block["state"]?[key] != null)["state"];
        }

        // セーブの解放状態で指定の品を未解放にし、書き換えた件数を返す
        // Mark the item locked in the saved unlock state and return how many entries were rewritten
        private static int LockInSave(JObject save, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var guid = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemGuid(itemId).ToString();
            var entries = save.Descendants().OfType<JObject>().Where(entry => (string)entry["guid"] == guid && entry["isUnlocked"] != null).ToList();
            foreach (var entry in entries) entry["isUnlocked"] = false;
            return entries.Count;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/OrbitalCargo/OrbitalCargoStateWireTest.cs`:

```csharp
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using MessagePack;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.OrbitalCargo
{
    // 状態に載せた積荷（ItemId?）が MessagePack を往復する。値あり・null の両方
    // The cargo fields (ItemId?) in block states round-trip through MessagePack, both with a value and null
    public class OrbitalCargoStateWireTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 発射台の積荷2欄が往復する()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var withValue = RoundTrip(new RocketLaunchPadStateDetail(RocketLaunchPadPhase.Building, RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.None, 0.5f, ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId, ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId, withValue.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId, withValue.LoadedCargoItemId);
            var empty = RoundTrip(new RocketLaunchPadStateDetail(RocketLaunchPadPhase.Idle, RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.CargoNotSelected, 0f, null, null));
            Assert.IsNull(empty.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.IsNull(empty.LoadedCargoItemId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 拠点の積荷2欄が往復する()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var withValue = RoundTrip(new SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail(true, 0, 0.5f, SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.Climbing, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload, ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload, withValue.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, withValue.ClimbingCargoItemId);
            var empty = RoundTrip(new SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail(false, 0, 0f, SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.CargoNotSelected, null, null));
            Assert.IsNull(empty.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.IsNull(empty.ClimbingCargoItemId);
        }

        private static T RoundTrip<T>(T detail)
        {
            return MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<T>(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(detail));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Linq;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.SpaceElevator;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util.Rocket;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Game.SpaceElevator.SpaceElevatorTestUtil;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Game.OrbitalCargo
{
    // 旧セーブなどで未選択の台に前から積荷が入っているとき、最初の選択でも選ばなかった種類を返す（ADR 0106 4）
    // When an unselected block already holds payloads (e.g. an old save), the first selection also returns the kinds not chosen (ADR 0106 4)
    public class OrbitalCargoFirstSelectionRefundTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 発射台は最初の選択で選ばなかった積荷枠を返し選んだ枠は残す()
        {
            CreateServer();
            var pad = RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.PlacePoweredPad(Vector3Int.zero, 100);
            var inventory = pad.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
            // 受け入れ判定を通らない SetItem で、旧セーブの中身を再現する
            // Reproduce old-save contents with SetItem, which skips the acceptance check
            inventory.SetItem(PayloadSlot(pad, ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId), ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId, 3);
            inventory.SetItem(PayloadSlot(pad, ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId), ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId, 1);

            var refund = NewRefund();
            Assert.AreEqual(OrbitalCargoSelectionResult.Success, pad.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>().SelectCargo(ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId, refund));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, Count(refund, ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(PayloadSlot(pad, ForUnitTestItemId.CablePayloadId)).Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.GetItem(PayloadSlot(pad, ForUnitTestItemId.SatellitePayloadId)).Count);
        }

        [TestCase(true)]
        [TestCase(false)]
        public void 拠点は最初の選択で入口の別の種類を返し同じ種類は残す(bool sameKind)
        {
            CreateServer();
            var elevatorBase = PlaceUnselectedBase(Vector3Int.zero);
            var held = sameKind ? ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite : ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorBulkPayload;
            Inventory(elevatorBase).SetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot, held, 2);

            var refund = NewRefund();
            Assert.AreEqual(OrbitalCargoSelectionResult.Success, elevatorBase.GetComponent<IOrbitalCargoSelectorComponent>().SelectCargo(ForUnitTestItemId.TestElevatorSatellite, refund));
            Assert.AreEqual(sameKind ? 0 : 2, Count(refund, held));
            Assert.AreEqual(sameKind ? 2 : 0, Inventory(elevatorBase).GetItem(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot).Count);
        }

        private static int PayloadSlot(IBlock pad, ItemId payloadItemId)
        {
            var layout = RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.GetLayout(pad);
            return layout.PayloadSlots.Single(slot => layout.RequirementAt(slot).ItemId == payloadItemId);
        }

        private static OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService NewRefund()
        {
            return new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService((_, _) => { }, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, 10);
        }

        private static int Count(OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService inventory, ItemId itemId)
        {
            return inventory.InventoryItems.Where(item => item.Id == itemId).Sum(item => item.Count);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task A8: 「ケーブルプールへ足す積荷か」をサーバーとクライアントが読む1か所の口にする

クライアントの下書き B の注文 1。クライアントは積荷の行に「ケーブルプール +1000」を出すのにこの判定が要るが、今の持ち主 `SpaceElevatorBaseMasters.CableItemIds()`（`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorBaseMasters.cs:21`）は `internal` で、`Game.SpaceElevator` はクライアントから参照できない。写しを持つと持ち主が2つになるので、公開の口を1つ置き、サーバーのプールもそれを読む。

置き場の決め方（`.claude/skills/moores-writing-plans/references/moorestech-layer-map.md`）:
- `Core.Master` は「ドメイン固有の解釈ロジック」を置いてはいけない層で、「`ItemMaster`/`BlockMaster` へのメソッド追加はほぼ常に誤り」とある。拠点のケーブルという宇宙エレベーターの語彙なので外す。
- 「マスタ値のドメイン解釈 → 該当ドメインの `Game.Xxx.Interface` に static util」「`Game.Xxx.Interface` にはマスタ生成物を読むだけの static util を置いてよい」。宇宙エレベーターには専用の `*.Interface` アセンブリが無く、公開の契約は既に `Game.Block.Interface/Component/SpaceElevator/`（`ISpaceElevatorBase`・`SpaceElevatorConnectResult`、名前空間 `Game.Block.Interface.Component`）にある。
- 同種の前例: `Game.Block.Interface/Component/RocketLaunchPad/RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout.cs`（`MasterHolder` から発射台の枠の並びを導き、「サーバーと表示が同じ並びを使う」とコメントにある。名前空間 `Game.Block.Interface.Component`）と `Game.Block.Interface/MachineUpgrade/ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.cs`。
- よって、クライアント案どおり `Game.Block.Interface/Component/SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorCableItems.cs`・名前空間 `Game.Block.Interface.Component` に置く。「ブロック共通の口の層に宇宙エレベーターの語彙」は、この層が既にドメインごとのサブディレクトリ（`RocketLaunchPad/`・`SpaceElevator/`・`CleanRoom/`）で各ブロックの契約を持つ作りなので、層の決まりに反しない。

静的な集合のキャッシュは持たない（テストは DI を作るたびに別のマスタを読み直すので、キャッシュは前のマスタを指したまま残る）。呼ばれるのは軌道到着のたびと表示の行の組み立てだけで、拠点のブロック数ぶん回すだけ。

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/Component/SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorCableItems.cs`（`Game.Block.Interface.asmdef` は `Core.Master` を既に参照し、`RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout` が `Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule` を使っている）:

```csharp
using Core.Master;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;

namespace Game.Block.Interface.Component
{
    // ケーブルプールへ足す積荷か（全拠点のケーブル品）。マスタだけから決まり、サーバーのプールとクライアントの表示が同じ口を読む
    // Whether a payload feeds the cable pool (any base's cable item); derived from the master alone and read by both the server pool and the client display
    public static class SpaceElevatorCableItems
    {
        public static bool Contains(ItemId itemId)
        {
            // 拠点の無いマスタでは何も数えない。種類の整合はマスタ読込時の検証が持つ
            // A master without bases counts nothing; consistency across bases is checked at master load
            foreach (var block in MasterHolder.BlockMaster.Blocks.Data)
            {
                if (block.BlockParam is SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam param && MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(param.CableItemGuid) == itemId) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.SpaceElevator/SpaceElevatorCablePool.cs` 全文:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Orbit;
using Game.SpaceElevator.Save;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.SpaceElevator
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ワールドに1つのケーブルプール。ケーブルの軌道到着で増え、接続で減り、接続済み拠点の撤去で戻る（ADR 0092）
    ///     The world's single cable pool: grows on cable orbital arrivals, shrinks on connections, refills when a connected base is removed (ADR 0092)
    /// </summary>
    public class SpaceElevatorCablePool : IBootInitializable
    {
        public int Amount { get; private set; }
        public IObservable<int> OnAmountChanged => _onAmountChanged;

        private readonly Subject<int> _onAmountChanged = new();
        private readonly IOrbitalArrivalService _orbitalArrivalService;

        public SpaceElevatorCablePool(IOrbitalArrivalService orbitalArrivalService)
        {
            _orbitalArrivalService = orbitalArrivalService;
        }

        public void Load()
        {
            // ケーブルの到着だけを数える。どの打ち上げ口から来たかは見ない
            // Count only cable arrivals, regardless of which launch site sent them
            _orbitalArrivalService.OnOrbitalArrival.Subscribe(arrival =>
            {
                // silent-ok: ケーブル以外の到着はプールの対象外 / 他の到着は各打ち上げ口の成果として届く
                if (!SpaceElevatorCableItems.Contains(arrival.PayloadItemId)) return;
                Add(arrival.PayloadCount);
            });
        }

        // 1エレベーター分が残っているか。接続できるかの判定はここだけが持つ
        // Whether one elevator's worth remains; this is the only place that judges whether a base can connect
        internal bool HasEnough(int count)
        {
            return count <= Amount;
        }

        // 足りれば引いてtrue。足りなければ何もしない（接続サービスだけが使う）
        // Take the count and return true when enough remains; otherwise change nothing (only the connection service uses this)
        internal bool TryTake(int count)
        {
            if (!HasEnough(count)) return false;
            SetAmount(Amount - count);
            return true;
        }

        internal void Add(int count)
        {
            // 到着と撤去返却の確定前に検査し、失敗時は残量も通知も変えない
            // Validate before committing an arrival or removal refund, leaving amount and notifications unchanged on failure
            if (count < 0 || int.MaxValue - Amount < count)
            {
                var reason = $"ケーブルプールの加算が整数範囲を超えます amount:{Amount} count:{count} max:{int.MaxValue}";
                Debug.LogError(reason);
                throw new InvalidOperationException(reason);
            }
            SetAmount(Amount + count);
        }

        public bool CanAcceptArrival(ItemId itemId, int count)
        {
            return !SpaceElevatorCableItems.Contains(itemId) || (0 <= count && count <= int.MaxValue - Amount);
        }

        public SpaceElevatorCablePoolSaveData GetSaveData()
        {
            return new SpaceElevatorCablePoolSaveData { CableCount = Amount };
        }

        public void Restore(SpaceElevatorCablePoolSaveData saveData)
        {
            // 負の残量は手編集による破損。黙って0にせず止める
            // A negative amount means a hand-edited save; stop instead of silently clamping to zero
            if (saveData.CableCount < 0)
            {
                var reason = $"セーブの spaceElevatorCablePool.cableCount が負です value:{saveData.CableCount}";
                Debug.LogError(reason);
                throw new InvalidOperationException(reason);
            }
            SetAmount(saveData.CableCount);
        }

        private void SetAmount(int amount)
        {
            Amount = amount;
            _onAmountChanged.OnNext(amount);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Core.Master;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の見本。ICチップ 2 種（成果は計算データ）とケーブル 1 種（成果はケーブルプール）
    /// Cargo samples: two IC chip kinds (compute data out) and one cable kind (cable pool)
    /// </summary>
    public static class OrbitalCargoSamples
    {
        // L1 で名前と絵を引くので、テスト用マスタにある小さな ID を使う（既存の画面テストと同じ 1〜4）
        // L1 resolves names and icons, so use small IDs present in the test master (1-4, as existing screen tests do)
        public static readonly ItemId ChipLv1 = new(1);
        public static readonly ItemId ChipLv2 = new(2);
        public static readonly ItemId Cable = new(3);
        public static readonly ItemId ComputeData = new(4);

        public static OrbitalCargoChoice ChipLv1Choice => new(ChipLv1, 20, new[] { new ItemAmount(ComputeData, 20) }, false);
        public static OrbitalCargoChoice ChipLv2Choice => new(ChipLv2, 20, new[] { new ItemAmount(ComputeData, 40) }, false);
        public static OrbitalCargoChoice CableChoice => new(Cable, 1000, Array.Empty<ItemAmount>(), true);

        public static IReadOnlyList<OrbitalCargoChoice> PadCarried => new[] { ChipLv1Choice, ChipLv2Choice, CableChoice };

        // 発射台の詳細（3 種を運び、unlocked だけ解放済み）
        // A launch pad cargo detail carrying three kinds with only `unlocked` released
        public static OrbitalCargoDetail Pad(ItemId? selected, ItemId? currentFlight, params ItemId[] unlocked)
        {
            return new OrbitalCargoDetail(selected, currentFlight, PadCarried, new HashSet<ItemId>(unlocked), 120);
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoDetailTest.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using static Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo.OrbitalCargoSamples;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    public class OrbitalCargoDetailTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 一覧は運ぶ種類のうち解放済みだけを運ぶ順で出す()
        {
            var detail = Pad(null, null, Cable, ChipLv1);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { ChipLv1, Cable }, detail.SelectableChoices.Select(c => c.PayloadItemId).ToArray());
            Assert.IsFalse(detail.IsSelected);
            Assert.IsFalse(detail.TryGetHeadline(out _), "未選択で今の便も無ければ見出しは無い");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 見出しは今の便を優先し選んだ積荷と違えば次の便を出す()
        {
            var detail = Pad(ChipLv2, ChipLv1, ChipLv1, ChipLv2);
            Assert.IsTrue(detail.TryGetHeadline(out var headline));
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipLv1, headline.PayloadItemId);
            Assert.IsTrue(detail.TryGetNextFlight(out var next));
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipLv2, next.PayloadItemId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 今の便が選んだ積荷と同じか無ければ次の便を出さない()
        {
            Assert.IsFalse(Pad(ChipLv1, ChipLv1, ChipLv1).TryGetNextFlight(out _));
            var idle = Pad(ChipLv1, null, ChipLv1);
            Assert.IsFalse(idle.TryGetNextFlight(out _));
            Assert.IsTrue(idle.TryGetHeadline(out var headline));
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipLv1, headline.PayloadItemId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 古いセーブで未選択のまま今の便があれば見出しは今の便で一覧も出す()
        {
            // 選択の項目が無いセーブは未選択で読まれ、積み終えた便だけが残る（A の判断）
            // A save without the selection loads as unselected while the loaded flight remains (server draft A)
            var detail = Pad(null, ChipLv1, ChipLv1);
            Assert.IsFalse(detail.IsSelected);
            Assert.IsTrue(detail.TryGetHeadline(out var headline));
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipLv1, headline.PayloadItemId);
            Assert.IsFalse(detail.TryGetNextFlight(out _));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Linq;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.Machine;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Core.Master;
using NUnit.Framework;
using static Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo.OrbitalCargoSamples;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    public class OrbitalCargoSlotBindingTest
    {
        // 資材 2 枠（0・1）と積荷 3 枠（2=Lv1・3=Lv2・4=ケーブル）
        // Two material slots (0, 1) and three payload slots (2=Lv1, 3=Lv2, 4=cable)
        private static readonly RequiredItemSlot[] Materials = { new(0, new ItemId(5), 20), new(1, new ItemId(6), 5) };
        private static readonly RequiredItemSlot[] Payloads = { new(2, ChipLv1, 20), new(3, ChipLv2, 20), new(4, Cable, 1000) };

        [Test]
        public void 未選択の発射台はShiftで何も受けない()
        {
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.PadShiftBindings(Materials, Payloads, Pad(null, null)));
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.ElevatorShiftBindings(0, null));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 選んだ発射台は資材と選んだ積荷の枠だけをShiftで受ける()
        {
            var bindings = OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.PadShiftBindings(Materials, Payloads, Pad(ChipLv2, null));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { 0, 1, 3 }, bindings.Select(b => b.Slot).ToArray());
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { ChipLv2 }, bindings[2].AcceptedItemIds.ToArray());
            var elevator = OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.ElevatorShiftBindings(0, ChipLv1).Single();
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { ChipLv1 }, elevator.AcceptedItemIds.ToArray());
        }

        [Test]
        public void 積荷の枠は選んだ枠を透かしつきで先に並べ前の種類の残りを後ろに並べる()
        {
            var slots = new[] { Empty(), Empty(), Empty(), new SlotItem(ChipLv2, 0), new SlotItem(Cable, 300) };
            var bound = OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.Payloads(Payloads, Pad(ChipLv1, null), slots);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { 2, 4 }, bound.Select(b => b.Index).ToArray(), "空の Lv2 の枠は出さず、ケーブルの残りは出す");
            var ghost = ((GhostedItemSlot)bound[0]).Ghost;
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipLv1, ghost.ItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(20, ghost.Count);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<PlainItemSlot>(bound[1]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 資材の枠は必要な数の透かしを持ち拠点の入口は選ぶまで透かしを持たない()
        {
            var materials = OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.Materials(Materials);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, ((GhostedItemSlot)materials[1]).Ghost.Count);
            var unselected = new OrbitalCargoDetail(null, null, new[] { ChipLv1Choice }, new[] { ChipLv1 }, 240);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<PlainItemSlot>(OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.Inlet(0, unselected).Single());
            var selected = new OrbitalCargoDetail(ChipLv1, null, new[] { ChipLv1Choice }, new[] { ChipLv1 }, 240);
            Assert.AreEqual(20, ((GhostedItemSlot)OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.Inlet(0, selected).Single()).Ghost.Count);
        }

        private static SlotItem Empty() => new(ItemMaster.EmptyItemId, 0);
    }
}
```

（`PlainItemSlot`・`GhostedItemSlot` は `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/Machine/MachineSlotView.cs`、`InletSlotBinding.Slot`/`AcceptedItemIds` は `Logic/SlotRestriction/BlockSlotRestrictionInput.cs` にある public の型・プロパティ。下書きを書いた時点で確かめた。）

```csharp
            // Selecting the same kind is a no-op success on the server (A), so the state already matches
            var state = new OrbitalCargoSelectionModeState();
            state.OpenSelection();
            state.RememberRequest(ChipLv1);
            Assert.IsFalse(state.ResolveShowsSelection(Pad(ChipLv1, null, ChipLv1)));
        }
    }
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Core.Master;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 1 種類の積荷の 1 便。成果は出力のアイテムとケーブルプールへ足す本数で、サーバーは両者を別々に処理するので両方を持つこともある
    /// One flight of one cargo kind; the outcome is output items and cables added to the pool, which the server applies independently, so a kind may have both
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoChoice
    {
        public ItemId PayloadItemId { get; }
        public int CountPerLaunch { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<ItemAmount> ArrivalOutputs { get; }
        // ケーブルプールへ足す種類なら 1 便の数だけ増える（ArrivalOutputs とは独立）
        // A pool-adding kind raises the cable pool by its per-flight count (independent of ArrivalOutputs)
        public bool AddsToCablePool { get; }

        public OrbitalCargoChoice(ItemId payloadItemId, int countPerLaunch, IReadOnlyList<ItemAmount> arrivalOutputs, bool addsToCablePool)
        {
            PayloadItemId = payloadItemId;
            CountPerLaunch = countPerLaunch;
            ArrivalOutputs = arrivalOutputs;
            AddsToCablePool = addsToCablePool;
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoCatalog.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// ブロックが運ぶ種類から、積荷表（マスタ）の 1 便と成果で選択肢を組む
    /// Builds the choices from the kinds a block carries, using the payload table's per-flight count and outcome
    /// </summary>
    public static class OrbitalCargoCatalog
    {
        public static IReadOnlyList<OrbitalCargoChoice> ForCarried(IReadOnlyList<ItemId> carriedPayloadItemIds)
        {
            var choices = new List<OrbitalCargoChoice>(carriedPayloadItemIds.Count);
            foreach (var payloadItemId in carriedPayloadItemIds) choices.Add(Create(payloadItemId));
            return choices;

            #region Internal

            OrbitalCargoChoice Create(ItemId payloadItemId)
            {
                // 運ぶ種類は積荷表から決まるので必ず引ける。引けなければマスタの矛盾として止める
                // Carried kinds come from the payload table, so the lookup succeeds; a miss is a master contradiction and stops here
                var payloadGuid = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemGuid(payloadItemId);
                var entry = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.OrbitalPayloads.FirstOrDefault(payload => payload.PayloadItemGuid == payloadGuid);
                if (entry == null) throw new InvalidOperationException($"積荷表に無い種類をブロックが運ぶと定義されています payload={payloadGuid}");
                var outputs = entry.ArrivalOutputs.Select(output => new ItemAmount(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(output.ItemGuid), output.Count)).ToList();
                return new OrbitalCargoChoice(payloadItemId, entry.CountPerLaunch, outputs, SpaceElevatorCableItems.Contains(payloadItemId));
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoDetail.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Master;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 発射台・拠点の積荷の選択。選んだ積荷・今の便の積荷・選べる一覧と、見出しと「次の便から」の判定（ADR 0106）
    /// Cargo selection of a launch pad or elevator base: selected cargo, current flight, selectable list, and the headline / next-flight decisions (ADR 0106)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoDetail
    {
        public ItemId? SelectedCargoItemId { get; }
        // 今の便（発射台は積み終えたロケット、拠点は昇降中の便）。無ければ null
        // The current flight (the loaded rocket on a pad, the climbing flight on a base); null when none
        public ItemId? CurrentFlightCargoItemId { get; }
        // 一覧に出す種類（運ぶ種類のうち解放済み。運ぶ順のまま）
        // Kinds listed for selection (carried and unlocked, in carried order)
        public IReadOnlyList<OrbitalCargoChoice> SelectableChoices { get; }
        // 一覧の行に出す 1 便の所要秒（発射台は建造、拠点は昇降）
        // Seconds per flight on list rows (build time on a pad, climb time on a base)
        public double FlightSeconds { get; }
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<OrbitalCargoChoice> _carriedChoices;

        public bool IsSelected => SelectedCargoItemId.HasValue;

        public OrbitalCargoDetail(ItemId? selectedCargoItemId, ItemId? currentFlightCargoItemId, IReadOnlyList<OrbitalCargoChoice> carriedChoices, IReadOnlyCollection<ItemId> unlockedPayloadItemIds, double flightSeconds)
        {
            SelectedCargoItemId = selectedCargoItemId;
            CurrentFlightCargoItemId = currentFlightCargoItemId;
            _carriedChoices = carriedChoices;
            SelectableChoices = carriedChoices.Where(choice => unlockedPayloadItemIds.Contains(choice.PayloadItemId)).ToList();
            FlightSeconds = flightSeconds;
        }

        // 見出しは今の便があればそれ、無ければ選んだ積荷（ADR 0106 の 4「画面は今の便の積荷と成果を出す」）
        // The headline is the current flight when there is one, otherwise the selection (ADR 0106 §4)
        public bool TryGetHeadline(out OrbitalCargoChoice choice)
        {
            return TryGetCarried(CurrentFlightCargoItemId ?? SelectedCargoItemId, out choice);
        }

        // 今の便と選んだ積荷が両方あって違うときだけ「次の便から」を出す
        // Show "from the next flight" only when both the current flight and the selection exist and differ
        public bool TryGetNextFlight(out OrbitalCargoChoice choice)
        {
            choice = null;
            if (!CurrentFlightCargoItemId.HasValue || !IsSelected) return false;
            if (IsSelectedChoice(CurrentFlightCargoItemId.Value)) return false;
            return TryGetCarried(SelectedCargoItemId, out choice);
        }

        public bool TryGetSelected(out OrbitalCargoChoice choice)
        {
            return TryGetCarried(SelectedCargoItemId, out choice);
        }

        public bool IsSelectedChoice(ItemId payloadItemId)
        {
            return SelectedCargoItemId.HasValue && SelectedCargoItemId.Value == payloadItemId;
        }

        private bool TryGetCarried(ItemId? payloadItemId, out OrbitalCargoChoice choice)
        {
            choice = null;
            if (!payloadItemId.HasValue) return false;
            foreach (var carried in _carriedChoices)
            {
                if (carried.PayloadItemId != payloadItemId.Value) continue;
                choice = carried;
                return true;
            }

            // サーバーは運ぶ種類しか選ばせないので、ここへ来るのは状態の食い違い。見出しを出さず開発者へ知らせる
            // The server only accepts carried kinds, so reaching here is a state mismatch; omit the headline and tell the developer
            Debug.LogError($"[OrbitalCargoDetail] ブロックが運ばない積荷が状態に入っています payload={payloadItemId.Value.AsPrimitive()}");
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.Machine;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.SlotRestriction;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Core.Master;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の選択から、透かしつきの枠の並びと Shift の束縛を組む（未選択は何も受けない。ADR 0106 の 2）
    /// Builds the ghosted slot order and the Shift bindings from the cargo selection (unselected accepts nothing; ADR 0106 §2)
    /// </summary>
    public static class OrbitalCargoSlotBinding
    {
        // 資材の枠は全部、入れる品と必要な数の透かしを持つ（本文に出るのは選んだ後だけ）
        // Every material slot carries a ghost of its item and required count (the body shows them only after selecting)
        public static IReadOnlyList<BoundItemSlot> Materials(IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> materialSlots)
        {
            var slots = new List<BoundItemSlot>(materialSlots.Count);
            foreach (var required in materialSlots) slots.Add(Ghosted(required));
            return slots;
        }

        // 選んだ積荷の枠を透かしつきで先に、続けて中身の残る他の積荷の枠（選び直しで返しきれなかった前の種類）を並べる
        // The selected payload slot with its ghost first, then other payload slots still holding items (leftovers a reselection could not refund)
        public static IReadOnlyList<BoundItemSlot> Payloads(IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> payloadSlots, OrbitalCargoDetail cargo, IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> itemSlots)
        {
            // 「選んだ種類か」の判定は OrbitalCargoDetail の 1 か所に寄せる
            // The "is it the selected kind" check lives only in OrbitalCargoDetail
            var slots = new List<BoundItemSlot>();
            foreach (var required in payloadSlots)
            {
                if (cargo.IsSelectedChoice(required.ItemId)) slots.Add(Ghosted(required));
            }
            foreach (var required in payloadSlots)
            {
                if (!cargo.IsSelectedChoice(required.ItemId) && OwnedItemCounts.IsOwnedSlot(itemSlots[required.Slot])) slots.Add(BoundItemSlot.WithoutGhost(required.Slot));
            }
            return slots;
        }

        // 拠点の入口は選んでいれば 1 便ぶんの透かし、未選択なら透かし無し（入口は 1 枠で、残りもこの枠に出る）
        // The base inlet carries one flight's ghost when selected and none otherwise (one inlet slot; leftovers show here too)
        public static IReadOnlyList<BoundItemSlot> Inlet(int inletSlot, OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            if (!cargo.TryGetSelected(out var selected)) return new[] { BoundItemSlot.WithoutGhost(inletSlot) };
            return new[] { BoundItemSlot.WithGhost(inletSlot, new MachineItemGhost(selected.PayloadItemId, selected.CountPerLaunch, new[] { selected.PayloadItemId })) };
        }

        // 発射台の Shift: 未選択は空（拒否が確定）、選べば資材の枠と選んだ積荷の枠だけ
        // Launch pad Shift: empty when unselected (a confirmed refusal); after selecting, only material slots and the selected payload slot
        public static IReadOnlyList<InletSlotBinding> PadShiftBindings(IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> materialSlots, IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> payloadSlots, OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            var bindings = new List<InletSlotBinding>();
            if (!cargo.IsSelected) return bindings;
            foreach (var required in materialSlots) bindings.Add(new InletSlotBinding(required.Slot, new[] { required.ItemId }));
            foreach (var required in payloadSlots)
            {
                if (cargo.IsSelectedChoice(required.ItemId)) bindings.Add(new InletSlotBinding(required.Slot, new[] { required.ItemId }));
            }
            return bindings;
        }

        // 拠点の Shift: 未選択は空、選べば入口に選んだ種類だけ
        // Elevator base Shift: empty when unselected; after selecting, only the selected kind on the inlet
        public static IReadOnlyList<InletSlotBinding> ElevatorShiftBindings(int inletSlot, ItemId? selected)
        {
            if (!selected.HasValue) return Array.Empty<InletSlotBinding>();
            return new[] { new InletSlotBinding(inletSlot, new[] { selected.Value }) };
        }

        private static BoundItemSlot Ghosted(RequiredItemSlot required)
        {
            return BoundItemSlot.WithGhost(required.Slot, new MachineItemGhost(required.ItemId, required.Count, new[] { required.ItemId }));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Network.API;
using Core.Master;
using Game.UnlockState;
using Server.Event.EventReceive;
using UniRx;
using VContainer.Unity;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 解放済みの積荷の集合。アイテムの解放イベントで作り直す（前例 UnlockedMachineRecipeSource と同じ契機）
    /// The set of unlocked cargo kinds, rebuilt on item unlock events (same trigger as UnlockedMachineRecipeSource)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class UnlockedOrbitalCargoSource : IUnlockedOrbitalCargoSource, IInitializable
    {
        private readonly IGameUnlockStateData _unlockState;
        private readonly IVanillaApiEvent _vanillaApiEvent;
        private readonly ReactiveProperty<IReadOnlyCollection<ItemId>> _unlocked = new(Array.Empty<ItemId>());

        public IReadOnlyReactiveProperty<IReadOnlyCollection<ItemId>> UnlockedPayloadItemIds => _unlocked;

        // 解放状態を ctor で受けるので、その購読（ClientGameUnlockStateData）が先に張られ更新後の表を読める
        // Taking the unlock state in the ctor makes its subscription (ClientGameUnlockStateData) register first, so the updated table is read
        public UnlockedOrbitalCargoSource(IGameUnlockStateData unlockState, IVanillaApiEvent vanillaApiEvent)
        {
            _unlockState = unlockState;
            _vanillaApiEvent = vanillaApiEvent;
        }

        public void Initialize()
        {
            Rebuild();
            _vanillaApiEvent.SubscribeEventResponse(UnlockedEventPacket.EventTag, _ => Rebuild());

            #region Internal

            void Rebuild()
            {
                // 積荷表の種類のうちアイテムが解放済みのもの（ADR 0106 の 3）
                // Payload-table kinds whose item is unlocked (ADR 0106 §3)
                var unlocked = new HashSet<ItemId>();
                foreach (var payload in MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.OrbitalPayloads)
                {
                    var itemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(payload.PayloadItemGuid);
                    if (_unlockState.ItemUnlockStateInfos[itemId].IsUnlocked) unlocked.Add(itemId);
                }
                _unlocked.Value = unlocked;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoSelectionModeState.cs`:

```csharp
using Core.Master;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の一覧を出すかの局所状態。本文の Presenter が持ち、作り直しと Detach で消える（前例 MachineSelectionModeState を MachineSectionPresenter が持つ形）
    /// Local state deciding whether the cargo list shows; the body presenter owns it and it resets on rebuild and Detach (as MachineSectionPresenter owns MachineSelectionModeState)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoSelectionModeState
    {
        private bool _selectionOpened;
        private bool _hasRequest;
        private ItemId _requestedPayloadItemId;

        public void OpenSelection()
        {
            _selectionOpened = true;
            _hasRequest = false;
        }

        public void RememberRequest(ItemId payloadItemId)
        {
            // 押した種類を要求として覚え、サーバーの選択が一致したら一覧を閉じる（拒否なら開いたまま）
            // Remember the pressed kind; close once the server's selection matches (a rejection keeps it open)
            _hasRequest = true;
            _requestedPayloadItemId = payloadItemId;
        }

        // 一覧を出すか。要求が届いたらここで閉じ、その後のほかの人の選び直しでは開き直さない
        // Whether the list shows; a fulfilled request closes it here so a later reselection by someone else does not reopen it
        public bool ResolveShowsSelection(OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            // 未選択は解放済みが 0 種類でも一覧（選んでから使う。ADR 0106 の 2・7）
            // Unselected always shows the list, even with zero unlocked kinds (select before use; ADR 0106 §2, §7)
            if (!cargo.IsSelected) return true;
            if (!_selectionOpened) return false;
            if (!_hasRequest || !cargo.IsSelectedChoice(_requestedPayloadItemId)) return true;
            _selectionOpened = false;
            _hasRequest = false;
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void 発射台は状態が届くまで出さず届けばマスタの枠の並びと選んだ積荷からの束縛を持つ()
        {
            var master = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.RocketLaunchPadId);
            var layout = new RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout((RocketLaunchPadBlockParam)master.BlockParam);
            var pending = _harness.CreateBlock(Vector3Int.zero, master);
            Assert.IsFalse(Read(pending).TryGetRocketLaunchPad(out _));

            // 未選択は Shift で何も受けず、選んだ後は資材と選んだ積荷の枠だけ（サーバーの受け入れと同じ）
            // Unselected accepts nothing on Shift; after selecting, only materials and the selected payload slot (same as the server)
            var unselected = _harness.CreateBlock(Vector3Int.zero, master, (RocketLaunchPadStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey, new RocketLaunchPadStateDetail(RocketLaunchPadPhase.Idle, RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.CargoNotSelected, 0f, null, null)));
            Assert.IsTrue(Read(unselected).TryGetRocketLaunchPad(out var unselectedPad));
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(unselectedPad.InletBindings);

            var payload = layout.RequirementAt(layout.PayloadSlots[0]).ItemId;
            var block = _harness.CreateBlock(Vector3Int.zero, master, (RocketLaunchPadStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey, new RocketLaunchPadStateDetail(RocketLaunchPadPhase.Building, RocketLaunchPadWaitReason.NoPower, 0.375f, payload, payload)));
            Assert.IsTrue(Read(block).TryGetRocketLaunchPad(out var pad));

            Assert.AreEqual(0.375f, pad.Progress);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(layout.MaterialSlots, pad.MaterialSlots.Select(slot => slot.Slot));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(layout.PayloadSlots, pad.PayloadSlots.Select(slot => slot.Slot));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(layout.OutputSlots, pad.OutputSlots(layout.TotalSlotCount));
            // 在庫の数が増えると出力の枠も伸びる
            // Output slots extend as the inventory grows
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(layout.OutputSlots.Concat(new[] { layout.TotalSlotCount }), pad.OutputSlots(layout.TotalSlotCount + 1));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(layout.MaterialSlots.Concat(new[] { layout.PayloadSlots[0] }), pad.InletBindings.Select(binding => binding.Slot));
            foreach (var binding in pad.InletBindings) CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { layout.RequirementAt(binding.Slot).ItemId }, binding.AcceptedItemIds);
            Assert.AreEqual(payload, pad.Cargo.SelectedCargoItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(payload, pad.Cargo.CurrentFlightCargoItemId);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 宇宙エレベーターは状態が届くまで出さず届けば出口数とケーブル数と選んだ積荷の束縛をマスタから引く()
        {
            var master = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.TestSpaceElevatorBase);
            var param = (SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam)master.BlockParam;
            var pending = _harness.CreateBlock(Vector3Int.zero, master);
            Assert.IsFalse(Read(pending).TryGetSpaceElevator(out _));

            var carried = param.CarriedPayloadItemGuids.Select(guid => MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(guid)).ToList();
            CollectionAssert.IsNotEmpty(carried, "テスト前提: 運ぶ積荷がマスタにあること");
            var block = _harness.CreateBlock(Vector3Int.zero, master, (SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey, new SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail(true, 250, 0.5f, SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.Climbing, carried[0], carried[0])));
            Assert.IsTrue(Read(block).TryGetSpaceElevator(out var elevator));

            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot }, elevator.SatelliteInputSlots);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(Enumerable.Range(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.FirstOutputSlot, param.OutputSlotCount), elevator.OutputSlots);
            Assert.AreEqual(param.CablesPerElevator, elevator.CablesPerElevator);
            Assert.AreEqual(250, elevator.CablePoolAmount);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, elevator.InletBindings.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot, elevator.InletBindings[0].Slot);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { carried[0] }, elevator.InletBindings[0].AcceptedItemIds);
            Assert.AreEqual(param.ClimbSeconds, elevator.Cargo.FlightSeconds, 0.001);
        }

        private static SpecialBlockDetailViewModel Read(Client.Game.InGame.Block.BlockGameObject block)
        {
            return SpecialBlockDetailReader.Read(block, new BlockNetworkInfoCache(), new BeltTransportClientCache(new BeltSegmentExitStatisticsTable()), Array.Empty<ItemId>(), out _);
        }
```

`RocketLaunchPadDetail.cs`（全体）:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.Machine;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.SlotRestriction;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.Special;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Details
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 発射台の詳細。資材・積荷の枠はサーバーの絶対添字と必要な品・数、出力は先頭から在庫の末尾まで、積荷の選択（ADR 0106）
    /// Launch pad detail: material and payload slots as absolute indices with required items and counts, outputs from the start to the inventory end, and the cargo selection (ADR 0106)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class RocketLaunchPadDetail
    {
        internal RocketLaunchPadPhase Phase { get; }
        internal RocketLaunchPadWaitReason WaitReason { get; }
        public float Progress { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> MaterialSlots { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> PayloadSlots { get; }
        // 未選択は空、選べば資材と選んだ積荷の枠だけを受ける Shift の束縛
        // Shift bindings: empty when unselected, otherwise only material slots and the selected payload slot
        public IReadOnlyList<InletSlotBinding> InletBindings { get; }
        public OrbitalCargoDetail Cargo { get; }
        private int OutputSlotStart { get; }

        public RocketLaunchPadDetail(RocketLaunchPadPhase phase, RocketLaunchPadWaitReason waitReason, float progress, IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> materialSlots, IReadOnlyList<RequiredItemSlot> payloadSlots, IReadOnlyList<InletSlotBinding> inletBindings, int outputSlotStart, OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            Phase = phase;
            WaitReason = waitReason;
            Progress = progress;
            MaterialSlots = materialSlots;
            PayloadSlots = payloadSlots;
            InletBindings = inletBindings;
            OutputSlotStart = outputSlotStart;
            Cargo = cargo;
        }

        // 状態文と題の操作は State で引き、Screens へサーバーの列挙を出さない（D-27）
        // Resolve the status text and title action in State so Screens never sees the server enums (D-27)
        public LocalizationKey StatusKey => RocketLaunchPadLogic.StatusKey(Phase, WaitReason);

        // 資材の枠（透かしつき）と、選んだ積荷の枠＋前の種類の残り
        // Material slots (ghosted) and the selected payload slot plus leftovers of previous kinds
        public IReadOnlyList<BoundItemSlot> MaterialBoundSlots => OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.Materials(MaterialSlots);

        public IReadOnlyList<BoundItemSlot> PayloadBoundSlots(IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> itemSlots)
        {
            return OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.Payloads(PayloadSlots, Cargo, itemSlots);
        }

        public bool TryGetCommandButton(out RocketCommandButton button)
        {
            return RocketLaunchPadLogic.TryGetCommandButton(Phase, out button);
        }

        // 出力の枠（在庫の数が先頭に届かなければ空）
        // Output slots; empty when the inventory does not reach the start
        public IReadOnlyList<int> OutputSlots(int itemSlotCount)
        {
            var slots = new List<int>();
            for (var slot = OutputSlotStart; slot < itemSlotCount; slot++) slots.Add(slot);
            return slots;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.Machine;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.SlotRestriction;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.Special;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Details
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 宇宙エレベーターの詳細。入口・出口は配られた順のままサーバーの絶対添字、積荷の選択（ADR 0106 の 7）
    /// Space elevator detail; inlet and outlets keep the published order as absolute server indices, plus the cargo selection (ADR 0106 §7)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class SpaceElevatorDetail
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<int> SatelliteInputSlots { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<int> OutputSlots { get; }
        // 未選択は空、選べば入口に選んだ種類だけを受ける Shift の束縛
        // Shift bindings: empty when unselected, otherwise only the selected kind on the inlet
        public IReadOnlyList<InletSlotBinding> InletBindings { get; }
        public bool Connected { get; }
        public int CablePoolAmount { get; }
        public int CablesPerElevator { get; }
        public float ClimbProgress { get; }

        internal SpaceElevatorBaseStatus Status { get; }

        // Status text, shortage tone and connectability are decided in State (no server enums reach Screens. D-27)
        public SpaceElevatorStatusDisplay StatusDisplay => SpaceElevatorLogic.StatusDisplay(Status);
        public bool CanConnect => Status == SpaceElevatorBaseStatus.ReadyToConnect;
        // 入口の枠（選んでいれば 1 便ぶんの透かし）
        // The inlet slot, ghosted with one flight when selected
        public IReadOnlyList<BoundItemSlot> InletBoundSlots => OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.Inlet(SatelliteInputSlots[0], Cargo);

        public SpaceElevatorDetail(IReadOnlyList<int> satelliteInputSlots, IReadOnlyList<int> outputSlots, IReadOnlyList<InletSlotBinding> inletBindings, bool connected, int cablePoolAmount, int cablesPerElevator, float climbProgress, SpaceElevatorBaseStatus status, OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            SatelliteInputSlots = satelliteInputSlots;
            OutputSlots = outputSlots;
            InletBindings = inletBindings;
            Connected = connected;
            CablePoolAmount = cablePoolAmount;
            CablesPerElevator = cablesPerElevator;
            ClimbProgress = climbProgress;
            Status = status;
            Cargo = cargo;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
            RocketLaunchPadDetail ReadRocketLaunchPad()
            {
                if (param is not RocketLaunchPadBlockParam rocketParam) return null;
                var state = block.GetStateDetail<RocketLaunchPadStateDetail>(RocketLaunchPadStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey);
                // silent-ok: 状態の初回到着待ちは本文が「状態の取得を待っています」を出す / 録画（R-12）の発射台の段で気づく
                if (state == null) return null;
                var layout = new RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout(rocketParam);
                var materials = layout.MaterialSlots.Select(slot => Required(layout, slot)).ToList();
                var payloads = layout.PayloadSlots.Select(slot => Required(layout, slot)).ToList();
                // 一覧は積荷の枠の種類（積荷表の全種類）から、今の便は積み終えたロケットの積荷
                // The list comes from the payload slots' kinds (the whole payload table); the current flight is the loaded rocket's cargo
                var carried = OrbitalCargoCatalog.ForCarried(payloads.Select(payload => payload.ItemId).ToList());
                var cargo = new OrbitalCargoDetail(state.SelectedCargoItemId, state.LoadedCargoItemId, carried, unlockedPayloadItemIds, rocketParam.BuildSeconds);
                var inletBindings = OrbitalCargoSlotBinding.PadShiftBindings(materials, payloads, cargo);
                return SpecialStateDetailReader.RocketLaunchPad(state, materials, payloads, inletBindings, layout.OutputSlotStart, cargo);
            }

            RequiredItemSlot Required(RocketLaunchPadSlotLayout layout, int slot)
            {
                var requirement = layout.RequirementAt(slot);
                return new RequiredItemSlot(slot, requirement.ItemId, requirement.Count);
            }

            SpaceElevatorDetail ReadSpaceElevator()
            {
                if (param is not SpaceElevatorBaseBlockParam elevatorParam) return null;
                var state = block.GetStateDetail<SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail>(SpaceElevatorBaseStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey);
                // silent-ok: 状態の初回到着待ちは区画が取得待ちを出す / 録画（R-12）の宇宙エレベーターの段で気づく
                if (state == null) return null;
                // 一覧は拠点が運ぶ種類から、今の便は昇降中の便の積荷
                // The list comes from the kinds the base carries; the current flight is the climbing flight's cargo
                var carried = OrbitalCargoCatalog.ForCarried(SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.GetCarriedPayloadItemIds(elevatorParam));
                var cargo = new OrbitalCargoDetail(state.SelectedCargoItemId, state.ClimbingCargoItemId, carried, unlockedPayloadItemIds, elevatorParam.ClimbSeconds);
                return SpecialStateDetailReader.SpaceElevator(state, SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.SatelliteSlot, SpaceElevatorBaseInventoryComponent.FirstOutputSlot, elevatorParam.OutputSlotCount, elevatorParam.CablesPerElevator, cargo);
            }
```

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void 積荷の選択の拒否はどの理由も専用のコードを持つ失敗になる()
        {
            foreach (CargoFailure reason in Enum.GetValues(typeof(CargoFailure)))
            {
                // None は成功応答のみなので除外
                // None only appears on success, so it is excluded
                if (reason == CargoFailure.None) continue;
                var outcome = SpecialBlockResponseCodes.FromCargoSelectionFailure(reason);
                StringAssert.StartsWith("cargo_select_", outcome.WireCode, reason.ToString());
                Assert.AreEqual(SpecialBlockRequestOutcomeKind.Failed, outcome.Kind, reason.ToString());
            }
            Assert.AreEqual("cargo_select_locked", SpecialBlockResponseCodes.FromCargoSelectionFailure(CargoFailure.Locked).WireCode);
        }
```

```csharp
        public void SelectOrbitalCargo(ItemId payloadItemId)
        {
            ReportWhenDone(SelectOrbitalCargoCommandName, Send()).Forget();

            #region Internal

            async UniTask<UiCommandResult> Send()
            {
                // 積荷を選べるのは発射台と拠点だけ。開いているのが拠点なら拠点、ほかは発射台として種別を確かめる
                // Only launch pads and elevator bases select cargo; check against the base when a base is open, otherwise against the pad
                var expected = _panels.Current.Value is OpenBlockInventoryPanel { BlockType: BlockMasterElement.BlockTypeConst.SpaceElevatorBase }
                    ? BlockMasterElement.BlockTypeConst.SpaceElevatorBase
                    : BlockMasterElement.BlockTypeConst.RocketLaunchPad;
                if (!TryOpen(expected, out var block, out var rejected)) return rejected;
                return ToResult(await _sender.SelectOrbitalCargo(block.Position, block.BlockInstanceId, payloadItemId));
            }

            #endregion
        }
```

`SpecialBlockResponseCodes.cs`（`using CargoFailure = Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.OrbitalCargoSelectionProtocol.OrbitalCargoSelectionFailureReason;` を足す）の末尾に:

```csharp
        // 積荷の選択の拒否はどれも失敗（選び直せば通る種類ではなく、画面の一覧と状態の食い違いか未解放）
        // Every cargo selection refusal is a failure (a mismatch between the list and the state, or a locked kind)
        public static SpecialBlockRequestOutcome FromCargoSelectionFailure(CargoFailure reason)
        {
            return reason switch
            {
                CargoFailure.InvalidRequest => SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Failed("cargo_select_invalid_request"),
                CargoFailure.BlockNotFound => SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Failed("cargo_select_block_not_found"),
                CargoFailure.InstanceMismatch => SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Failed("cargo_select_instance_mismatch"),
                CargoFailure.NotCargoSelector => SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Failed("cargo_select_not_cargo_selector"),
                CargoFailure.NotCarriedHere => SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Failed("cargo_select_not_carried_here"),
                CargoFailure.Locked => SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Failed("cargo_select_locked"),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(reason), reason, "未知の積荷の選択の拒否理由"),
            };
        }
```

```csharp
        public async UniTask<SpecialBlockRequestOutcome> SelectOrbitalCargo(Vector3Int position, BlockInstanceId instanceId, ItemId payloadItemId)
        {
            var (response, reason) = await ClientContext.VanillaApi.Response.Block.SendOrbitalCargoSelection(position, payloadItemId, instanceId, CancellationToken.None);
            if (reason != PacketWaitCompletionReason.Received) return SpecialBlockResponseCodes.FromWait(reason, "cargo_select_timeout", "cargo_select_invalid_response");
            if (response == null) return SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Failed("cargo_select_invalid_response");
            return response.Success ? SpecialBlockRequestOutcome.Accepted : SpecialBlockResponseCodes.FromCargoSelectionFailure(response.FailureReason);
        }
```

### Task B5: 積荷の共通の画面部品（一覧・行・見出し・出し分け・透かしの格子）

発射台と拠点が同じ部品を使う。並びと見た目は機械のレシピ選択（`MachineRecipeSelectionList`・`MachineRecipeSelectionRowView`・`SelectedRecipeHeader`・`MachineSectionView` の出し分け）に合わせる。機械のレシピ専用の型（`MachineRecipeSelectionRow`・`MachineRecipeData`・`IMachineRecipeSelectCommand`）は使わない。使うのは、機械用の名前を持つが中身が「枠と透かし」だけの `BoundItemSlot`・`MachineItemGhost`・`MachineSlotContents.For`（判断 4）。

この Task の部品はどれも View で、一覧の局所状態を持たない。`OrbitalCargoPane` は「一覧を出すか」を `Render(cargo, listStatus, showsSelection)` の引数で受け、行・見出しの押下を UniRx の Subject で出すだけにする（前例 `MachineSectionView.Render(viewModel, showsSelection)`・`OnRecipeRowPressed`・`OnChangeRecipeRequested`）。局所状態を持って押下で進めるのは B6 の `OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter`（前例 `MachineSectionPresenter`）。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Client.Tests.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Support;
using Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Core.Master;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;
using static Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo.OrbitalCargoSamples;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の一覧と選んだ後の見出しの View（ADR 0106 の 1・3・4）。一覧を出すかは引数で受け、押下はコマンドと Subject へ出す。モードの進み方は OrbitalCargoBodyPresenterTest が見る
    /// The cargo list and selected-headline view (ADR 0106 §1, §3, §4); the mode comes as an argument and presses go to the command and Subjects; OrbitalCargoBodyPresenterTest covers mode transitions
    /// </summary>
    public class OrbitalCargoPaneViewTest : SpecialScreenTestHost
    {
        private const string Prefix = "rocket-launch-pad";
        private static readonly UiText Status = UiText.FromVerbatim("status");

        [Test]
        public void 一覧を出すときは一覧だけを置き解放済みの行を運ぶ順で並べる()
        {
            var (pane, content) = Render(Pad(null, null, Cable, ChipLv1), true);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-1", $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-3" }, RowIds(pane));
            Assert.IsNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>($"{Prefix}-cargo-header"), "見出しと選んだ後の中身は木に置かない");
            Assert.IsNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>(content.name));
            Assert.AreEqual("status", TextOf(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-status"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 行の文は積むものと返るものの対でケーブルは成果の枠を持たずプールの増分を書く()
        {
            var (pane, _) = Render(Pad(null, null, ChipLv2, Cable), true);
            Assert.AreEqual(Resolved(OrbitalCargoNames.Row(ChipLv2Choice, LoadContent())), TextOf(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-2-name"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>($"{Prefix}-cargo-row-2-output-0"));
            StringAssert.Contains("+1000", TextOf(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-3-name"));
            Assert.IsNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>($"{Prefix}-cargo-row-3-output-0"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void プールへ足し出力も出す積荷の行は文に両方を書き成果の枠も並べる()
        {
            // サーバーはプールへの加算と出力を別々に処理するので、両方を持つ積荷もマスタに書ける（判断 21）
            // The server applies the pool and the outputs independently, so the master may give a kind both (decision 21)
            var both = new OrbitalCargoChoice(Cable, 1000, new[] { new ItemAmount(ComputeData, 7) }, true);
            var (pane, _) = Render(new OrbitalCargoDetail(null, null, new[] { both }, new[] { Cable }, 120), true);
            var text = TextOf(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-3-name");
            StringAssert.Contains("+1000", text);
            StringAssert.Contains(LoadContent().ItemName(ComputeData).Resolve(), text);
            StringAssert.Contains("×7", text);
            Assert.IsNotNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>($"{Prefix}-cargo-row-3-output-0"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 行を押すと選ぶコマンドを送り押した種類を出すが自分ではモードを変えない()
        {
            var (pane, _) = Render(Pad(null, null, ChipLv1, ChipLv2), true);
            var pressed = new List<ItemId>();
            pane.OnRowPressed.Subscribe(pressed.Add);
            simulate.Click(Find<VisualElement>(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-2"));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "orbital_cargo.select 2" }, Commands.Issued);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { ChipLv2 }, pressed);
            Assert.IsNotNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>($"{Prefix}-cargo-list"), "一覧を閉じるのは Presenter の描き直し");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 一覧を出さないときは見出しと中身を置き見出しを押すと一覧を求める()
        {
            var (pane, content) = Render(Pad(ChipLv2, null, ChipLv1, ChipLv2), false);
            Assert.IsNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>($"{Prefix}-cargo-list"));
            Assert.AreEqual(Resolved(OrbitalCargoNames.Row(ChipLv2Choice, LoadContent())), TextOf(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-header-name"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>(content.name));
            Assert.IsFalse(IsShown(Find<VisualElement>(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-next-flight")));

            var requested = 0;
            pane.OnChangeCargoRequested.Subscribe(_ => requested++);
            simulate.Click(Find<VisualElement>(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-header"));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, requested);
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(Commands.Issued, "見出しの押下はコマンドを送らない");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 選んだ後に一覧を出すと今の種類の行に印が付く()
        {
            var (pane, _) = Render(Pad(ChipLv1, null, ChipLv1, ChipLv2), true);
            Assert.IsTrue(Find<VisualElement>(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-1").ClassListContains(OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView.SelectedClassName));
            Assert.IsFalse(Find<VisualElement>(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-row-2").ClassListContains(OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView.SelectedClassName));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 便の途中で選び直すと見出しは今の便で下に次の便から一行を出す()
        {
            var (pane, _) = Render(Pad(ChipLv2, ChipLv1, ChipLv1, ChipLv2), false);
            Assert.AreEqual(Resolved(OrbitalCargoNames.Row(ChipLv1Choice, LoadContent())), TextOf(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-header-name"));
            Assert.IsTrue(IsShown(Find<VisualElement>(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-next-flight")));
            Assert.AreEqual(Resolved(OrbitalCargoNames.NextFlight(ChipLv2Choice, LoadContent())), TextOf(pane, $"{Prefix}-cargo-next-flight"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 解放済みが無くても一覧を出すときは空の一覧を置く()
        {
            var (pane, _) = Render(Pad(null, null), true);
            Assert.IsNotNull(pane.Q<VisualElement>($"{Prefix}-cargo-list"));
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(RowIds(pane));
        }

        private (OrbitalCargoPane pane, VisualElement content) Render(OrbitalCargoDetail cargo, bool showsSelection)
        {
            var content = new VisualElement { name = "selected-content" };
            var pane = Mount(new OrbitalCargoPane(Prefix, Kit(LoadContent()), content, false));
            pane.Render(cargo, Status, showsSelection);
            simulate.FrameUpdate();
            return (pane, content);
        }

        private static string[] RowIds(VisualElement root)
        {
            return root.Query<OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView>().ToList().Select(row => row.name).ToArray();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        public void Render(IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> itemSlots, IReadOnlyList<int> slotIndices)
        {
            var contents = new List<ItemSlotContent>(slotIndices.Count);
            foreach (var index in slotIndices) contents.Add(SlotItemContent.From(_content, BlockSlotIndexReader.Read(itemSlots, index, nameof(BlockItemGrid), _testId), false));
            RenderContents(slotIndices, contents);
        }

        // 中身を呼び手が組む枠（透かし・所持/必要つき）。contents は slotIndices と同じ並び
        // Slots whose content the caller builds (ghosts, held/required); contents follow slotIndices
        public void RenderContents(IReadOnlyList<int> slotIndices, IReadOnlyList<ItemSlotContent> contents)
        {
            // 並ぶ枠の番号が変わったときだけ作り直し、同じなら中身だけ差し替える
            // Rebuild only when the slot indices change; otherwise just swap contents
            if (_slots.ClearIfKeysChanged(slotIndices)) Rebuild(slotIndices);
            for (var i = 0; i < _slots.Count; i++) _slots.RowAt(i).SetContent(contents[i]);
            ApplyColumns();

            #region Internal

            void Rebuild(IReadOnlyList<int> indices)
            {
                _grid.ClearItems();
                foreach (var index in indices)
                {
                    var slot = new ItemSlot($"{_testId}-slot-{index}");
                    var capturedIndex = index;
                    slot.OnSlotGestured.Subscribe(gesture => BlockSlotGestureCommands.Run(_commands, capturedIndex, gesture));
                    _grid.AddItem(slot);
                    _slots.Add(index, slot);
                }
            }

            #endregion
        }
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.Components.Slots;
using Client.Ui.Content;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Machine.Slots;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Parts;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.Machine;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 透かしと所持/必要つきの枠を格子へ流す（見せ方は機械の枠と同じ。前例 MachineSlotContents）
    /// Pushes ghosted, held/required slots into a grid (same presentation as machine slots; precedent MachineSlotContents)
    /// </summary>
    public static class OrbitalCargoSlotContents
    {
        public static void Render(BlockItemGrid grid, string gridTestId, IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> itemSlots, IReadOnlyList<BoundItemSlot> boundSlots, GameContentPresentation content)
        {
            var indices = new List<int>(boundSlots.Count);
            var contents = new List<ItemSlotContent>(boundSlots.Count);
            foreach (var bound in boundSlots)
            {
                indices.Add(bound.Index);
                contents.Add(MachineSlotContents.For(BlockSlotIndexReader.Read(itemSlots, bound.Index, nameof(OrbitalCargoSlotContents), gridTestId), bound, true, content));
            }
            grid.RenderContents(indices, contents);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using Client.Localization;
using Client.Ui.Content;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の文。「ICチップLv2 ×20 → 計算データ ×40」「グラフェンケーブル ×1000 → ケーブルプール +1000」（ADR 0106 の 1）
    /// Cargo text: "IC chip Lv2 ×20 → Compute data ×40", "Graphene cable ×1000 → Cable pool +1000" (ADR 0106 §1)
    /// </summary>
    public static class OrbitalCargoNames
    {
        public static UiText Row(OrbitalCargoChoice choice, GameContentPresentation content)
        {
            return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.OrbitalCargoRow, new[]
            {
                new LocalizationTextParam("payload", content.ItemName(choice.PayloadItemId).Resolve()),
                new LocalizationTextParam("count", Count(choice.CountPerLaunch)),
                new LocalizationTextParam("outcome", Outcome(choice, content).Resolve()),
            });
        }

        public static UiText NextFlight(OrbitalCargoChoice choice, GameContentPresentation content)
        {
            return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.OrbitalCargoNextFlight, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("cargo", Row(choice, content).Resolve()) });
        }

        // プールへ足す種類は 1 便の効果を先に書き（今の数は拠点の画面で見る。ADR 0106 の 1）、続けて出力の品と数を書く。サーバーは両者を別々に処理するので両方あれば両方
        // Pool-adding kinds state one flight's effect first (the current pool is on the base screen; ADR 0106 §1), then output items and counts; both when both, as the server applies them independently
        private static UiText Outcome(OrbitalCargoChoice choice, GameContentPresentation content)
        {
            var parts = new List<UiText>(choice.ArrivalOutputs.Count + 1);
            if (choice.AddsToCablePool) parts.Add(new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.OrbitalCargoOutcomeCablePool, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("count", Count(choice.CountPerLaunch)) }));
            foreach (var output in choice.ArrivalOutputs)
            {
                parts.Add(new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.OrbitalCargoOutcomeItem, new[]
                {
                    new LocalizationTextParam("item", content.ItemName(output.ItemId).Resolve()),
                    new LocalizationTextParam("count", Count(output.Count)),
                }));
            }
            return UiText.Join(", ", parts);
        }

        private static string Count(int count)
        {
            return count.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
    }
}
```

（`LocalizationTextParam` の名前空間は実装前に `grep -rn "struct LocalizationTextParam"` で確かめ、`using` を合わせる。前例 `MachineRecipeNames.cs` の using をそのまま写すのが早い。）
