```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.Components.Recipe;
using Client.Ui.Components.Slots;
using Client.Ui.Content;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Input.OsCursor;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Text;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Recipe.Logic;
using Core.Master;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の一覧の 1 行: 積むものと返るものの文、積荷 → 1 便の秒 → 成果の RecipeRow、選択中の外周（前例 MachineRecipeSelectionRowView）
    /// One cargo row: the up/back text, a payload → seconds → outcome RecipeRow and the selected outline (precedent MachineRecipeSelectionRowView)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView : VisualElement
    {
        public const string SelectedClassName = "orbital-cargo-row--selected";

        private readonly Subject<ItemId> _pressed = new();

        public IObservable<ItemId> OnPressed => _pressed;

        public OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView(string rowId, OrbitalCargoChoice choice, double flightSeconds, GameContentPresentation content, IUiOsCursor osCursor)
        {
            name = rowId;
            AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-row");

            // 文 → 静止矢印の行（枠の押下は購読せず、行が押す対象）
            // Text → idle-arrow row; slot presses are not subscribed, the row is the press target
            var title = new LocalizedLabel { name = $"{rowId}-name", pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore };
            title.AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-row__name");
            title.SetText(OrbitalCargoNames.Row(choice, content));
            Add(title);
            var recipeRow = new RecipeRow($"{rowId}-row", $"{rowId}-arrow", RecipeDurationText.Create(flightSeconds));
            recipeRow.SetSlots(new[] { Slot($"{rowId}-payload", choice.PayloadItemId, choice.CountPerLaunch) }, Outputs());
            recipeRow.SetIdle();
            Add(recipeRow);

            // 選択中の外周は絶対配置の枠で描く
            // The selected outline is an absolute, non-picking frame
            var outline = new VisualElement { pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore };
            outline.AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-row__outline");
            Add(outline);
            RegisterCallback<ClickEvent>(_ => _pressed.OnNext(choice.PayloadItemId));
            osCursor.CreateHoverRequest(this, UiOsCursorShape.Pointer, UiOsCursorLayer.Element);

            #region Internal

            // 右は出力の品を全部並べる。プールへ足すだけの種類は右が空で、文が「ケーブルプール +1000」を語る
            // The right lists every output item; a pool-only kind leaves it empty and the text says "Cable pool +1000"
            IReadOnlyList<VisualElement> Outputs()
            {
                var slots = new List<VisualElement>(choice.ArrivalOutputs.Count);
                for (var i = 0; i < choice.ArrivalOutputs.Count; i++) slots.Add(Slot($"{rowId}-output-{i}", choice.ArrivalOutputs[i].ItemId, choice.ArrivalOutputs[i].Count));
                return slots;
            }

            VisualElement Slot(string testid, ItemId itemId, int count)
            {
                var slot = new ItemSlot(testid);
                slot.SetContent(SlotItemContent.ForItem(content, itemId, count));
                return slot;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        public void SetSelected(bool selected)
        {
            EnableInClassList(SelectedClassName, selected);
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoSelectionList.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.Components.Controls;
using Client.Ui.Content;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Input.OsCursor;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Text;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Core.Master;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の一覧。先頭に状態文、続けて解放済みの種類の行（前例 MachineRecipeSelectionList）
    /// The cargo list: the status line first, then rows of unlocked kinds (precedent MachineRecipeSelectionList)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoSelectionList : VisualElement
    {
        private readonly string _testPrefix;
        private readonly GameContentPresentation _content;
        private readonly IUiOsCursor _osCursor;
        private readonly RecipeListScrollView _list;
        private readonly LocalizedLabel _status;
        private readonly Subject<ItemId> _rowPressed = new();
        private readonly List<ItemId> _rowKinds = new();
        private readonly List<OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView> _rows = new();

        public IObservable<ItemId> OnRowPressed => _rowPressed;

        public OrbitalCargoSelectionList(string testPrefix, GameContentPresentation content, IUiOsCursor osCursor)
        {
            _testPrefix = testPrefix;
            _content = content;
            _osCursor = osCursor;
            AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-list");
            _list = new RecipeListScrollView($"{testPrefix}-cargo-list");
            _status = SpecialViewParts.Label($"{testPrefix}-cargo-status", UiTypographyClass.TextSm, UiTypographyClass.TextHighContrast);
            _list.SetLeadingContent(_status);
            Add(_list);
        }

        public void Render(OrbitalCargoDetail cargo, UiText status)
        {
            _status.SetText(status);
            // 種類の並びが変わったときだけ行を作り直す（状態更新ごとに作らない。D-37）
            // Rebuild rows only when the kinds change, not on every state update (D-37)
            if (!SameKinds()) Rebuild();
            for (var i = 0; i < _rows.Count; i++) _rows[i].SetSelected(cargo.IsSelectedChoice(_rowKinds[i]));

            #region Internal

            bool SameKinds()
            {
                if (_rowKinds.Count != cargo.SelectableChoices.Count) return false;
                for (var i = 0; i < _rowKinds.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (_rowKinds[i] != cargo.SelectableChoices[i].PayloadItemId) return false;
                }
                return true;
            }

            void Rebuild()
            {
                _rowKinds.Clear();
                _rows.Clear();
                var entries = new List<VisualElement>(cargo.SelectableChoices.Count);
                foreach (var choice in cargo.SelectableChoices)
                {
                    var row = new OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView($"{_testPrefix}-cargo-row-{choice.PayloadItemId.AsPrimitive()}", choice, cargo.FlightSeconds, _content, _osCursor);
                    row.OnPressed.Subscribe(_rowPressed.OnNext);
                    _rowKinds.Add(choice.PayloadItemId);
                    _rows.Add(row);
                    entries.Add(row);
                }
                _list.SetEntries(entries);
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Text;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Tooltip;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Core.Master;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 選んだ積荷の見出し（今の便があればその積荷と成果）と「次の便から ◯◯」の 1 行。押すと一覧へ戻る（前例 SelectedRecipeHeader）
    /// Selected cargo headline (the current flight's cargo and outcome when flying) plus one "from the next flight" line; pressing returns to the list (precedent SelectedRecipeHeader)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoHeader : VisualElement
    {
        private readonly UiGroup _group = new(UiGap.Xs);
        private readonly ItemSlot _slot;
        private readonly LocalizedLabel _name;
        private readonly LocalizedLabel _nextFlight;
        private readonly Subject<Unit> _pressed = new();
        private readonly GameContentPresentation _content;
        private bool _hasShown;
        private ItemId? _shownHeadline;
        private ItemId? _shownNextFlight;

        public IObservable<Unit> OnPressed => _pressed;

        public OrbitalCargoHeader(string testPrefix, GameContentPresentation content, IUiOsCursor osCursor)
        {
            name = $"{testPrefix}-cargo-header";
            AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-header");
            _content = content;
            _slot = new ItemSlot($"{testPrefix}-cargo-header-item");
            _name = new LocalizedLabel { name = $"{testPrefix}-cargo-header-name", pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore };
            _nextFlight = new LocalizedLabel { name = $"{testPrefix}-cargo-next-flight", pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore };
            _nextFlight.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextSm);
            _nextFlight.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextDimmed);
            _group.pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore;
            _group.AddToClassList(UiLayoutClass.GroupJustifyCenter);
            _group.AddItem(_slot);
            _group.AddItem(_name);
            Add(_group);
            Add(_nextFlight);

            // 押すと積荷を選び直す。押せる印の指は OS カーソルへ要素の層で要求する（前例 SelectedRecipeHeader）
            // Pressing reselects the cargo; the pressable pointer is requested on the element layer (precedent SelectedRecipeHeader)
            HoverTooltipMark.Mark(this, new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.ChangeOrbitalCargo));
            RegisterCallback<ClickEvent>(_ => _pressed.OnNext(Unit.Default));
            osCursor.CreateHoverRequest(this, UiOsCursorShape.Pointer, UiOsCursorLayer.Element);
        }

        public void Render(OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            var hasHeadline = cargo.TryGetHeadline(out var headline);
            var hasNextFlight = cargo.TryGetNextFlight(out var nextFlight);
            ItemId? headlineId = hasHeadline ? headline.PayloadItemId : null;
            ItemId? nextFlightId = hasNextFlight ? nextFlight.PayloadItemId : null;
            // 見出しと次の便が前回と同じなら描き直さない（状態更新ごとに作り直さない。D-37）
            // Skip redrawing while the headline and next flight are unchanged (not rebuilt per state update; D-37)
            if (_hasShown && _shownHeadline == headlineId && _shownNextFlight == nextFlightId) return;
            _hasShown = true;
            _shownHeadline = headlineId;
            _shownNextFlight = nextFlightId;

            UiDisplay.SetShown(_group, hasHeadline);
            if (hasHeadline)
            {
                _slot.SetContent(SlotItemContent.ForItem(_content, headline.PayloadItemId, headline.CountPerLaunch));
                _name.SetText(OrbitalCargoNames.Row(headline, _content));
            }
            UiDisplay.SetShown(_nextFlight, hasNextFlight);
            if (hasNextFlight) _nextFlight.SetText(OrbitalCargoNames.NextFlight(nextFlight, _content));
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoPane.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using Client.Ui.Components.Controls;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Layout;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Registration;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Core.Master;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 一覧を出すときは積荷の一覧、出さないときは見出し＋持ち主の中身を置く View（前例 MachineSectionView のモード切替）。一覧を出すかは Presenter が決めて渡す
    /// View placing the cargo list when told to, otherwise the headline plus the owner's content (precedent MachineSectionView's mode switch); the presenter decides and passes the mode
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoPane : VisualElement
    {
        private readonly OrbitalCargoSelectionList _list;
        private readonly OrbitalCargoHeader _header;
        private readonly UiStack _selected = new(UiGap.Sm);
        private readonly VisualElement _selectedHost;
        private bool _hasMode;
        private bool _showsSelection;

        public IObservable<ItemId> OnRowPressed => _list.OnRowPressed;
        public IObservable<Unit> OnChangeCargoRequested => _header.OnPressed;

        public OrbitalCargoPane(string testPrefix, SpecialViewKit kit, VisualElement selectedContent, bool fillsPanelHeight)
        {
            name = $"{testPrefix}-cargo-pane";
            AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-pane");
            EnableInClassList("orbital-cargo-pane--fill-panel-height", fillsPanelHeight);
            pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore;
            _list = new OrbitalCargoSelectionList(testPrefix, kit.Presentation, kit.OsCursor);
            _header = new OrbitalCargoHeader(testPrefix, kit.Presentation, kit.OsCursor);
            _selected.AddItem(_header);
            _selected.AddItem(selectedContent);
            _selectedHost = fillsPanelHeight ? WrapInScroll() : _selected;

            // 行の押下は View が直接コマンドへ渡す（前例 MachineSectionView・D-33）。一覧の開閉は Presenter が同じ押下を購読して進める
            // Row presses go straight from the view to the command (precedent MachineSectionView, D-33); the presenter subscribes to the same press to advance the list state
            _list.OnRowPressed.Subscribe(kit.Commands.SelectOrbitalCargo);

            #region Internal

            // 大型面では選んだ後の中身を縦のスクロール器に入れ、パネルの下端からはみ出さない
            // On the large panel the selected content sits in a vertical scroller so it never overflows the panel
            VisualElement WrapInScroll()
            {
                var scroll = new GameScrollView($"{testPrefix}-cargo-scroll", GameScrollAxis.Vertical);
                scroll.AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-pane__scroll");
                scroll.Add(_selected);
                return scroll;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        public void Render(OrbitalCargoDetail cargo, UiText listStatus, bool showsSelection)
        {
            // 木に置くのは今のモードの中身だけ。付け替えはモードが変わったときだけ（D-37）
            // Only the current mode's content is in the tree; re-attach only on a mode change (D-37)
            if (!_hasMode || showsSelection != _showsSelection)
            {
                _hasMode = true;
                _showsSelection = showsSelection;
                Clear();
                Add(showsSelection ? _list : _selectedHost);
            }
            if (showsSelection)
            {
                _list.Render(cargo, listStatus);
                return;
            }
            _selected.SetItemShown(_header, true);
            _header.Render(cargo);
        }

        // 積荷の詳細が未着の間は持ち主の中身だけを出す（中身の側が取得待ちを語る。拠点の状態区画）
        // While the cargo detail is pending show only the owner's content, which shows its own loading line (the base's state section)
        public void RenderWithoutCargo()
        {
            _hasMode = false;
            Clear();
            Add(_selectedHost);
            _selected.SetItemShown(_header, false);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task B6: 発射台・拠点の本文に積荷の選択を組み込み、大型パネルにする

発射台: 未選択は一覧だけ。選んだ後は「見出し・資材 3 枠（透かし）・選んだ積荷の 1 枠（透かし）＋前の種類の残り・状態・進み・出力」。拠点: 未選択は接続の有無にかかわらず一覧だけ。選んだ後は「見出し・入口（透かし）・出口・状態区画（プールの行は今のまま）・電力網」。一覧の先頭の状態文は、発射台は待ち理由（未選択なら「積荷を選んでいない」）、拠点は状態の文。題の建造・発射ボタン（`RocketLaunchPadTitleActionView`）は変えない。

一覧の局所状態 `OrbitalCargoSelectionModeState` は、発射台・拠点の本文用に新しく作る Presenter `OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter` が持つ。形は機械の前例どおり:

| 役 | 前例（機械） | 今回 |
|---|---|---|
| 局所状態の持ち主 | `MachineSectionPresenter`（`private readonly MachineSelectionModeState _mode`。`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui/Screens/BlockInventory/Machine/MachineSectionPresenter.cs:20`） | `OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter`（`_mode`） |
| 押下を出す | View が Subject を出す（`MachineSectionView.OnChangeRecipeRequested`・`OnRecipeRowPressed`） | 本文の View が `OnChangeCargoRequested`・`OnCargoRowPressed` を出す（中身は `OrbitalCargoPane` の Subject） |
| 状態を進める | Presenter が押下を購読して `OpenSelection`・`RememberRequest` し、描き直す（同 37–49 行） | 同じ |
| 選ぶコマンドを呼ぶ | View が行の押下で直接呼ぶ（`MachineSectionView.cs:43–55`「Presenter は中継しない」。D-24・D-33） | 同じ。`OrbitalCargoPane` が `kit.Commands.SelectOrbitalCargo` を呼ぶ（B5） |
| 描かせる | `MachineSectionView.Render(viewModel, _mode.ShowsSelection(machine))`（同 57 行） | `IOrbitalCargoBodyView.Render(itemSlots, detail, showsSelection)` |
| 特殊族での組み立て | `SpecialPresenters.Belt(view)` が専用の `BeltThroughputSectionPresenter` を作る（`…/Special/Registration/SpecialPresenters.cs:35`） | `SpecialPresenters.OrbitalCargoBody(view)` が `OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter` を作り、本文の工場が汎用の `Section(...)` の代わりに使う |

Presenter は今の汎用 Presenter `SpecialSectionPresenter<T>` と同じ「同じパネルの枠と詳細の流れ」を購読する。この組み立ては今 `SpecialSectionPresenter.Attach` のローカル関数にあるので、`SpecialPanelDetailStream.Of` へ移して 2 つの Presenter で共有する（同じ式を 2 か所に書かない）。

`OrbitalCargoBodyPresenterTest.cs`（新規。局所状態の進み方は Presenter と本物の発射台の本文を組んで見る。前例 `BeltThroughputSectionViewTest` の `Presenters.Belt(view)`・`Model.Set`・`presenter.Attach(OpenPanel(...))`）:

```csharp
using Client.Tests.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Support;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Space;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Details;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;
using static Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo.OrbitalCargoSamples;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 積荷の本文の Presenter が一覧の局所状態を持ち、本文の押下で進めて描かせる（前例 MachineSectionPresenter。ADR 0106 の 1・3・4）。発射台の本文で組む
    /// The cargo body presenter owns the list's local state, advances it on the body's presses and has it draw (precedent MachineSectionPresenter; ADR 0106 §1, §3, §4), built with the launch pad body
    /// </summary>
    public class OrbitalCargoBodyPresenterTest : SpecialScreenTestHost
    {
        [Test]
        public void 未選択の発射台を開くと一覧だけを出し資材と積荷の枠を出さない()
        {
            var (view, presenter) = Attach(Pad(null, null, ChipLv1));
            Assert.IsTrue(presenter.IsApplicable.Value);
            Assert.IsNotNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-row-1"));
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-material-slots"));
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-payload-slots"));
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-output-slots"), "出力の枠も選ぶまで出さない（ユーザー裁定 2026-11-21・判断 23）");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 行を押すと送り届くまで一覧のまま届けば見出しと中身を出す()
        {
            var (view, _) = Attach(Pad(null, null, ChipLv1, ChipLv2));
            simulate.Click(Find<VisualElement>(view, "rocket-launch-pad-cargo-row-2"));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "orbital_cargo.select 2" }, Commands.Issued);
            Assert.IsNotNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-list"), "届くまでは一覧のまま（拒否されても一覧に残る）");

            Model.Set(Detail(Pad(ChipLv2, null, ChipLv1, ChipLv2)));
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-list"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-header"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-material-slots"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 見出しを押すと一覧へ戻り今の種類の行を押せばその場で閉じる()
        {
            var (view, _) = Attach(Pad(ChipLv1, null, ChipLv1, ChipLv2));
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-list"), "選んだ後は見出しと中身");
            simulate.Click(Find<VisualElement>(view, "rocket-launch-pad-cargo-header"));
            simulate.FrameUpdate();
            Assert.IsTrue(Find<VisualElement>(view, "rocket-launch-pad-cargo-row-1").ClassListContains(OrbitalCargoSelectionRowView.SelectedClassName));
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(Commands.Issued, "見出しの押下はコマンドを送らない");

            // 同じ種類はサーバーの状態が変わらず更新が来ないので、押した時の描き直しで閉じる（判断 15）
            // The same kind leaves the server state unchanged and no update comes, so the redraw on press closes it (decision 15)
            simulate.Click(Find<VisualElement>(view, "rocket-launch-pad-cargo-row-1"));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "orbital_cargo.select 1" }, Commands.Issued);
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-list"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Detachで開いた一覧を戻し次のAttachでは選んだ後の画面から始める()
        {
            var (view, presenter) = Attach(Pad(ChipLv1, null, ChipLv1, ChipLv2));
            simulate.Click(Find<VisualElement>(view, "rocket-launch-pad-cargo-header"));
            Assert.IsNotNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-list"));
            presenter.Detach();
            Assert.IsFalse(presenter.IsApplicable.Value);
            presenter.Attach(OpenPanel(BlockMasterElement.BlockTypeConst.RocketLaunchPad, Slots()));
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-list"), "前のパネルの開いた一覧を持ち越さない");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 詳細の未着は本文を出したまま取得待ちを語り一覧を出さない()
        {
            var view = Mount(new RocketLaunchPadBodyView(Kit(LoadContent()), false));
            var presenter = Presenters.OrbitalCargoBody(view);
            presenter.Attach(OpenPanel(BlockMasterElement.BlockTypeConst.RocketLaunchPad, Slots()));
            Assert.IsTrue(presenter.IsApplicable.Value, "本文は詳細の未着でも出す（前例 WholeSpecialDetailSelector）");
            Assert.IsTrue(IsShown(Find<Label>(view, "rocket-launch-pad-loading")));
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-list"));
        }

        private (RocketLaunchPadBodyView view, OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter presenter) Attach(OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            var view = Mount(new RocketLaunchPadBodyView(Kit(LoadContent()), false));
            var presenter = Presenters.OrbitalCargoBody(view);
            Model.Set(Detail(cargo));
            presenter.Attach(OpenPanel(BlockMasterElement.BlockTypeConst.RocketLaunchPad, Slots()));
            simulate.FrameUpdate();
            return (view, presenter);
        }

        private static SpecialBlockDetailViewModel Detail(OrbitalCargoDetail cargo)
        {
            return SpecialDetailSamples.Only(SpecialDetailSamples.RocketWith(RocketLaunchPadPhase.Idle, cargo));
        }

        // 見本の発射台（RocketWith）は資材 0・積荷 1・出力 2 から
        // The sample pad (RocketWith) has material 0, payload 1 and outputs from 2
        private static SlotItem[] Slots()
        {
            return new[] { new SlotItem(ItemMaster.EmptyItemId, 0), new SlotItem(ItemMaster.EmptyItemId, 0), new SlotItem(ItemMaster.EmptyItemId, 0) };
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Details;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Selectors
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 発射台・宇宙エレベーター拠点の積荷の詳細を取り出す（どちらでもなければ取れない）。積荷の本文の Presenter が一覧のモードを決めるのに使う
    /// Selects the cargo detail of a launch pad or space elevator base (none for other kinds); the cargo body presenter uses it to decide the list mode
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoDetailSelector : ISpecialDetailSelector<OrbitalCargoDetail>
    {
        public bool TryGet(SpecialBlockDetailViewModel detail, out OrbitalCargoDetail value)
        {
            if (detail.TryGetRocketLaunchPad(out var rocket))
            {
                value = rocket.Cargo;
                return true;
            }
            if (detail.TryGetSpaceElevator(out var elevator))
            {
                value = elevator.Cargo;
                return true;
            }
            value = null;
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`SpecialPanelDetailStream.cs`（新規。`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui/Screens/BlockInventory/Special/Registration/`。今 `SpecialSectionPresenter.cs` 48–66 行にある組み立てをそのまま移す）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Panel;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Details;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using UniRx;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Registration
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 同じパネルの枠と特殊族の詳細の流れ。特殊族の Presenter が Attach で購読する（SpecialSectionPresenter と OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter で共有）
    /// Stream of the same panel's slots joined with the special detail; special presenters subscribe to it in Attach (shared by SpecialSectionPresenter and OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter)
    /// </summary>
    public static class SpecialPanelDetailStream
    {
        public static IObservable<(IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> slots, SpecialBlockDetailViewModel detail)> Of(IBlockInventoryPanelSource panels, ISpecialBlockDetailModel model, OpenBlockInventoryPanel panel)
        {
            // 同じパネルの枠の変化と、パネルの組み直しの外で届く詳細（網の集約・ベルトの統計）の両方で流す
            // Emit on both slot changes of the same panel and details arriving outside panel rebuilds (network totals, belt stats)
            return panels.Current
                .Where(IsSamePanel)
                .Select(current => ((OpenBlockInventoryPanel)current).ItemSlots)
                .CombineLatest(model.Current, (slots, detail) => (slots, detail));

            #region Internal

            bool IsSamePanel(BlockInventoryPanelState current)
            {
                // silent-ok: 別のパネルへ替わる途中の値は描かない / alpha の BodyHost が同じフレームで Detach して新しい部分を作る（前例 alpha の SectionStackItemGridSection）
                return current is OpenBlockInventoryPanel open && open.IsSamePanel(panel);
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter.cs`（新規。`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui/Screens/BlockInventory/Special/Cargo/`）:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Parts;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Registration;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Panel;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Details;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Selectors;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 発射台・拠点の本文の Presenter。一覧の局所状態を持ち、本文の行・見出しの押下で進め、一覧を出すかを決めて本文に描かせる。選ぶコマンドは View が送る（前例 MachineSectionPresenter・BeltThroughputSectionPresenter）
    /// Presenter of the launch pad and elevator base bodies; owns the cargo list's local state, advances it on the body's row and headline presses and has the body draw with the decided mode; the view sends the select command (precedents MachineSectionPresenter, BeltThroughputSectionPresenter)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter : BlockInventorySectionBase
    {
        private readonly IOrbitalCargoBodyView _view;
        private readonly ISpecialDetailSelector<OrbitalCargoDetail> _cargoSelector;
        private readonly ISpecialBlockDetailModel _model;
        private readonly IBlockInventoryPanelSource _panels;
        private OrbitalCargoSelectionModeState _mode = new();
        private IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> _slots;
        private SpecialBlockDetailViewModel _detail;

        public override VisualElement Root { get; }

        public OrbitalCargoBodyPresenter(VisualElement root, IOrbitalCargoBodyView view, ISpecialDetailSelector<OrbitalCargoDetail> cargoSelector, ISpecialBlockDetailModel model, IBlockInventoryPanelSource panels)
        {
            Root = root;
            _view = view;
            _cargoSelector = cargoSelector;
            _model = model;
            _panels = panels;
        }

        public override void Attach(OpenBlockInventoryPanel panel)
        {
            // 同じパネルの枠と詳細が届くたびに、最後の値を覚えて描く
            // Remember the latest slots and detail of the same panel and draw on every update
            AddSubscription(SpecialPanelDetailStream.Of(_panels, _model, panel).Subscribe(pair =>
            {
                _slots = pair.slots;
                _detail = pair.detail;
                Apply();
            }));

            // 見出しの押下は一覧を開き、行の押下は要求を覚えて描き直す（送信は View。前例 MachineSectionPresenter・D-24・D-33）
            // A headline press opens the list; a row press remembers the request and redraws (the view sends; precedent MachineSectionPresenter, D-24, D-33)
            AddSubscription(_view.OnChangeCargoRequested.Subscribe(_ =>
            {
                _mode.OpenSelection();
                Apply();
            }));
            AddSubscription(_view.OnCargoRowPressed.Subscribe(payloadItemId =>
            {
                _mode.RememberRequest(payloadItemId);
                Apply();
            }));
        }

        protected override void ResetSectionStateOnDetach()
        {
            // 外れたら一覧の開閉と最後の値を捨てる（前のパネルの状態を次のパネルへ持ち越さない。前例 BeltThroughputSectionPresenter）
            // On detach drop the list state and the latest values (never carry the previous panel over; precedent BeltThroughputSectionPresenter)
            _mode = new OrbitalCargoSelectionModeState();
            _slots = null;
            _detail = null;
        }

        private void Apply()
        {
            // 一覧を出すかは積荷の詳細が届いたときだけ局所状態で決める。未着は本文が取得待ちを語るので、本文はいつも出す（前例 WholeSpecialDetailSelector）
            // Decide the list mode from local state only once the cargo detail arrives; while pending the body shows loading, so the body always shows (precedent WholeSpecialDetailSelector)
            var showsSelection = _cargoSelector.TryGet(_detail, out var cargo) && _mode.ResolveShowsSelection(cargo);
            _view.Render(_slots, _detail, showsSelection);
            SetApplicable(true);
        }
    }
}
```

（押下は本文の行・見出しからしか来ず、それらは詳細が届いて描かれた後にしか木に無い。Detach で購読も切れるので、`Apply` の時点で `_slots`・`_detail` は必ず入っている。押下の購読は Attach で張るので、View が ctor で張ったコマンドの購読〈B5 の `OrbitalCargoPane`〉の後に呼ばれる。送ってから要求を覚える順は前例の機械と同じ。）

```csharp
    /// 発射台の本文: 一覧のモードでは積荷の一覧、そうでなければ見出し・資材・選んだ積荷・状態・進捗・出力（ADR 0106 の 1）。モードは Presenter が決める。詳細の未着は取得待ち
    /// Launch pad body: the cargo list in list mode, otherwise headline, materials, selected payload, status, progress and outputs (ADR 0106 §1); the presenter decides the mode; pending detail shows loading
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class RocketLaunchPadBodyView : VisualElement, IOrbitalCargoBodyView
    {
        private const string MaterialGridTestId = "rocket-launch-pad-material-slots";
        private const string PayloadGridTestId = "rocket-launch-pad-payload-slots";

        private readonly LocalizedLabel _loading = SpecialViewParts.Label("rocket-launch-pad-loading", UiTypographyClass.TextSm, UiTypographyClass.TextMuted);
        private readonly UiStack _view = new(UiGap.Sm) { name = "rocket-launch-pad-view" };
        private readonly BlockItemGrid _material;
        private readonly BlockItemGrid _payload;
        private readonly BlockItemGrid _output;
        private readonly LocalizedLabel _status = SpecialViewParts.Label("rocket-launch-pad-status", UiTypographyClass.TextSm, UiTypographyClass.TextHighContrast);
        private readonly GaugeBar _progress = new("rocket-launch-pad-progress");
        private readonly OrbitalCargoPane _pane;
        private readonly GameContentPresentation _content;

        public IObservable<ItemId> OnCargoRowPressed => _pane.OnRowPressed;
        public IObservable<Unit> OnChangeCargoRequested => _pane.OnChangeCargoRequested;

        public RocketLaunchPadBodyView(SpecialViewKit kit, bool fillsPanelHeight)
        {
            AddToClassList("rocket-launch-pad-view");
            AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-host");
            _content = kit.Presentation;
            _loading.SetText(new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.DetailLoading));
            _material = kit.Grids.Create(MaterialGridTestId);
            _payload = kit.Grids.Create(PayloadGridTestId);
            _output = kit.Grids.Create("rocket-launch-pad-output-slots");

            // 選んだ後の並び: 資材・積荷・状態・進捗・出力（見出しは一覧と出し分ける枠が上に置く）
            // Order after selecting: materials, payload, status, progress, outputs (the pane puts the headline above)
            _view.AddItem(new BlockItemGridGroup(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.RocketMaterials, _material));
            _view.AddItem(new BlockItemGridGroup(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.RocketPayloads, _payload));
            _view.AddItem(_status);
            _view.AddItem(_progress);
            _view.AddItem(new BlockItemGridGroup(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.RocketOutputs, _output));
            _pane = new OrbitalCargoPane("rocket-launch-pad", kit, _view, fillsPanelHeight);
            Add(_loading);
            Add(_pane);
        }

        public void Render(IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> itemSlots, SpecialBlockDetailViewModel detail, bool showsSelection)
        {
            var present = detail.TryGetRocketLaunchPad(out var rocket);
            UiDisplay.SetShown(_loading, !present);
            UiDisplay.SetShown(_pane, present);
            // silent-ok: 詳細の未着は「状態の取得を待っています」を出したまま / 録画（R-12）の発射台の段で気づく
            if (!present) return;

            // 資材と選んだ積荷は透かしと「持っている数／必要な数」で描く（ADR 0106 の 1）
            // Materials and the selected payload draw ghosts and held/required (ADR 0106 §1)
            OrbitalCargoSlotContents.Render(_material, MaterialGridTestId, itemSlots, rocket.MaterialBoundSlots, _content);
            OrbitalCargoSlotContents.Render(_payload, PayloadGridTestId, itemSlots, rocket.PayloadBoundSlots(itemSlots), _content);
            _output.Render(itemSlots, rocket.OutputSlots(itemSlots.Count));
            var status = new UiText(rocket.StatusKey);
            _status.SetText(status);
            _progress.SetValue(rocket.Progress);
            _pane.Render(rocket.Cargo, status, showsSelection);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.Content;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Layout;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Parts;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Cargo;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Network;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Registration;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Selectors;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Special.Details;
using Client.Ui.State.Items;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Core.Master;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Special.Space
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 宇宙エレベーターの本文: 一覧のモードでは積荷の一覧、そうでなければ見出し・入口・出口・状態区画・電力網（ADR 0106 の 7）。モードは Presenter が決める（未選択は接続の有無にかかわらず一覧）
    /// Space elevator body: the cargo list in list mode, otherwise headline, inlet, outlets, state section and electric network (ADR 0106 §7); the presenter decides the mode (unselected shows the list regardless of connection)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class SpaceElevatorBodyView : VisualElement, IOrbitalCargoBodyView
    {
        private const string InputGridTestId = "space-elevator-input-grid";

        private readonly UiStack _grid = new(UiGap.Sm) { name = "space-elevator-grid" };
        private readonly BlockItemGridGroup _inputGroup;
        private readonly BlockItemGridGroup _outputGroup;
        private readonly BlockItemGrid _input;
        private readonly BlockItemGrid _output;
        private readonly SpaceElevatorSectionView _section;
        private readonly ElectricNetworkSectionView _network = new();
        private readonly ElectricNetworkDetailSelector _networkSelector = new();
        private readonly UiStack _stack = new(UiGap.Sm);
        private readonly OrbitalCargoPane _pane;
        private readonly GameContentPresentation _content;

        public IObservable<ItemId> OnCargoRowPressed => _pane.OnRowPressed;
        public IObservable<Unit> OnChangeCargoRequested => _pane.OnChangeCargoRequested;

        public SpaceElevatorBodyView(SpecialViewKit kit, bool fillsPanelHeight)
        {
            name = "space-elevator-view";
            AddToClassList("space-elevator-view");
            AddToClassList("orbital-cargo-host");
            _content = kit.Presentation;
            _input = kit.Grids.Create(InputGridTestId);
            _output = kit.Grids.Create("space-elevator-output-grid");
            _inputGroup = new BlockItemGridGroup(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.SpaceElevatorSatelliteInput, _input);
            _outputGroup = new BlockItemGridGroup(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.SpaceElevatorResultOutput, _output);
            _grid.AddItem(_inputGroup);
            _grid.AddItem(_outputGroup);
            _section = new SpaceElevatorSectionView(kit);

            _stack.AddItem(_grid);
            _stack.AddItem(_section);
            _stack.AddItem(_network);
            _pane = new OrbitalCargoPane("space-elevator", kit, _stack, fillsPanelHeight);
            Add(_pane);
        }

        public void Render(IReadOnlyList<SlotItem> itemSlots, SpecialBlockDetailViewModel detail, bool showsSelection)
        {
            // 群は詳細が届いてから出す。未着の間は中身だけを出し、状態区画が取得待ちを語る
            // Groups appear once the detail arrives; while pending only the content shows and the state section shows loading
            var present = detail.TryGetSpaceElevator(out var elevator);
            _grid.SetItemShown(_inputGroup, present);
            _grid.SetItemShown(_outputGroup, present);
            if (present)
            {
                OrbitalCargoSlotContents.Render(_input, InputGridTestId, itemSlots, elevator.InletBoundSlots, _content);
                _output.Render(itemSlots, elevator.OutputSlots);
                _pane.Render(elevator.Cargo, new UiText(elevator.StatusDisplay.LabelKey), showsSelection);
            }
            else
            {
                _pane.RenderWithoutCargo();
            }
            _section.Render(detail);

            // 電力網の区画は Stack の項目なので selector で決めて SetItemShown で出し入れする（直に display を触ると先頭の間隔がずれる。D-23）
            // The network section is a Stack item, so decide with the selector and toggle via SetItemShown (touching display directly skews the leading gap. D-23)
            var showsNetwork = _networkSelector.TryGet(detail, out var network);
            if (showsNetwork) _network.Render(itemSlots, network);
            _stack.SetItemShown(_network, showsNetwork);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
            // 積荷の選択を送り、トーストの係へ結果が届くまで待つ
            // Send a cargo selection and wait until its result reaches the toaster
            async UniTask<UiCommandResult> Select(SpecialBlockCommands commands, RecordingUiCommandResultToaster toaster, ItemId payload)
            {
                var before = toaster.Reports.Count;
                commands.SelectOrbitalCargo(payload);
                for (var i = 0; i < 50 && toaster.Reports.Count == before; i++) await UniTask.Delay(100);
                Assert.AreEqual(before + 1, toaster.Reports.Count, "the cargo selection result never reached the toaster");
                Assert.AreEqual(SpecialBlockCommands.SelectOrbitalCargoCommandName, toaster.Reports[before].CommandName);
                return toaster.Reports[before].Result;
            }
```

```csharp
    await p.Until(() => !padObject.IsPlayingPlaceAnimation, 30f, "発射台の設置演出が終わった");
    // 未選択の台は何も受け取らないので、開いて一覧の行を押して選んでから積む（ADR 0106 の 1・2。Lv1 はロケット技術の前提で解放済み）
    // An unselected pad accepts nothing, so open it and press the list row before loading (ADR 0106 §1, §2; Lv1 is unlocked by rocket technology's prerequisites)
    await OpenPad();
    await p.UntilUiElement($"rocket-launch-pad-cargo-row-{payloadId.AsPrimitive()}", 10f);
    await p.Screenshot("00-cargo-list");
    await p.ClickUi($"rocket-launch-pad-cargo-row-{payloadId.AsPrimitive()}");
    await p.UntilUiElement("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-header", 10f);
    await LoadOneLaunch();
    await p.Until(() => Phase() == RocketLaunchPadPhase.AwaitingBuildCommand, 10f, "建造の合図待ちになった");
    await p.Screenshot("01-awaiting-build");
```

- [ ] **Step 1b: 選び直しのシナリオ tier9-4c を足す**

新しいファイル `.agents/skills/unity-playmode-recorded-playtest/scenarios/tier9/tier9-4c-rocket-cargo-reselect.cs`（0 行 → 196 行。下のコードの行数そのまま）。Lv2 を解放 → Lv1 を UI で選んで積む → 建造中に見出しから Lv2 へ選び直す → 見出しは Lv1 のまま「次の便から」が出る → 今の便は Lv1 の成果（計算データ 20）を返す → 次の便は Lv2 で積み、合図なしで建造が始まる（ADR 0106 の 4）。足場・研究・配線・`OpenPad`・`Refuel`・`WaitPhaseRefueling` は tier9-4 と同じ手順を写す。

```csharp
using Game.Context;
// 出荷マスタで発射台の建造中に積荷を ICチップLv1 から Lv2 へ選び直し、見出しは今の便のまま「次の便から」が出て、今の便は Lv1 の成果を返し、次の便は Lv2 で積むことを確かめる
// On the shipped master, reselect the pad's cargo from IC chip Lv1 to Lv2 while building; the headline keeps the current flight with "from the next flight", the current flight returns Lv1's output and the next flight loads Lv2
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Client.Game.InGame.Map.MapObject;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.UIState;
using Client.Playtest;
using Client.Playtest.Input;
using Client.Playtest.Operations;
using Client.Playtest.Operations.Ui;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Root;
using Core.Master;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Blocks.PowerGenerator;
using Game.Block.Blocks.RocketLaunchPad;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Game.EnergySystem;
using Game.Fluid;
using Game.Research;
using Game.UnlockState;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.Util.ElectricWire.Connection;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

var rocketResearch = Guid.Parse("01a167cf-af9d-7f31-817c-3069b4f6e499"); // ロケット技術（P2 の research.json）
var padPos = new Vector3Int(0, 32, 0);
return PlaytestRunner.Run("tier9-4c-rocket-cargo-reselect", new PlaytestRunOptions { Record = true }, async p =>
{
    await p.SetupFlatGround();
    await p.SkipOpeningSkitIfPlaying();
    await p.Until(() => p.CurrentUiState == UIStateEnum.GameScreen && Camera.main != null, 15f, "GameScreen とメインカメラに戻った");
    // 地形が台の手前に湧いて照準と画面を塞ぐので、地形の表示と生成を止める（tier9-4 と同じ）
    // Terrain spawns in front of the pad and blocks aim and view, so stop its display and spawning (same as tier9-4)
    UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<MapObjectGameObjectDatastore>().SetActive(false);
    await PlaytestUiOps.PrepareBackgroundInputAndWaitEnabled(p);
    p.WarpPlayer(new Vector3(5f, 32.5f, -14f));

    // ロケット技術を前提ごと完了扱いにし、ICチップLv2 を解放する（前提の閉包では Lv1 だけが解放される）
    // Mark rocket technology done with its prerequisites and unlock IC chip Lv2 (the closure unlocks only Lv1)
    var lv1 = PlaytestItemOps.ResolveItemId("ICチップLv1");
    var lv2 = PlaytestItemOps.ResolveItemId("ICチップLv2");
    await p.RunOnServer("ロケット技術を前提ごと完了扱いにする", () => ServerContext.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().LoadResearchData(new ResearchSaveJsonObject { CompletedResearchGuids = WithPrerequisites(new[] { rocketResearch }).Select(g => g.ToString()).ToList() }));
    await p.WaitForResearch(new[] { rocketResearch }, Array.Empty<Guid>(), 15f, "ロケット技術が完了扱いになった");
    await p.RunOnServer("ICチップLv2 を解放する", () => ServerContext.GetService<IGameUnlockStateDataController>().UnlockItem(lv2));

    // 発射台と発電機を置き、広範囲電柱で給電する（tier9-4 と同じ配置）
    // Place the pad and a generator and power the pad through a wide-range pole (same layout as tier9-4)
    var pad = await p.PlaceBlockDirect("ロケット発射台", padPos, BlockDirection.North);
    var generator = await p.PlaceBlockDirect("ガソリンエンジン発電機", new Vector3Int(-20, 32, -20), BlockDirection.North);
    var pole = (await p.PlaceBlockDirect("広範囲電柱", new Vector3Int(-3, 32, -3), BlockDirection.North)).GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>();
    var processor = pad.GetComponent<RocketLaunchPadProcessorComponent>();
    var param = (RocketLaunchPadBlockParam)pad.BlockMasterElement.BlockParam;
    var free = new ConnectionLineRecord(Guid.Parse("872372d5-2998-4fb7-826c-593ceeafcfb2"), Array.Empty<ConnectToolMaterialCost>());
    var wired = new List<bool>();
    await p.RunOnServer("発電機 → 電柱 → 発射台を配線する", () =>
    {
        wired.Add(ElectricWireSystemUtil.TryConnectBothSides(generator.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>(), pole, free));
        wired.Add(ElectricWireSystemUtil.TryConnectBothSides(pole, pad.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>(), free));
    });
    p.Assert(wired.Count == 2 && wired.All(w => w), "発電機 → 電柱 → 発射台を配線した");
    await Refuel();
    var padObject = await p.WaitBlockGameObject(padPos);
    await p.Until(() => !padObject.IsPlayingPlaceAnimation, 30f, "発射台の設置演出が終わった");

    // 一覧に Lv1・Lv2 の 2 行が出る。Lv1 を押して選び、1便を積んで建造を始める
    // The list shows two rows, Lv1 and Lv2; press Lv1, load one launch and start building
    p.Note("一覧から ICチップLv1 を選び、1便を積んで建造を始める");
    await OpenPad();
    await p.UntilUiElement(CargoRow(lv2), 10f);
    await p.Screenshot("01-cargo-list-two-kinds");
    await p.ClickUi(CargoRow(lv1));
    await p.Until(() => State().SelectedCargoItemId == lv1, 10f, "サーバーが ICチップLv1 を選んだ状態になった");
    await LoadOneLaunch(lv1);
    await p.Until(() => State().Phase == RocketLaunchPadPhase.AwaitingBuildCommand, 10f, "建造の合図待ちになった");
    await p.UntilUiElement("rocket-launch-pad-build", 10f);
    await p.ClickUi("rocket-launch-pad-build");
    await p.Until(() => State().Phase == RocketLaunchPadPhase.Building, 5f, "建造が始まった");

    // 建造中に見出しを押して Lv2 へ選び直す。選択だけが変わり、見出しは今の便（Lv1）のまま下に「次の便から」が出る（ADR 0106 の 4）
    // While building, press the headline and reselect Lv2; only the selection changes, the headline keeps the current flight (Lv1) with "from the next flight" below (ADR 0106 §4)
    p.Note("建造中に見出しを押し、ICチップLv2 へ選び直す");
    await p.ClickUi("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-header");
    await p.UntilUiElement(CargoRow(lv2), 10f);
    await p.Screenshot("02-reselect-list");
    await p.ClickUi(CargoRow(lv2));
    await p.Until(() => State().SelectedCargoItemId == lv2 && State().LoadedCargoItemId == lv1, 10f, "選択は Lv2 になり、今の便は Lv1 のまま");
    // 「次の便から」は PickingMode.Ignore で中心のヒットを待てないので、見つかって表示中かを読む（前例 uitk-block-special-panels）
    // The "from the next flight" line ignores picking and cannot wait on a centre hit, so read found-and-shown instead (precedent: uitk-block-special-panels)
    await p.Until(() => Shown("rocket-launch-pad-cargo-next-flight"), 10f, "見出しの下に「次の便から」が出た");
    await p.Screenshot("03-next-flight");

    // 今の便は Lv1 で打ち上がり、Lv1 の成果（計算データ 20 個）を返す
    // The current flight launches with Lv1 and returns Lv1's output (20 compute data)
    p.Note($"建造 {param.BuildSeconds} 秒を早送りせずに待ち、発射する");
    await WaitPhaseRefueling(RocketLaunchPadPhase.AwaitingLaunchCommand, param.BuildSeconds + 60f, "建造が実時間で終わり発射の合図待ちになった");
    await p.UntilUiElement("rocket-launch-pad-launch", 10f);
    await p.ClickUi("rocket-launch-pad-launch");
    var computeDataId = PlaytestItemOps.ResolveItemId("計算データ");
    var expected = (await p.ReadArrivalOutputs(lv1, CountPerLaunch(lv1))).Where(s => s.Id == computeDataId).Sum(s => s.Count);
    p.Assert(expected == 20, $"ICチップLv1 1便の到着成果は計算データ20個（{expected} 個）");
    await p.Until(() => CountInOutputs() == expected, param.LaunchSeconds + 30f, $"Lv1 の成果の計算データ {expected} 個が出力口に届いた");
    await p.Until(() => State().Phase == RocketLaunchPadPhase.Idle, 20f, "打ち上げが終わり待機に戻った");
    await p.Screenshot("04-lv1-output");

    // 次の便は選び直した Lv2 で積み、合図なしで建造が始まる
    // The next flight loads the reselected Lv2 and starts building without a command
    p.Note("2便目の資材と ICチップLv2 を積み、合図なしで建造が始まることを確かめる");
    await Refuel();
    await LoadOneLaunch(lv2);
    await p.Until(() => State().Phase == RocketLaunchPadPhase.Building && State().LoadedCargoItemId == lv2, 10f, "2便目は ICチップLv2 を積んで合図なしで建造が始まった");
    await p.Screenshot("05-lv2-building");
    p.Note("選び直し 完了");

    #region Internal

    IEnumerable<Guid> WithPrerequisites(IEnumerable<Guid> targets)
    {
        // 前提を辿って閉包を作る（tier9-4 と同じ）
        // Walk prerequisites into a closure (same as tier9-4)
        var (done, pending) = (new HashSet<Guid>(), new Stack<Guid>(targets));
        while (pending.TryPop(out var guid))
            if (done.Add(guid)) foreach (var prev in MasterHolder.ResearchMaster.GetResearch(guid).PrevResearchNodeGuids) pending.Push(prev);
        return done;
    }

    // 本番の状態配信と同じ観測口で状態を読む（RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.ReadState と同じ）
    // Read the state through the production state contract (same as RocketLaunchPadTestUtil.ReadState)
    RocketLaunchPadStateDetail State()
    {
        var detail = processor.GetBlockStateDetails().Single(d => d.Key == RocketLaunchPadStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey);
        return MessagePack.MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<RocketLaunchPadStateDetail>(detail.Value);
    }

    bool Shown(string testid)
    {
        var element = GameUiRoot.Instance.GetRootElement().Q<VisualElement>(testid);
        if (element == null || element.panel == null) return false;
        for (var e = element; e != null; e = e.parent) if (e.resolvedStyle.display == DisplayStyle.None) return false;
        return true;
    }

    string CargoRow(ItemId itemId) => $"rocket-launch-pad-cargo-row-{itemId.AsPrimitive()}";

    int CountPerLaunch(ItemId itemId)
    {
        var guid = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemMaster(itemId).ItemGuid;
        return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.OrbitalPayloads.Single(payload => payload.PayloadItemGuid == guid).CountPerLaunch;
    }

    int CountInOutputs() => pad.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>().InventoryItems.Where(s => s.Id == computeDataId).Sum(s => s.Count);

    async UniTask Refuel() => await p.RunOnServer("発電機を満タンまで給油する", () => generator.GetComponent<VanillaElectricGeneratorComponent>().AddLiquid(new FluidStack(100000, MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(new Guid("019eded2-7454-76da-8943-84c4e7a59179"))), default));

    async UniTask LoadOneLaunch(ItemId cargo) => await p.RunOnServer("1便ぶんの資材（マスタの launchMaterials）と選んだ積荷を積む", () =>
    {
        var inventory = pad.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
        foreach (var material in param.LaunchMaterials) inventory.InsertItem(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(material.ItemGuid), material.Count);
        inventory.InsertItem(cargo, CountPerLaunch(cargo));
    });

    async UniTask WaitPhaseRefueling(RocketLaunchPadPhase phase, float timeoutSeconds, string label)
    {
        // 1秒ごとに段階を見て、10秒ごとに給油する（tier9-4 と同じ）
        // Check the phase every second and refuel every ten (same as tier9-4)
        var deadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartup + timeoutSeconds;
        for (var second = 0; State().Phase != phase && Time.realtimeSinceStartup < deadline; second++)
        {
            if (second % 10 == 0) await Refuel();
            await UniTask.Delay(1000);
        }
        await p.Until(() => State().Phase == phase, 0f, label);
    }

    async UniTask OpenPad()
    {
        // 台の南面の1m手前に着地し、Alt のカーソル照準で南面を狙って開く（tier9-4 と同じ）
        // Land 1 m south of the pad's south face and open it by aiming at the face with the Alt cursor (same as tier9-4)
        p.WarpPlayer(new Vector3(padPos.x + 5f, 32.5f, padPos.z - 1f));
        await p.Until(() => Mathf.Abs(p.PlayerPosition.y - 32f) < 0.05f, 5f, "地面(y=32.0)に着地した");
        SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.LeftAlt);
        await p.AimAt(new Vector3(padPos.x + 5f, 33f, padPos.z));
        await p.PressInteract();
        await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.SubInventory, 10f);
        SemanticInput.KeyUp(Key.LeftAlt);
        await p.UntilUiElement("block-inventory-close", 10f);
    }

    #endregion
});
```

（`computeDataId` は `CountInOutputs` が捕まえるので、`CountInOutputs` を呼ぶ前に宣言してある。tier9-4 と同じ並び。`Core.Master` の `ItemId` は using 済み。）

「部屋クラスを1つ上げる」の差分を出すには、今の値が何行目かと、1つ上の行の値が要る。今の `CleanRoomClassYield` は値3つだけで行が分からない。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block.Interface/Component/CleanRoom/CleanRoomClassYield.cs`（全体 1-20）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.CleanRoom/CleanRoomMachineEffectService.cs`（40-50）

  - `public static bool CleanRoomClassYield.TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(int currentIndex, out int targetIndex)`（今の行の1つ上の行の添字。Out〈行数〉からはいちばん下の行。いちばん良い行〈添字0〉だけ false。「いちばん良いクラスか」と「1つ上の行」はここ1か所で、改善の計算〈C3〉・台数の数え上げ〈C5〉・見通し〈C6〉が呼ぶ。`Game.Block` と `Game.CleanRoom` の両方が参照する `Game.Block.Interface` に置く）

```csharp
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    public class CleanRoomClassYieldTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void FromThresholdIndexCarriesTheRowValuesAndIndexTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));

            // テストマスタのクラスC（添字2）は品質倍率0.5・層失敗率0.2・ダイ損失率0.3
            // Test master class C (index 2) is quality x0.5, layer fail 0.2, die loss 0.3
            var classC = CleanRoomClassYield.FromThresholdIndex(2);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, classC.ThresholdIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.5f, classC.QualityMultiplier, 1e-6f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.2f, classC.LayerFailRate, 1e-6f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.3f, classC.DieLossRate, 1e-6f);
        }

        [Test]
        public void PromotionTargetIsTheRowAboveExceptAtTheBestRowTest()
        {
            // いちばん良い行（添字0）には昇格の目標が無い
            // The best row (index 0) has no promotion target
            Assert.IsFalse(CleanRoomClassYield.TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(0, out _));

            // Out（行数4）の目標はいちばん下の D(3)、B(1) の目標は A(0)
            // From Out (row count 4) the target is the lowest row D(3); from B(1) it is A(0)
            Assert.IsTrue(CleanRoomClassYield.TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(4, out var fromOut));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, fromOut);
            Assert.IsTrue(CleanRoomClassYield.TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(1, out var fromB));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, fromB);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Interface.Component
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋クラスの歩留まり値
    ///     Per-class yield values carried only by an operable room effect
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct CleanRoomClassYield
    {
        public readonly float QualityMultiplier;
        public readonly float LayerFailRate;
        public readonly float DieLossRate;

        public CleanRoomClassYield(float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate)
        {
            QualityMultiplier = qualityMultiplier;
            LayerFailRate = layerFailRate;
            DieLossRate = dieLossRate;
        }
```

直した後（全体）:

```csharp
using Core.Master;

namespace Game.Block.Interface.Component
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋クラスの歩留まり値と、その値を取った閾値行の添字
    ///     Per-class yield values and the threshold row index they came from, carried only by an operable room effect
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct CleanRoomClassYield
    {
        // 閾値行の添字。0 がいちばん良いクラス
        // Threshold row index; 0 is the best class
        public readonly int ThresholdIndex;
        public readonly float QualityMultiplier;
        public readonly float LayerFailRate;
        public readonly float DieLossRate;

        public CleanRoomClassYield(int thresholdIndex, float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate)
        {
            ThresholdIndex = thresholdIndex;
            QualityMultiplier = qualityMultiplier;
            LayerFailRate = layerFailRate;
            DieLossRate = dieLossRate;
        }

        // 閾値行の値をマスタから読む。部屋の効果の押し込みと、改善の差分の仮の部屋クラスが共有する
        // Read a threshold row's values from the master; shared by the room-effect push and the hypothetical class of the improvement deltas
        public static CleanRoomClassYield FromThresholdIndex(int thresholdIndex)
        {
            var row = MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.Thresholds[thresholdIndex];
            return new CleanRoomClassYield(thresholdIndex, row.QualityMultiplier, row.LayerFailRate, row.DieLossRate);
        }

        // 昇格の目標の行（今の行の1つ上。Out〈行数〉からはいちばん下の行）。いちばん良い行（添字0）には無い。「いちばん良いクラスか」の判定はここ1か所で、改善の計算・台数の数え上げ・見通しが呼ぶ
        // The promotion target row (one above the current row; the lowest row from Out, the row count); none at the best row (index 0). The only best-class check, called by the improvement deltas, the unit count and the outlook
        public static bool TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(int currentIndex, out int targetIndex)
        {
            targetIndex = currentIndex - 1;
            return 0 < currentIndex;
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C2: 品質モジュールを「あと1個刺せるか」と、効いているモジュールの一覧を出す

改善の差分の「品質モジュールを1個足す」行は、枠に空きが無い・上限に達しているときに出さない（ADR 0105 §4）。判定の持ち主はモジュール欄（`VanillaMachineModuleInventory`。既に `IsModuleEffective`・`GetSlotStackLimit` を持つ）。仮に1個足した効果を同じ集計で出すため、集計の材料（上限で切った装着一覧）も外へ出す。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/VanillaMachineModuleInventory.cs`（84 の後に足す）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Module/MachineModuleEffectComponent.cs`（24-47）
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/MachineModuleEquipOneMoreTest.cs`（新）

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(Guid)`・`ModuleMasterElement.ItemGuid/EffectAxis/Tier`・`IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup.CurrentStackLimit`
- Produces:
  - `public bool VanillaMachineModuleInventory.CanAcceptOneMore(ModuleMasterElement module)`
  - `public List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> MachineModuleEffectComponent.CollectEffectiveModules()`
  - `public bool MachineModuleEffectComponent.CanEquipOneMore(ModuleMasterElement module)`

- [ ] **Step 1: テストを書く** — `Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/MachineModuleEquipOneMoreTest.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     品質モジュールをあと1個刺せるか（空き・同じモジュールの上限未満）と、上限で切った装着一覧を検証する
    ///     Verifies whether one more quality module fits (an empty slot or the same module below the limit) and the limit-clipped loadout
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineModuleEquipOneMoreTest
    {
        // TestElectricMachine は品質可・入力2・出力3・モジュール4。上限は研究前の3
        // TestElectricMachine allows quality and has 2 inputs, 3 outputs and 4 module slots; the limit is 3 before research
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = 5;
        private const int ModuleSlotCount = 4;

        [Test]
        public void EmptySlotOrSameModuleBelowLimitAcceptsOneMoreTest()
        {
            var (inventory, effectComponent) = Setup();
            var tier1 = QualityModuleOfTier(1);
            var tier2 = QualityModuleOfTier(2);

            // 空きスロットがあればどの品質モジュールも入る
            // With an empty slot any quality module fits
            Assert.IsTrue(effectComponent.CanEquipOneMore(tier2));

            // 全スロットを tier1×2 で埋めると、tier1 は上限未満のスロットに入り、tier2 は入らない
            // With every slot holding tier1 x2, tier1 fits a slot below the limit and tier2 does not
            for (var slot = 0; slot < ModuleSlotCount; slot++) inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart + slot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(tier1.ItemGuid, 2));
            Assert.IsTrue(effectComponent.CanEquipOneMore(tier1));
            Assert.IsFalse(effectComponent.CanEquipOneMore(tier2));

            // 全スロットが上限3に達すると tier1 も入らない
            // Once every slot reaches the limit of 3, tier1 does not fit either
            for (var slot = 0; slot < ModuleSlotCount; slot++) inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart + slot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(tier1.ItemGuid, 3));
            Assert.IsFalse(effectComponent.CanEquipOneMore(tier1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void CollectEffectiveModulesClipsCountToTheLimitTest()
        {
            var (inventory, effectComponent) = Setup();
            var tier1 = QualityModuleOfTier(1);

            // 判定を通さずに5個書いても、集めた個数は上限の3
            // Even with 5 written past the check, the collected count is the limit of 3
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(tier1.ItemGuid, 5));
            var modules = effectComponent.CollectEffectiveModules();
            Assert.AreEqual(1, modules.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(tier1, modules[0].Module);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, modules[0].Count);
        }

        private static (VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, MachineModuleEffectComponent effectComponent) Setup()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return (block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>(), block.GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>());
        }

        // テストマスタの品質モジュールのアイテム（tier1 は ...1234-000000000005、tier2 は ...1234-000000000006）
        // Test-master quality module items (tier 1 is ...1234-000000000005, tier 2 is ...1234-000000000006)
        private static readonly System.Guid[] QualityModuleItemGuids =
        {
            System.Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000005"),
            System.Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000006"),
        };

        private static ModuleMasterElement QualityModuleOfTier(int tier)
        {
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetModuleByItemIdOrNull(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(QualityModuleItemGuids[tier - 1]));
            Assert.AreEqual(tier, module.Tier, $"tier {tier} quality module is missing in the test master");
            return module;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        // Whether one more of the module fits effectively: an empty slot, or a slot of the same item below the limit
        public bool CanAcceptOneMore(ModuleMasterElement module)
```

```csharp
        public MachineModuleEffect AggregateCurrent()
```

```csharp
        // 効いているモジュールを上限で切った個数で集める。集計と、改善の差分（仮に1個足す）が共有する
        // Collect the effective modules with counts clipped to the limit; shared by the aggregate and the improvement deltas (adding one hypothetically)
        public List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> CollectEffectiveModules()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);

            // スロットのアイテムをモジュール定義へ解決する

            var modules = new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule>();
            foreach (var stack in _moduleInventory.ModuleSlot)

                var effectiveCount = Math.Min(stack.Count, _moduleInventory.GetSlotStackLimit());
```

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    public class CleanRoomFinalOddsTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void DicingFinalOddsMultiplySurvivalAndLeaveTheRestAsFailureTest()
        {
            var (dicing, _) = LoadRoles();

            // 損失0.2・良品内訳 [0.5, 0.3, 0]・失敗ダイ0.2 → Lv1 0.8×0.5=0.4、Lv2 0.8×0.3=0.24、失敗 0.2+0.8×0.2=0.36
            // Loss 0.2, survivor split [0.5, 0.3, 0], failed 0.2 -> Lv1 0.4, Lv2 0.24, failure 0.2 + 0.8 x 0.2 = 0.36
            var odds = (DicingFinalOdds)CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(dicing, new DicingPreview(0.2, 1, new[] { 0.5, 0.3, 0d }, 0.2));
            Assert.AreEqual(300, odds.OutputCount);
            Assert.That(odds.LevelRates, Is.EqualTo(new[] { 0.4, 0.24, 0d }).Within(1e-9));
            Assert.AreEqual(0.36, odds.FailedRate, 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void LayerExposureFinalOddsIsTheLayerFailRateTest()
        {
            var (_, layer) = LoadRoles();

            // EUV はLv別を持たず、失敗＝層の失敗率
            // EUV has no levels and its failure is the layer fail rate
            var odds = CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(layer, new LayerExposurePreview(0.308));
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<LayerExposureFinalOdds>(odds);
            Assert.IsEmpty(odds.LevelRates);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.308, odds.FailedRate, 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MismatchedRoleAndRatePairsThrowTest()
        {
            var (dicing, layer) = LoadRoles();

            // 役割と率の組の食い違いは呼び出し側の約束違反
            // Mismatched role/rate pairs break the caller's contract
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(dicing, new LayerExposurePreview(0.308)));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(layer, new DicingPreview(0.2, 1, new[] { 0.5, 0.3, 0d }, 0.2)));
        }

        private static (CleanRoomRecipeRole dicing, CleanRoomRecipeRole layer) LoadRoles()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            Assert.IsTrue(MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, out var dicing));
            Assert.IsTrue(MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomLayerExposureRecipe, out var layer));
            return (dicing, layer);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     改善の差分（部屋クラスを1つ上げる・品質モジュールを1個足す）の値・並び・変わらない行の除外を固定する
    ///     Pins the improvement deltas (one class up, one more quality module), their order and the dropping of rows that change nothing
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomYieldImprovementCalculatorTest
    {
        private const double Tolerance = 1e-5;

        [Test]
        public void ClassCDicingListsRoomUpThenHighestTierThenNextTierTest()
        {
            var (dicing, _) = LoadRoles();
            var tier1 = QualityModule(1);
            var tier2 = QualityModule(2);

            // クラスC×tier1 1個から、クラスB・tier1 を1個足す・tier2 を1個足す の順に並ぶ
            // From class C with one tier-1 module the rows run: class B, one more tier 1, one tier 2
            var improvements = Compute(dicing, 2, Loadout(tier1, 1), tier1, tier2);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, improvements.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual("B", ((CleanRoomRoomClassUpImprovement)improvements[0]).TargetClassName);
            AssertDeltas(improvements[0], new[] { 0.082964, 0.013456, 0d }, -0.096420);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, ((CleanRoomAddQualityModuleImprovement)improvements[1]).ModuleTier);
            AssertDeltas(improvements[1], new[] { 0.123621, 0.022433, 0d }, -0.146055);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, ((CleanRoomAddQualityModuleImprovement)improvements[2]).ModuleTier);
            AssertDeltas(improvements[2], new[] { -0.226974, 0.294261, 0.047321 }, -0.114608);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ClassAWithoutModulesListsOnlyTheTier1AdditionTest()
        {
            var (dicing, _) = LoadRoles();
            var tier1 = QualityModule(1);

            // クラスAより上は無いので部屋クラスの行は出ず、tier1 を1個足す行だけになる
            // Nothing is above class A, so no room-class row appears and only the one-tier-1 row remains
            var improvements = Compute(dicing, 0, new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule>(), tier1);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, improvements.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, ((CleanRoomAddQualityModuleImprovement)improvements[0]).ModuleTier);
            AssertDeltas(improvements[0], new[] { 0.321749, 0.061316, 0d }, -0.383065);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SaturatedLayerExposureListsNothingTest()
        {
            var (_, layer) = LoadRoles();
            var tier1 = QualityModule(1);
            var tier2 = QualityModule(2);

            // EUV のクラスA×tier1 1個は品質合計1.0が低減の上限0.8を超えているので、どれを足しても失敗は変わらない
            // EUV in class A with one tier-1 module already exceeds the 0.8 reduction cap, so no addition changes the failure
            Assert.IsEmpty(Compute(layer, 0, Loadout(tier1, 1), tier1, tier2));
        }

        [Test]
        public void LayerExposureDeltasCarryOnlyTheFailureTest()
        {
            var (_, layer) = LoadRoles();
            var tier1 = QualityModule(1);

            // EUV のクラスC×モジュール無しは失敗0.2。クラスBで0.15、tier1 1個で 0.2×(1−0.8)=0.04
            // EUV in class C without modules fails at 0.2; class B gives 0.15 and one tier-1 module gives 0.2 x (1 - 0.8) = 0.04
            var improvements = Compute(layer, 2, new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule>(), tier1);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, improvements.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual("B", ((CleanRoomRoomClassUpImprovement)improvements[0]).TargetClassName);
            AssertDeltas(improvements[0], Array.Empty<double>(), -0.05);
            AssertDeltas(improvements[1], Array.Empty<double>(), -0.16);
        }

        // 部品と同じく、今の最終の内訳を1回だけ出して計算へ渡す
        // As the component does, derive the current final odds once and hand them to the calculator
        private static List<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> Compute(CleanRoomRecipeRole role, int thresholdIndex, List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> equipped, params ModuleMasterElement[] candidates)
        {
            var classYield = CleanRoomClassYield.FromThresholdIndex(thresholdIndex);
            var current = CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(role, CleanRoomYieldPreview.Evaluate(role, classYield, MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(equipped), null, out _));
            return CleanRoomYieldImprovementCalculator.Compute(role, classYield, equipped, current, candidates);
        }

        private static List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> Loadout(ModuleMasterElement module, int count)
        {
            return new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> { new(module, count) };
        }

        private static void AssertDeltas(CleanRoomYieldImprovement improvement, double[] levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta)
        {
            Assert.That(improvement.LevelRateDeltas, Is.EqualTo(levelRateDeltas).Within(Tolerance));
            Assert.AreEqual(failedRateDelta, improvement.FailedRateDelta, Tolerance);
        }

        // テストマスタの品質モジュールのアイテム（tier1 は ...1234-000000000005、tier2 は ...1234-000000000006）
        // Test-master quality module items (tier 1 is ...1234-000000000005, tier 2 is ...1234-000000000006)
        private static readonly System.Guid[] QualityModuleItemGuids =
        {
            System.Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000005"),
            System.Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000006"),
        };

        private static ModuleMasterElement QualityModule(int tier)
        {
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetModuleByItemIdOrNull(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(QualityModuleItemGuids[tier - 1]));
            Assert.AreEqual(tier, module.Tier, $"tier {tier} quality module is missing in the test master");
            return module;
        }

        private static (CleanRoomRecipeRole dicing, CleanRoomRecipeRole layer) LoadRoles()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            Assert.IsTrue(MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, out var dicing));
            Assert.IsTrue(MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomLayerExposureRecipe, out var layer));
            return (dicing, layer);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine

    /// <summary>
    ///     差分に並べる品質モジュール（刺さっている最高 tier を増やす・1つ上を刺す）が装着と空きに従うことを固定する

    public class CleanRoomQualityModuleCandidatesTest
    {
        // 工程用テスト機械はモジュール3枠・品質可。上限は研究前の3
        // The process test machine has 3 module slots and allows quality; the limit is 3 before research
        private const int ModuleSlotCount = 3;

        [Test]
        public void CandidatesFollowTheHighestEquippedTierAndFreeSpaceTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            var tier1 = QualityModule(1);
            var tier2 = QualityModule(2);

            // 何も刺さっていなければ tier1 を1個刺す候補だけ
            // With nothing equipped the only candidate is one tier-1 module
            Assert.That(CandidateTiers(machine), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 1 }));

            // tier1 が1個なら tier1 を増やす候補と tier2 を刺す候補
            // With one tier-1 module: more tier 1, then one tier 2
            SetModule(machine, 0, tier1, 1);
            Assert.That(CandidateTiers(machine), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 1, 2 }));

            // tier2 が最高なら tier2 を増やす候補だけ（テストマスタに tier3 は無い）
            // With tier 2 the highest, only more tier 2 remains (the test master has no tier 3)
            SetModule(machine, 0, tier2, 1);
            Assert.That(CandidateTiers(machine), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 2 }));

            // 3枠とも tier1×3 なら増やせず空きも無いので候補なし
            // With all three slots at tier1 x3 nothing can be added and no slot is free
            for (var slot = 0; slot < ModuleSlotCount; slot++) SetModule(machine, slot, tier1, 3);
            Assert.IsEmpty(CandidateTiers(machine));

            // 3枠とも tier1×1 なら tier1 は増やせるが、tier2 を刺す空きは無い
            // With all three slots at tier1 x1, tier 1 can grow but no slot is free for tier 2
            for (var slot = 0; slot < ModuleSlotCount; slot++) SetModule(machine, slot, tier1, 1);
            Assert.That(CandidateTiers(machine), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 1 }));
        }

        private static int[] CandidateTiers(IBlock machine)
        {
            var effectComponent = machine.GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>();
            var highestTier = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(effectComponent.CollectEffectiveModules()).HighestQualityModuleTier;
            return CleanRoomQualityModuleCandidates.Select(effectComponent, highestTier).Select(module => module.Tier).ToArray();
        }

        private static void SetModule(IBlock machine, int slot, ModuleMasterElement module, int count)
        {
            machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>().SetItem(FirstModuleSlot + slot, MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(module.ItemGuid), count);
        }

        // テストマスタの品質モジュールのアイテム（tier1 は ...1234-000000000005、tier2 は ...1234-000000000006）
        // Test-master quality module items (tier 1 is ...1234-000000000005, tier 2 is ...1234-000000000006)
        private static readonly System.Guid[] QualityModuleItemGuids =
        {
            System.Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000005"),
            System.Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000006"),
        };

        private static ModuleMasterElement QualityModule(int tier)
        {
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetModuleByItemIdOrNull(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(QualityModuleItemGuids[tier - 1]));
            Assert.AreEqual(tier, module.Tier, $"tier {tier} quality module is missing in the test master");
            return module;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     画面に出す最終の内訳。Lv別の最終割合と失敗を足すと1になる（EUV はLv別が空で、失敗＝層の失敗率）
    ///     Final odds shown on screen; the final per-level rates plus the failure sum to 1 (EUV has no levels and its failure is the layer fail rate)
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomFinalOdds
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<double> LevelRates { get; }
        public double FailedRate { get; }

        private protected CleanRoomFinalOdds(IReadOnlyList<double> levelRates, double failedRate)
        {
            LevelRates = levelRates;
            FailedRate = failedRate;
        }

        // 役割と抽選の率から最終の内訳を作る。組の食い違いは呼び出し側の約束違反なので止める
        // Build final odds from the role and the draw rates; a mismatched pair breaks the caller's contract, so stop
        public static CleanRoomFinalOdds Of(CleanRoomRecipeRole role, CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult rates)
        {
            return (role, rates) switch
            {
                (LayerExposureRecipeRole _, LayerExposurePreview layer) => new LayerExposureFinalOdds(layer.LayerFailRate),
                (DicingRecipeRole dicingRole, DicingPreview dicing) => DicingFinalOdds.From(dicingRole.Dicing.DiesPerWafer, dicing),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(rates), $"{role.GetType().Name}/{rates.GetType().Name}", "最終の内訳を作れない役割と率の組 / No final odds for this role and rate pair"),
            };
        }
    }

    public sealed class LayerExposureFinalOdds : CleanRoomFinalOdds
    {
        public LayerExposureFinalOdds(double layerFailRate) : base(Array.Empty<double>(), layerFailRate)
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class DicingFinalOdds : CleanRoomFinalOdds
    {
        // レシピの出力個数（ウェハ1枚のダイ数）
        // The recipe's output count (dies per wafer)
        public int OutputCount { get; }

        private DicingFinalOdds(int outputCount, IReadOnlyList<double> levelRates, double failedRate) : base(levelRates, failedRate)
        {
            OutputCount = outputCount;
        }

        // Lv N の最終割合＝(1−損失率)×Lv N の割合。失敗は残り全部（抽選が残りを失敗ダイにするのと同じ）
        // Final Lv N = (1 - loss) x Lv N rate; the failure is the whole remainder, as the draw turns the remainder into failed dies
        public static DicingFinalOdds From(int outputCount, DicingPreview dicing)
        {
            var survivalRate = 1d - dicing.DieLossRate;
            var levelRates = new double[dicing.LevelRates.Count];
            var levelSum = 0d;
            for (var i = 0; i < levelRates.Length; i++)
            {
                levelRates[i] = survivalRate * dicing.LevelRates[i];
                levelSum += levelRates[i];
            }
            return new DicingFinalOdds(outputCount, levelRates, 1d - levelSum);
        }
    }
}
```
