```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     抽選と同じ式に仮の部屋クラス・仮の装着を入れ、今との差分を並べる。数字が変わらない行は並べない
    ///     Feeds a hypothetical room class or loadout into the draw's own formula and lists the differences from now, dropping rows that change nothing
    /// </summary>
    internal static class CleanRoomYieldImprovementCalculator
    {
        // 表示の最小単位（0.1%）の半分。全項目の差分がこれ未満なら「数字が変わらない」
        // Half of the display step (0.1%); a row whose every delta is below this "changes nothing"
        public const double VisibleDeltaThreshold = 0.0005;

        // 並びは 部屋クラスを1つ上げる → 候補の品質モジュールを1個ずつ足す（候補の順）。current は部品が同じ装着から1回だけ出した今の最終の内訳
        // Order: one class up, then one more of each candidate quality module in candidate order; current is the final odds the component derived once from the same loadout
        public static List<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> Compute(CleanRoomRecipeRole role, CleanRoomClassYield classYield, IReadOnlyList<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> equipped, CleanRoomFinalOdds current, IReadOnlyList<ModuleMasterElement> addableQualityModules)
        {
            var improvements = new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovement>();
            AddRoomClassUp();
            foreach (var module in addableQualityModules) AddQualityModule(module);
            return improvements;

            #region Internal

            void AddRoomClassUp()
            {
                // いちばん良いクラス（添字0）より上は無い。判定は C1 の1か所に任せる
                // Nothing is above the best class (index 0); the check is left to the single one from C1
                if (!CleanRoomClassYield.TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(classYield.ThresholdIndex, out var targetIndex)) return;
                var odds = OddsOf(CleanRoomClassYield.FromThresholdIndex(targetIndex), equipped);
                if (!TryGetVisibleDeltas(odds, out var levelDeltas, out var failedDelta)) return;
                var className = MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.Thresholds[targetIndex].ClassName;
                improvements.Add(new CleanRoomRoomClassUpImprovement(className, levelDeltas, failedDelta));
            }

            void AddQualityModule(ModuleMasterElement module)
            {
                // 今の装着にちょうど1個足した仮の装着で同じ式を回す
                // Run the same formula on a hypothetical loadout with exactly one more of the module
                var withOneMore = new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule>(equipped) { new(module, 1) };
                var odds = OddsOf(classYield, withOneMore);
                if (!TryGetVisibleDeltas(odds, out var levelDeltas, out var failedDelta)) return;
                improvements.Add(new CleanRoomAddQualityModuleImprovement(module.Tier, levelDeltas, failedDelta));
            }

            // 仮の条件で、抽選と同じ役割分岐（Evaluate）を抽選なしで回す
            // Run the draw's own role dispatch (Evaluate) without rolling, under the hypothetical condition
            CleanRoomFinalOdds OddsOf(CleanRoomClassYield yieldOfClass, IReadOnlyList<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> modules)
            {
                var rates = CleanRoomYieldPreview.Evaluate(role, yieldOfClass, MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(modules), null, out _);
                return CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(role, rates);
            }

            // 今との差（Lv別と失敗）をここで1回だけ出し、見せるかの判定と行の組み立ての両方に同じ値を使う。失敗かLvのどれか1つでも表示で見える差があれば true
            // Derive the deltas from now (per level and failure) once here and use the same values for both the visibility check and the row; true when the failure or any level differs by a visible amount
            bool TryGetVisibleDeltas(CleanRoomFinalOdds odds, out double[] levelDeltas, out double failedDelta)
            {
                failedDelta = odds.FailedRate - current.FailedRate;
                levelDeltas = new double[odds.LevelRates.Count];
                var isVisible = VisibleDeltaThreshold <= Math.Abs(failedDelta);
                for (var i = 0; i < levelDeltas.Length; i++)
                {
                    levelDeltas[i] = odds.LevelRates[i] - current.LevelRates[i];
                    if (VisibleDeltaThreshold <= Math.Abs(levelDeltas[i])) isVisible = true;
                }
                return isVisible;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     改善の差分に並べる品質モジュールを選ぶ。今刺さっている最高 tier のものと、その1つ上の tier のもの。あと1個刺せないものは外す
    ///     Picks the quality modules for the improvement list: the highest equipped tier and the tier above it, dropping any that cannot take one more
    /// </summary>
    internal static class CleanRoomQualityModuleCandidates
    {
        // highestTier は部品が抽選と同じ集計（MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate）で1回だけ出した HighestQualityModuleTier。品質モジュールが無ければ0
        // highestTier is the HighestQualityModuleTier the component took once from the draw's own aggregate (MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate); zero without quality modules
        public static List<ModuleMasterElement> Select(MachineModuleEffectComponent effectComponent, int highestTier)
        {
            var candidates = new List<ModuleMasterElement>();

            // 刺さっている最高 tier のものを1個増やす。上限か空きで入らなければ並べない
            // One more of the highest equipped tier, unless the limit or free space keeps it out
            if (0 < highestTier && TryGetQualityModuleOfTier(highestTier, out var highest) && effectComponent.CanEquipOneMore(highest)) candidates.Add(highest);

            // その1つ上の tier を1個刺す。品質モジュールが無ければ tier1。マスタに無い tier（最上位の次）は並べない
            // One of the next tier; tier 1 when no quality module is equipped; a tier missing from the master (past the top) is not listed
            if (TryGetQualityModuleOfTier(highestTier + 1, out var nextTier) && effectComponent.CanEquipOneMore(nextTier)) candidates.Add(nextTier);
            return candidates;

            #region Internal

            // 指定 tier の品質モジュール定義。同じ tier が複数あればマスタの並びで先のもの。モジュールを定義しないマスタ（items.yml で optional）では false
            // The quality module of the tier; with several of one tier the first in master order; false for a master defining no modules (optional in items.yml)
            static bool TryGetQualityModuleOfTier(int tier, out ModuleMasterElement module)
            {
                module = null;
                if (MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules == null) return false;
                foreach (var candidate in MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules)
                {
                    if (candidate.EffectAxis != ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality || candidate.Tier != tier) continue;
                    module = candidate;
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master.CleanRoomRoles;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.OutputRewrite;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     工程の抽選に使う率を抽選と同じ口（CleanRoomRoleRates）から求める。表示・改善の差分・実抽選が同じ役割分岐を通る
    ///     Computes a process's draw rates through the draw's own entry point (CleanRoomRoleRates); display, improvement deltas and actual draws share one role dispatch
    /// </summary>
    internal static class CleanRoomYieldPreview
    {
        // Previewと実抽選を同じ役割分岐で選ぶ
        // Select preview and actual draw through one role dispatch
        internal static CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult Evaluate(CleanRoomRecipeRole role, CleanRoomClassYield classYield, MachineModuleEffect moduleEffect,
            CleanRoomYieldRollContext? roll, out List<IItemStack> outputs)
        {
            outputs = null;
            switch (role)
            {
                case LayerExposureRecipeRole layer:
                    if (roll.HasValue) outputs = LayerExposureOutputRewriter.Rewrite(layer, roll.Value);
                    return new LayerExposurePreview(CleanRoomRoleRates.LayerFailRate(layer, classYield, moduleEffect));
                case DicingRecipeRole dicing:
                    var dicingPreview = CleanRoomRoleRates.Dicing(dicing, classYield, moduleEffect);
                    if (roll.HasValue) outputs = DicingOutputRewriter.Rewrite(dicing, dicingPreview, roll.Value);
                    return dicingPreview;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(role), role.GetType().Name, "未対応の清浄室工程の役割 / Unsupported clean-room recipe role");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
    ///     Draw-detail query result; always exactly one of the per-kind types (no role, room not operable, with odds), and only the with-odds type carries numbers, always
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport
    {

    // With odds (EUV, dicing): always carries the final odds under current conditions and the improvement list in display order
    public sealed class CleanRoomOddsYieldReport : CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport
    {
        public CleanRoomFinalOdds Odds { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> Improvements { get; }

        // The next draw's rates and a fixed draw's rates waiting for output space (null when none), kept only for the old wire keys 3-6 and removed in C7
        public CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult Next { get; }
        public CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult PendingDraw { get; }

        public CleanRoomOddsYieldReport(CleanRoomFinalOdds odds, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> improvements, CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult next, CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult pendingDraw)
        {
            Odds = odds;
            Improvements = improvements;
            Next = next;
```

```csharp
            // サーバーの役割ごとの結果を役割ごとの factory へ写す（クライアントは Game.Block の型を持たない）。出力待ちの確定済み抽選は同じ役割の値として添える
            // Map each per-role server result onto its per-role factory, so the client never holds Game.Block types; a fixed draw waiting for output rides along as the same role's values
            static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateResponse(CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport report)
            {
                var pending = report.PendingDraw;
                return report.Next switch
                {
                    NoRolePreview _ => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateNoRole(),
                    // 稼働できない間は率の欄を出さない（停止理由は部屋欄が出す）ので、確定済みの率も載せない
                    // While the machine cannot operate no rate section is shown (the room section shows the halt reason), so fixed rates are not carried either
                    NotOperablePreview _ => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateNotOperable(),
                    LayerExposurePreview layerExposure => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateLayerExposure(layerExposure.LayerFailRate, pending == null ? null : new LayerExposureYieldMessagePack(RequireSameRole<LayerExposurePreview>(pending).LayerFailRate)),
                    DicingPreview dicing => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateDicing(ToDicingMessagePack(dicing), pending == null ? null : ToDicingMessagePack(RequireSameRole<DicingPreview>(pending))),
                    _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(report.Next), report.Next.GetType().Name, "未対応の抽選の中身 / Unsupported yield preview"),
                };

                // 確定済み抽選は選択レシピのものだけが届くので役割は次の抽選と同じ。違えば部品の約束の破れなので止める
                // Only the selected recipe's fixed draw arrives, so its role matches the next draw; a mismatch breaks the component's contract, so stop
                T RequireSameRole<T>(CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult pendingDraw) where T : CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult
                {
                    return pendingDraw as T ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"確定済み抽選の役割が次の抽選と違います next={report.Next.GetType().Name} pending={pendingDraw.GetType().Name}");
                }
            }
```

直した後（43-64。役割の分岐は数字ありの報告の `Next` の型を property pattern で読む。前例 `Game.SaveLoad/Migration/Steps/V7ToV8/ZeroCostTier9ResearchResetter.cs:87` の `is JValue { Type: ... } value`）:

```csharp
            // サーバーの報告の種別ごとの型を種別ごとの factory へ写す（クライアントは Game.Block の型を持たない）。出力待ちの確定済み抽選は同じ役割の値として添える
            // Map each per-kind server report onto its per-kind factory, so the client never holds Game.Block types; a fixed draw waiting for output rides along as the same role's values
            static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateResponse(CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport report)
            {
                return report switch
                {
                    CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport _ => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateNoRole(),
                    // 稼働できない間は率の欄を出さない（停止理由は部屋欄が出す）ので、確定済みの率も載せない
                    // While the machine cannot operate no rate section is shown (the room section shows the halt reason), so fixed rates are not carried either
                    CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport _ => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateNotOperable(),
                    CleanRoomOddsYieldReport { Next: LayerExposurePreview layerExposure } withOdds => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateLayerExposure(layerExposure.LayerFailRate, withOdds.PendingDraw == null ? null : new LayerExposureYieldMessagePack(RequireSameRole<LayerExposurePreview>(withOdds).LayerFailRate)),
                    CleanRoomOddsYieldReport { Next: DicingPreview dicing } withOdds => ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateDicing(ToDicingMessagePack(dicing), withOdds.PendingDraw == null ? null : ToDicingMessagePack(RequireSameRole<DicingPreview>(withOdds))),
                    _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(report), report.GetType().Name, "未対応の抽選の中身の報告 / Unsupported draw-detail report"),
                };

                // 確定済み抽選は選択レシピのものだけが届くので役割は次の抽選と同じ。違えば部品の約束の破れなので止める
                // Only the selected recipe's fixed draw arrives, so its role matches the next draw; a mismatch breaks the component's contract, so stop
                static T RequireSameRole<T>(CleanRoomOddsYieldReport withOdds) where T : CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult
                {
                    return withOdds.PendingDraw as T ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"確定済み抽選の役割が次の抽選と違います next={withOdds.Next.GetType().Name} pending={withOdds.PendingDraw.GetType().Name}");
                }
            }
```

```csharp
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     室内機械の選択工程について、次の抽選の最終の内訳と改善の差分を答える部品。抽選と同じ入力（選択レシピ・今の部屋の効果・装着モジュール）を読む
    ///     Answers the next draw's final odds and the improvement deltas for an interior machine's selected process, reading the draw's own inputs (selected recipe, current room effect, equipped modules)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent : IBlockComponent
    {
        private readonly IMachineRecipeSelectorComponent _recipeSelector;
        private readonly MachineModuleEffectComponent _moduleEffectComponent;
        private readonly ICleanRoomEffectLookup _effectLookup;
        private readonly IMachinePendingRealizationReader _pendingRealizationReader;

        internal CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent(IMachineRecipeSelectorComponent recipeSelector, MachineModuleEffectComponent moduleEffectComponent, ICleanRoomEffectLookup effectLookup, IMachinePendingRealizationReader pendingRealizationReader)
        {
            _recipeSelector = recipeSelector;
            _moduleEffectComponent = moduleEffectComponent;
            _effectLookup = effectLookup;
            _pendingRealizationReader = pendingRealizationReader;
        }

        public CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport GetPreview()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);

            // 未選択と役割表に無いレシピは数字を持たない
            // Unselected recipes and recipes outside the role tables carry no numbers
            if (!_recipeSelector.TryGetSelectedRecipe(out var recipe)) return CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport.Instance;
            if (!MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(recipe.MachineRecipeGuid, out var role)) return CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport.Instance;

            // 部屋の効果は抽選と同じ持ち主（デコレータ）の読み口から読む。止まっている効果はクラス値を持たないので数字も改善も作らない
            // Read the room effect through the draw owner's (decorator's) read view; a halted effect has no class values, so neither numbers nor improvements are built
            if (!_effectLookup.CurrentEffect.TryGetClassYield(out var classYield)) return CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport.Instance;

            // 装着（上限で切った個数）の集計・次の抽選の率・今の最終の内訳はここで1回だけ出し、候補選びと改善の計算へ渡す
            // Aggregate the loadout (counts clipped to the limit), the next draw's rates and the current final odds once here, and hand them to candidate selection and the improvement calculation
            var equipped = _moduleEffectComponent.CollectEffectiveModules();
            var moduleEffect = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(equipped);
            var next = CleanRoomYieldPreview.Evaluate(role, classYield, moduleEffect, null, out _);
            var current = CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(role, next);
            var candidates = CleanRoomQualityModuleCandidates.Select(_moduleEffectComponent, moduleEffect.HighestQualityModuleTier);
            var improvements = CleanRoomYieldImprovementCalculator.Compute(role, classYield, equipped, current, candidates);
            return new CleanRoomOddsYieldReport(current, improvements, next, FindPendingDraw());

            #region Internal

            // 待機中の確定結果が今の選択レシピのものなら、抽選に使った率を返す（C7 で外す）
            // Return the draw rates when the waiting realization belongs to the selected recipe (removed in C7)
            CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult FindPendingDraw()
            {
                if (!_pendingRealizationReader.TryGetPendingRealization(out var pending) || pending.Recipe != recipe) return null;
                return pending.DrawRecord as CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }

        public void Destroy()
        {
            IsDestroy = true;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using MessagePack;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers;
using Response = Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Server.PacketTest.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     確率の取得が最終の内訳（足して1）と改善の差分を運び、壊れた改善の一覧を読めない扱いにすることを固定する
    ///     Pins that the draw-detail query carries final odds (summing to 1) and improvement deltas, and treats a broken improvement list as unreadable
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomYieldOddsProtocolTest
    {
        private const int TickCap = 4000;
        private const double Tolerance = 1e-5;
        private static readonly Guid TestQualityModuleItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000005");

        [Test]
        public void DicingCarriesFinalOddsAndModuleImprovementsTest()
        {
            var (packet, machine) = SetUpClassAMachine(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, 1);
            var view = ReadView<CleanRoomYieldDicingView>(Invoke(packet, machine.BlockInstanceId));

            // クラスA×tier1 1個の最終の内訳: 出力300個・Lv1 0.491749・Lv2 0.061316・失敗 0.446935（足して1）
            // Final odds for class A with one tier-1 module: 300 outputs, Lv1 0.491749, Lv2 0.061316, failure 0.446935 (summing to 1)
            Assert.AreEqual(300, view.Odds.OutputCount);
            Assert.That(view.Odds.LevelRates, Is.EqualTo(new[] { 0.491749, 0.061316, 0d }).Within(Tolerance));
            Assert.AreEqual(0.446935, view.Odds.FailedRate, Tolerance);
            Assert.AreEqual(1d, view.Odds.LevelRates.Sum() + view.Odds.FailedRate, 1e-9);

            // クラスAより上は無いので部屋クラスの行は無く、tier1 を増やす行・tier2 を刺す行の順に並ぶ
            // Nothing is above class A, so there is no room-class row; the rows are one more tier 1, then one tier 2
            Assert.AreEqual(2, view.Improvements.Count);
            Assert.IsFalse(view.Improvements[0].TryGetRoomClassUp(out _));
            Assert.IsTrue(view.Improvements[0].TryGetAddQualityModule(out var firstTier));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, firstTier);
            Assert.That(view.Improvements[0].LevelRateDeltas, Is.EqualTo(new[] { 0.118365, 0.022557, 0d }).Within(Tolerance));
            Assert.AreEqual(-0.140922, view.Improvements[0].FailedRateDelta, Tolerance);
            Assert.IsTrue(view.Improvements[1].TryGetAddQualityModule(out var secondTier));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, secondTier);
            Assert.That(view.Improvements[1].LevelRateDeltas, Is.EqualTo(new[] { -0.376748, 0.450245, 0.073080 }).Within(Tolerance));
            Assert.AreEqual(-0.146577, view.Improvements[1].FailedRateDelta, Tolerance);

            // どの行の Lv別差分も、同じ応答の最終の内訳と同じ長さ（クライアントが Lv に当てる約束）
            // Every row's per-level deltas match the length of the same response's final odds (the contract the client relies on to map levels)
            foreach (var improvement in view.Improvements) Assert.AreEqual(view.Odds.LevelRates.Length, improvement.LevelRateDeltas.Length);
        }

        [Test]
        public void LayerExposureImprovementsCarryEmptyLevelDeltasTest()
        {
            var (packet, machine) = SetUpClassAMachine(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomLayerExposureRecipe, 0);
            var view = ReadView<CleanRoomYieldLayerExposureView>(Invoke(packet, machine.BlockInstanceId));

            // クラスA×モジュール無しの失敗は 0.10。クラスAより上は無く、tier1 1個で 0.10×(1−0.8)=0.02 になる1行だけ
            // Class A without modules fails at 0.10; nothing is above class A, so the only row is one tier-1 module giving 0.10 x (1 - 0.8) = 0.02
            Assert.AreEqual(0.10, view.Odds.FailedRate, Tolerance);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, view.Improvements.Count);
            Assert.IsTrue(view.Improvements[0].TryGetAddQualityModule(out var tier));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, tier);
            Assert.AreEqual(-0.08, view.Improvements[0].FailedRateDelta, Tolerance);

            // 露光の Lv別差分は wire を通しても null でなく空の配列
            // Layer exposure's per-level deltas arrive through the wire as an empty array, not null
            Assert.IsNotNull(view.Improvements[0].LevelRateDeltas);
            Assert.IsEmpty(view.Improvements[0].LevelRateDeltas);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SaturatedLayerExposureCarriesFailureWithoutImprovementsTest()
        {
            var (packet, machine) = SetUpClassAMachine(ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomLayerExposureRecipe, 1);
            var view = ReadView<CleanRoomYieldLayerExposureView>(Invoke(packet, machine.BlockInstanceId));

            // 失敗は 0.10×(1−min(1.0, 0.8))=0.02。品質は頭打ちでクラスAより上も無いので、改善の行は無い（モーダルのボタンを出さない条件）
            // The failure is 0.10 x (1 - min(1.0, 0.8)) = 0.02; quality is saturated and nothing is above class A, so no rows (the modal button stays hidden)
            Assert.AreEqual(0.02, view.Odds.FailedRate, Tolerance);
            Assert.IsEmpty(view.Improvements);
        }

        [Test]
        public void BrokenImprovementsAreUnreadableWithWarningTest()
        {
            // Lv別差分の長さが最終の内訳と違う行は、壊れた wire として警告し読めない扱いにする
            // A row whose per-level deltas differ in length from the final odds is broken wire: it warns and is unreadable
            var odds = new DicingOddsMessagePack(300, new[] { 0.5, 0.1, 0d }, 0.4);
            var shortDeltas = new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> { CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateAddQualityModule(1, new[] { 0.1, 0.1 }, -0.2) };
            var dicing = Response.CreateDicing(new DicingYieldMessagePack(0.1, 1, new[] { 0.6, 0.1, 0d }, 0.3), null, odds, shortDeltas);
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo\] Dicing response has broken improvements"));
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, dicing.TryReadView(out _));

            // クラス名の無い RoomClassUp も、wire を通した後で読めない
            // A RoomClassUp without a class name is unreadable after the wire as well
            var noClassName = CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateRoomClassUp(null, Array.Empty<double>(), -0.05);
            var layer = Response.CreateLayerExposure(0.1, null, new LayerExposureOddsMessagePack(0.1), new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> { noClassName });
            var received = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<Response>(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(layer));
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo\] LayerExposure response has broken improvements"));
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, received.TryReadView(out _));

            // 最終の内訳が欠けた応答は入れ子の欠けとして読めない
            // A response missing its final odds is unreadable as a missing nested object
            var noOdds = Response.CreateDicing(new DicingYieldMessagePack(0.1, 1, new[] { 0.6, 0.1, 0d }, 0.3), null, null, new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack>());
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo\] Dicing response has no"));
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, noOdds.TryReadView(out _));
        }

        private static (PacketResponseCreator packet, IBlock machine) SetUpClassAMachine(Guid recipeGuid, int tier1ModuleCount)
        {
            var (packet, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            if (0 < tier1ModuleCount) machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>().SetItem(FirstModuleSlot, MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(TestQualityModuleItemGuid), tier1ModuleCount);
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(machine, MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(recipeGuid));
            Assert.IsTrue(WaitForClassA(serviceProvider.GetService<CleanRoomDatastore>(), filter, machine, TickCap));

            // クラスAに上がったtickの効果の押し込みを、もう1tick回して確実に済ませる
            // Run one more tick so the effect push for the tick that reached class A has surely happened
            TickRoom(filter, machine);
            return (packet, machine);
        }

        private static Response Invoke(PacketResponseCreator packet, BlockInstanceId id)
        {
            var request = new GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.RequestCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(id);
            var responseBytes = packet.GetPacketResponse(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(request), Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity.BoundPacketContext.Bind(1));
            return MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<Response>(responseBytes[0]);
        }

        private static TView ReadView<TView>(Response response) where TView : CleanRoomYieldView
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Success, response.TryReadView(out var view), $"kind={response.Kind}");
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<TView>(view);
            return (TView)view;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    // EUV の最終の内訳（失敗の割合だけ）
    // EUV final odds (only the failure)
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class LayerExposureOddsMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public double FailedRate { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public LayerExposureOddsMessagePack() { }

        public LayerExposureOddsMessagePack(double failedRate)
        {
            FailedRate = failedRate;
        }
    }

    // ダイシングの最終の内訳（出力個数・Lv別の最終割合・失敗。Lv別と失敗を足すと1）
    // Dicing final odds (output count, final per-level rates, failure; the levels plus the failure sum to 1)
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class DicingOddsMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public int OutputCount { get; set; }
        [Key(1)] public double[] LevelRates { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public double FailedRate { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public DicingOddsMessagePack() { }

        public DicingOddsMessagePack(int outputCount, double[] levelRates, double failedRate)
        {
            OutputCount = outputCount;
            LevelRates = levelRates;
            FailedRate = failedRate;
        }
    }
}
```

`CleanRoom/Yield/CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.cs`（新）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     「失敗率の改善方法」の1行。組み立ては種別ごとの static factory、種別ごとの値の読み出しは TryGet に閉じる
    ///     One row of the improvement list; built only through per-kind static factories and read only through the TryGet methods
    /// </summary>
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind Kind { get; set; }

        // TargetClassName は RoomClassUp、ModuleTier は AddQualityModule のときだけ書かれる
        // TargetClassName is written only for RoomClassUp and ModuleTier only for AddQualityModule
        [Key(1)] public string TargetClassName { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public int ModuleTier { get; set; }

        // 今との差分（仮の条件 − 今）。ダイシングは最終の内訳と同じ長さ、EUV は空
        // Difference from now (hypothetical minus current); dicing matches the final odds' length, EUV is empty
        [Key(3)] public double[] LevelRateDeltas { get; set; }
        [Key(4)] public double FailedRateDelta { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack() { }

        private CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind kind, double[] levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta)
        {
            Kind = kind;
            LevelRateDeltas = levelRateDeltas;
            FailedRateDelta = failedRateDelta;
        }

        public static CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack CreateRoomClassUp(string targetClassName, double[] levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta)
        {
            return new CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind.RoomClassUp, levelRateDeltas, failedRateDelta) { TargetClassName = targetClassName };
        }

        public static CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack CreateAddQualityModule(int moduleTier, double[] levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta)
        {
            return new CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind.AddQualityModule, levelRateDeltas, failedRateDelta) { ModuleTier = moduleTier };
        }

        public bool TryGetRoomClassUp(out string targetClassName)
        {
            targetClassName = Kind == CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind.RoomClassUp ? TargetClassName : default;
            return Kind == CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind.RoomClassUp;
        }

        public bool TryGetAddQualityModule(out int moduleTier)
        {
            moduleTier = Kind == CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind.AddQualityModule ? ModuleTier : default;
            return Kind == CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind.AddQualityModule;
        }

        // 外から届いた一覧が読めるか。各行の判別子・RoomClassUp のクラス名・Lv別差分の長さ（最終の内訳のLv数）を確かめる。検査はここ1か所で、読み口が呼び、クライアントで要るときもこれを呼ぶ
        // Whether a list from outside is readable: each row's discriminator, the RoomClassUp class name and the per-level delta length (the final odds' level count); the only copy of this check, called by the reader and by the client whenever it needs one
        public static bool AreReadable(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> improvements, int levelCount)
        {
            if (improvements == null) return false;
            foreach (var improvement in improvements)
            {
                if (improvement == null || improvement.LevelRateDeltas == null) return false;
                if (improvement.LevelRateDeltas.Length != levelCount) return false;
                if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind), improvement.Kind)) return false;
                if (improvement.Kind == CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind.RoomClassUp && improvement.TargetClassName == null) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // 改善の種別。部屋クラスを1つ上げる／品質モジュールを1個足す
    // Improvement kinds: raise the room class by one, or add one quality module
    public enum CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind
    {
        RoomClassUp,
        AddQualityModule,
    }
}
```

`CleanRoom/Yield/CleanRoomYieldResponseFactory.cs`（新。C3 で直した `GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.GetResponse` の `#region Internal`〈43-71〉をここへ移し、内訳と改善を足す。分岐は報告の種別の型と最終の内訳の型を1つの switch で読む）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview;
using Response = Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーの抽選の中身の報告を応答へ写す（クライアントは Game.Block の型を持たない）
    ///     Maps the server's draw-detail report onto the response, so the client never holds Game.Block types
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomYieldResponseFactory
    {
        public static Response Create(CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport report)
        {
            // 報告の種別と最終の内訳の型ごとに factory へ写す。数字を持たない種別は判別子だけ（停止理由は部屋欄が出す）
            // Map each report kind and final-odds type onto its factory; kinds without numbers carry only the discriminator (the room section shows the halt reason)
            return report switch
            {
                CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport _ => Response.CreateNoRole(),
                CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport _ => Response.CreateNotOperable(),
                CleanRoomOddsYieldReport { Odds: LayerExposureFinalOdds layer } withOdds => Response.CreateLayerExposure(RequireSameRole<LayerExposurePreview>(withOdds, withOdds.Next).LayerFailRate,
                    withOdds.PendingDraw == null ? null : new LayerExposureYieldMessagePack(RequireSameRole<LayerExposurePreview>(withOdds, withOdds.PendingDraw).LayerFailRate),
                    new LayerExposureOddsMessagePack(layer.FailedRate), ToImprovementMessagePacks(withOdds.Improvements)),
                CleanRoomOddsYieldReport { Odds: DicingFinalOdds dicing } withOdds => Response.CreateDicing(ToDicingMessagePack(RequireSameRole<DicingPreview>(withOdds, withOdds.Next)),
                    withOdds.PendingDraw == null ? null : ToDicingMessagePack(RequireSameRole<DicingPreview>(withOdds, withOdds.PendingDraw)),
                    new DicingOddsMessagePack(dicing.OutputCount, dicing.LevelRates.ToArray(), dicing.FailedRate), ToImprovementMessagePacks(withOdds.Improvements)),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(report), report.GetType().Name, "未対応の抽選の中身の報告 / Unsupported draw-detail report"),
            };

            #region Internal

            // 次の抽選と確定済み抽選は最終の内訳と同じ役割のはず（C7 で外す古い項目のためだけの確認）。違えば部品の約束の破れなので止める
            // The next and the fixed draw share the final odds' role (checked only for the old fields removed in C7); a mismatch breaks the component's contract, so stop
            static T RequireSameRole<T>(CleanRoomOddsYieldReport withOdds, CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult result) where T : CleanRoomYieldPreviewResult
            {
                return result as T ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"抽選の中身の役割が最終の内訳と違います odds={withOdds.Odds.GetType().Name} result={result.GetType().Name}");
            }

            // 改善は並びのまま載せる
            // Improvements keep their order
            static List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> ToImprovementMessagePacks(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> improvements)
            {
                return improvements.Select(ToImprovementMessagePack).ToList();
            }

            static DicingYieldMessagePack ToDicingMessagePack(DicingPreview dicing)
            {
                return new DicingYieldMessagePack(dicing.DieLossRate, dicing.QualityTier, dicing.LevelRates.ToArray(), dicing.FailedRate);
            }

            static CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack ToImprovementMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldImprovement improvement)
            {
                var levelDeltas = improvement.LevelRateDeltas.ToArray();
                return improvement switch
                {
                    CleanRoomRoomClassUpImprovement classUp => CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateRoomClassUp(classUp.TargetClassName, levelDeltas, classUp.FailedRateDelta),
                    CleanRoomAddQualityModuleImprovement addModule => CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateAddQualityModule(addModule.ModuleTier, levelDeltas, addModule.FailedRateDelta),
                    _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(improvement), improvement.GetType().Name, "未対応の改善の種別 / Unsupported improvement kind"),
                };
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

`GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.cs` の `GetResponse`（C3 の後の 23-74）直した後（`#region Internal` は factory へ移したので消す。using から `System.Linq` を外す）:

```csharp
        public ProtocolMessagePackBase GetResponse(byte[] payload, int requesterPlayerId)
        {
            var request = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<RequestCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack>(payload);

            // 照会の間にブロックが壊れていれば BlockNotFound を返し、クライアントのポーラーが警告を出す
            // If the block was removed before the query, return BlockNotFound so the client's poller logs a warning
            var block = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(request.BlockInstanceId);
            if (block == null) return ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateBlockNotFound();

            // クライアントは室内機械にだけ問い合わせる。別種のブロックは食い違いとして警告し、正常な NoRole と区別して返す
            // The client only asks interior machines; any other block is a mismatch, warned and returned apart from a genuine NoRole
            if (!block.TryGetComponent<CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent>(out var yieldPreview))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo] block {request.BlockInstanceId} has no CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent; returning UnsupportedTarget");
                return ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateUnsupportedTarget();
            }
            return CleanRoomYieldResponseFactory.Create(yieldPreview.GetPreview());
        }
```

```csharp
        [MessagePackObject]
        public class ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            // wire は判別子と役割ごとの入れ子が並ぶ形。その役割の入れ子だけが書かれ、他は null。組み立ては下の factory、読み出しは TryReadView だけ
            // The wire has a discriminator plus per-role nested objects; only that role's object is written and the rest stay null. Build only via the factories below and read only via TryReadView
            [Key(2)] public CleanRoomYieldResponseKind Kind { get; set; }
            [Key(3)] public LayerExposureYieldMessagePack LayerExposure { get; set; }
            [Key(4)] public DicingYieldMessagePack Dicing { get; set; }

            // 出力の空きを待っている確定済み抽選に使った値（C7 で外す）
            // Values a fixed draw waiting for output space used (removed in C7)
            [Key(5)] public LayerExposureYieldMessagePack PendingLayerExposure { get; set; }
            [Key(6)] public DicingYieldMessagePack PendingDicing { get; set; }

            // 画面に出す最終の内訳と、失敗率の改善方法の行（並べる順）
            // Final odds for the screen and the improvement rows in display order
            [Key(7)] public LayerExposureOddsMessagePack LayerExposureOdds { get; set; }
            [Key(8)] public DicingOddsMessagePack DicingOdds { get; set; }
            [Key(9)] public List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> Improvements { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack() { }

            private ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind kind)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                Kind = kind;
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateBlockNotFound()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.BlockNotFound);
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateUnsupportedTarget()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.UnsupportedTarget);
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateNoRole()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NoRole);
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateNotOperable()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NotOperable);
            }

            // pendingDraw は出力待ちの確定済み抽選の値。待っていなければ null
            // pendingDraw holds the values of a fixed draw waiting for output; null when nothing waits
            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateLayerExposure(double layerFailRate, LayerExposureYieldMessagePack pendingDraw, LayerExposureOddsMessagePack odds, List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> improvements)
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.LayerExposure)
                {
                    LayerExposure = new LayerExposureYieldMessagePack(layerFailRate), PendingLayerExposure = pendingDraw, LayerExposureOdds = odds, Improvements = improvements,
                };
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateDicing(DicingYieldMessagePack dicing, DicingYieldMessagePack pendingDraw, DicingOddsMessagePack odds, List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> improvements)
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.Dicing) { Dicing = dicing, PendingDicing = pendingDraw, DicingOdds = odds, Improvements = improvements };
            }

            // 判別子と確定済み抽選の欄の読み分けは読み口1か所（CleanRoomYieldResponseReader）で行う
            // The single reader (CleanRoomYieldResponseReader) branches on the discriminator and the fixed-draw fields
            public BlockInfoReadResult TryReadView(out CleanRoomYieldView view)
            {
                return CleanRoomYieldResponseReader.Read(this, out view);
            }
        }
```

`CleanRoomYieldResponseReader.cs` の `Read`（12-68）直した後（LayerExposure・Dicing の case と警告を足す。他の case は今のまま）:

```csharp
        public static BlockInfoReadResult Read(Response response, out CleanRoomYieldView view)
        {
            view = default;
            var kind = response.Kind;
            switch (kind)
            {
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NoRole:
                    if (HasPendingDraw()) return WarnMismatchedPending();
                    view = CleanRoomYieldNoRoleView.Instance;
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NotOperable:
                    if (HasPendingDraw()) return WarnMismatchedPending();
                    view = CleanRoomYieldNotOperableView.Instance;
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.LayerExposure:
                    if (response.LayerExposure == null || response.LayerExposureOdds == null) return WarnMissingNested();
                    if (response.PendingDicing != null) return WarnMismatchedPending();
                    if (!CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.AreReadable(response.Improvements, 0)) return WarnBrokenImprovements();
                    view = new CleanRoomYieldLayerExposureView(response.LayerExposure, response.PendingLayerExposure, response.LayerExposureOdds, response.Improvements);
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.Dicing:
                    if (response.Dicing == null || response.Dicing.LevelRates == null) return WarnMissingNested();
                    if (response.DicingOdds == null || response.DicingOdds.LevelRates == null) return WarnMissingNested();
                    if (response.PendingDicing != null && response.PendingDicing.LevelRates == null) return WarnMissingNested();
                    if (response.PendingLayerExposure != null) return WarnMismatchedPending();
                    if (!CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.AreReadable(response.Improvements, response.DicingOdds.LevelRates.Length)) return WarnBrokenImprovements();
                    view = new CleanRoomYieldDicingView(response.Dicing, response.PendingDicing, response.DicingOdds, response.Improvements);
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.BlockNotFound:
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.BlockNotFound;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.UnsupportedTarget:
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.UnsupportedTarget;
                default:
                    Debug.LogWarning($"Unreadable response kind: {kind}");
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable;
            }

            #region Internal

            bool HasPendingDraw()
            {
                return response.PendingLayerExposure != null || response.PendingDicing != null;
            }

            // 外部から届いた wire の食い違いなので例外にせず、警告を出して読めない応答として扱う（ポーラーは値を捨てて再試行する）
            // A mismatch in wire data from outside, so warn instead of throwing and treat it as unreadable (the poller drops the value and retries)
            BlockInfoReadResult WarnMissingNested()
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo] {kind} response has no {kind} details; treating it as unreadable");
                return BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable;
            }

            BlockInfoReadResult WarnMismatchedPending()
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo] {kind} response carries a fixed draw of another role; treating it as unreadable");
                return BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable;
            }

            BlockInfoReadResult WarnBrokenImprovements()
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo] {kind} response has broken improvements; treating it as unreadable");
                return BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable;
            }

            #endregion
        }
```

### Task C5: 次のクラスまでに足す台数を数える純関数と、その材料

- [ ] **Step 3: 実装を書く**

`CleanRoomPurityLogic.cs` の `DecideThresholdIndex`（22-36）の後に足す（ファイル先頭に `using System;` と `using Game.Block.Interface.Component;` を足す。`Game.CleanRoom.asmdef` は `Game.Block.Interface` を参照済み。38 → 63 行）:

```csharp
        // 今の除去量に「新しく置く1台」を1台ずつ足し、一つ上の行へ昇格する最小台数を数える。置いた台の分だけ空きセルが減り、空きが尽きても届かなければ false
        // Add "one more unit" at a time to the current removal and count the fewest units that promote to the next better row; each unit takes its cells from the volume, and false when the free cells run out first
        public static bool TryCountUnitsToPromote(int currentIndex, double removalVolumePerSecond, int volume, double unitRemovalVolumePerSecond, int unitCellCount, IReadOnlyList<double> requiredAirChangeRates, out int units)
        {
            // セルを占めない台は数えると終わらないので、ブロックの形の約束違反として止める
            // A unit occupying no cell would never end the count, so treat it as a broken block-shape contract
            if (unitCellCount <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(unitCellCount), unitCellCount, "清浄機は1セル以上を占める / A purifier occupies at least one cell");

            units = 0;
            if (!CleanRoomClassYield.TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(currentIndex, out var targetIndex)) return false;

            // 昇格の判定はクラス判定と同じ関数（昇格倍率込み）に任せる
            // Leave the promotion decision to the class decision's own function, margin included
            for (var count = 1; 0 < volume - count * unitCellCount; count++)
            {
                var airChangeRate = AirChangeRate(removalVolumePerSecond + count * unitRemovalVolumePerSecond, volume - count * unitCellCount);
                if (targetIndex < DecideThresholdIndex(currentIndex, airChangeRate, requiredAirChangeRates)) continue;
                units = count;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
```

### Task C6: 部屋の要約に清浄機の台数のまとめと次のクラスまでの台数を載せる（`va:getCleanRoomInfo`）

ADR 0105 §5。経路は今の部屋の取得（`GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol` → `CleanRoomInfoQuery`）のまま、部屋の要約に4項目（台数・止まっている台数・次のクラス・照会した清浄機自身の状態）を**足す**。台数は「照会した清浄機と同じ種類を1台ずつ置く」として数える。清浄機の画面の「この清浄機: 電力 100% / 残量 50%」の行（判断 22）は、部屋の全清浄機の一覧（`AirFilters`）から探さず、照会した清浄機自身の状態1つで運ぶ。機械から引いた照会では「清浄機ではない」種別になる。一覧は C7 で外す。機械から引いた照会は台数を数えない（機械の画面は部屋クラスの1行だけ。裁定 `2026-11-20-機械の画面の部屋の情報は1行にし清浄機の一覧は機械から外す`）。サーバーの中では「機械から聞いたか・清浄機から聞いたか」を照会の出どころ `CleanRoomQueriedFrom` の1つの区別で持ち、清浄機から聞いたときだけ自身の状態と見通しを必ず持つ（判断 25）。wire の形は判断 26 のとおり「種別＋欄」のまま。

- [ ] **Step 1: テストを書く** — `Tests/CombinedTest/Core/CleanRoom/Usability/CleanRoomNextClassQueryTest.cs`

```csharp
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info;
using Game.Context;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Usability
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋の要約の清浄機の台数・止まっている台数・次のクラスまでの台数を固定する
    ///     Pins the room summary's purifier count, stopped count and units to the next class
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomNextClassQueryTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void StoppedPurifierCountsUnitsFromOutToTheLowestClassTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 電線の無い清浄機は電力0で止まっている（除去0）。新しく置く1台は電力100%・フィルターありの除去5で数える
            // A purifier without wires is stopped at zero power (no removal); the unit to place counts as removal 5 at full power with a filter
            var airFilter = filter.GetComponent<ICleanRoomAirFilter>();
            Assert.AreEqual(0d, airFilter.RemovalVolumePerSecond);
            Assert.AreEqual(5d, airFilter.RatedRemovalVolumePerSecond);

            // 部屋は Out のまま。1台（1セル）置けば 5/25=0.2 でいちばん下の D 以上に上がるので「D まであと1台」
            // The room stays Out; one more 1-cell unit gives 5/25 = 0.2, reaching at least the lowest class D, so "1 more to D"
            var room = AsEnclosed(new CleanRoomInfoQuery(datastore, ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore).Query(filter)).Room;
            Assert.AreEqual(1, room.AirFilterCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, room.StoppedAirFilterCount);
            var queried = AsQueriedFromAirFilter(room);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomUnitsToNextClassOutlook>(queried.NextClass);
            var units = (CleanRoomUnitsToNextClassOutlook)queried.NextClass;
            Assert.AreEqual("D", units.NextClassName);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, units.Units);

            // 照会した清浄機自身の状態（電力0・フィルター満タン）は、清浄機から引いた照会の型が必ず持つ
            // The queried purifier's own state (zero power, fresh filter) is always carried by the from-a-purifier type
            Assert.AreEqual(0d, queried.Status.PowerRatio);
            Assert.AreEqual(1d, queried.Status.CurrentFilterRemainingRatio, 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MachineQueryDoesNotCountUnitsTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers.PlaceProcessMachine();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 機械の画面は部屋クラスの1行だけなので、機械から引いた照会は台数を数えない（台数のまとめは同じ部屋の値）
            // The machine screen shows only the class line, so a query from a machine does not count units (the purifier totals are the same room's)
            var room = AsEnclosed(new CleanRoomInfoQuery(datastore, ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore).Query(machine)).Room;
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomQueriedFromNonAirFilter>(room.QueriedFrom);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, room.AirFilterCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void BestClassHasNoNextClassTest()
        {
            var datastore = CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var query = new CleanRoomInfoQuery(datastore, ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore);

            // 満電の清浄機でいちばん良いクラス（添字0）まで進める
            // Run the fully powered purifier up to the best class (index 0)
            CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.EnsureFilterWiredPower(filter);
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            var room = AsEnclosed(query.Query(filter)).Room;
            for (var i = 0; i < 3000 && !(room.Class is CleanRoomClassifiedStanding { ThresholdIndex: 0 }); i++)
            {
                GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
                room = AsEnclosed(query.Query(filter)).Room;
            }

            // クラスAには次のクラスが無く、満電の清浄機は止まっていない
            // Class A has no next class, and the fully powered purifier is not stopped
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomClassifiedStanding>(room.Class, "room never reached class A within 3000 ticks");
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomAtBestClassOutlook>(AsQueriedFromAirFilter(room).NextClass);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, room.StoppedAirFilterCount);
        }

        private static CleanRoomEnclosedInfo AsEnclosed(CleanRoomInfo info)
        {
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomEnclosedInfo>(info, $"expected an enclosed room but got {info.GetType().Name}");
            return (CleanRoomEnclosedInfo)info;
        }

        private static CleanRoomQueriedFromAirFilter AsQueriedFromAirFilter(CleanRoomRoomSummary room)
        {
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomQueriedFromAirFilter>(room.QueriedFrom, $"expected a query from a purifier but got {room.QueriedFrom.GetType().Name}");
            return (CleanRoomQueriedFromAirFilter)room.QueriedFrom;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void MismatchedQuerySourceKindsAreUnreadableWithWarningTest()
        {
            // 次のクラスが NotCounted なのに自身の状態がある応答と、台数があるのに NotAirFilter の応答は、2つの種別が食い違った壊れた wire なので警告して読めない
            // A response with NotCounted but its own state, or with units but NotAirFilter, is broken wire whose two kinds disagree, so it warns and is unreadable
            var uncountedWithStatus = CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateOut(0, 1, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack>(), 1, 0, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateNotCounted(), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateAirFilter(1, 1));
            ExpectDisagreementWarnings();
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateEnclosed(uncountedWithStatus).TryReadView(out _));
            var countedWithoutStatus = CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateOut(0, 1, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack>(), 1, 0, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateUnitsToNextClass("D", 1), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateNotAirFilter());
            ExpectDisagreementWarnings();
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateEnclosed(countedWithoutStatus).TryReadView(out _));

            // そろった組（機械からの照会・清浄機からの照会）はどちらも読める
            // Agreeing pairs (queried from a machine, queried from a purifier) are both readable
            var fromMachine = CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateOut(0, 1, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack>(), 1, 0, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateNotCounted(), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateNotAirFilter());
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Success, GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateEnclosed(fromMachine).TryReadView(out _));
            var fromPurifier = CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateOut(0, 1, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack>(), 1, 0, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateUnitsToNextClass("D", 1), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateAirFilter(1, 1));
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Success, GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateEnclosed(fromPurifier).TryReadView(out _));

            #region Internal

            // 食い違いの警告と、部屋が読めない警告の2つが開発者向けのログに出る
            // Both the disagreement warning and the unreadable-room warning reach the developer log
            static void ExpectDisagreementWarnings()
            {
                LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomInfo\] Room query-source kinds disagree"));
                LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomInfo\] Enclosed response has a missing or broken room"));
            }

            #endregion
        }
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     清浄機の画面に出す次のクラスまでの見通し。いちばん良いクラス／あと N 台／空きを埋めても届かない のどれか1つ
    ///     Outlook to the next class for the purifier screen: exactly one of best class, N more units, or unreachable even when filled
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomNextClassOutlook
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the types in this file
        private protected CleanRoomNextClassOutlook()
        {
        }

        // 今の稼働状態のまま（止まっている台は除去0）、照会した清浄機と同じ種類を電力100%・フィルターありで1台ずつ足して数える
        // Count from the current operating state (stopped units remove nothing), adding units of the queried purifier's kind at full power with a filter
        public static CleanRoomNextClassOutlook Of(CleanRoom room, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilterEntry> entries, IBlock queriedBlock, ICleanRoomAirFilter queriedFilter, IReadOnlyList<double> requiredAirChangeRates)
        {
            // いちばん良いクラスかと次のクラスの行は、台数の数え上げと同じ口で決める（Out〈行数〉のときはいちばん下の行）
            // The best-class check and the next class row come from the same entry point as the unit count (the lowest row from Out, the row count)
            if (!CleanRoomClassYield.TryGetPromotionTargetIndex(room.ThresholdIndex, out var nextClassIndex)) return CleanRoomAtBestClassOutlook.Instance;
            var nextClassName = MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.Thresholds[nextClassIndex].ClassName;
            var removal = CleanRoomAirFilterCollector.SumRemovalVolume(entries);
            var unitCellCount = queriedBlock.BlockPositionInfo.EnumeratePositions().Count();
            if (!CleanRoomPurityLogic.TryCountUnitsToPromote(room.ThresholdIndex, removal, room.Volume, queriedFilter.RatedRemovalVolumePerSecond, unitCellCount, requiredAirChangeRates, out var units))
            {
                return new CleanRoomNextClassUnreachableOutlook(nextClassName);
            }
            return new CleanRoomUnitsToNextClassOutlook(nextClassName, units);
        }
    }

    // いちばん良いクラス。次のクラスは無い
    // The best class; there is no next class
    public sealed class CleanRoomAtBestClassOutlook : CleanRoomNextClassOutlook
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomAtBestClassOutlook Instance = new();

        private CleanRoomAtBestClassOutlook()
        {
        }
    }

    public sealed class CleanRoomUnitsToNextClassOutlook : CleanRoomNextClassOutlook
    {
        public string NextClassName { get; }
        public int Units { get; }

        public CleanRoomUnitsToNextClassOutlook(string nextClassName, int units)
        {
            NextClassName = nextClassName;
            Units = units;
        }
    }

    // 空きセルを全部清浄機で埋めても次のクラスに届かない
    // Even filling every free cell with purifiers does not reach the next class
    public sealed class CleanRoomNextClassUnreachableOutlook : CleanRoomNextClassOutlook
    {
        public string NextClassName { get; }

        public CleanRoomNextClassUnreachableOutlook(string nextClassName)
        {
            NextClassName = nextClassName;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋1つのクラス・清浄機の台数のまとめ・照会の出どころ（清浄機から引いたときだけ、その清浄機の状態と次のクラスまでの見通し）
    ///     Class, purifier totals and query source of one room (only from a purifier: that purifier's state and the outlook to the next class)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomRoomSummary
    {
        // Out か分類済みかは型で表し、クラス名を空文字で埋めない
        // Out versus classified is told by the type; the class name is never padded with an empty string
        public CleanRoomClassStanding Class { get; }
        public double AirChangeRate { get; }
        public int Volume { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilterSummary> AirFilters { get; }

        // 部屋の清浄機の台数と、そのうち止まっている（電力かフィルターが無く除去0の）台数
        // Purifiers in the room and how many of them are stopped (no power or no filter, removing nothing)
        public int AirFilterCount { get; }
        public int StoppedAirFilterCount { get; }
        public CleanRoomQueriedFrom QueriedFrom { get; }

        private CleanRoomRoomSummary(CleanRoomClassStanding standing, double airChangeRate, int volume, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilterSummary> airFilters, int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, CleanRoomQueriedFrom queriedFrom)
        {
            Class = standing;
            AirChangeRate = airChangeRate;
            Volume = volume;
            AirFilters = airFilters;
            AirFilterCount = airFilterCount;
            StoppedAirFilterCount = stoppedAirFilterCount;
            QueriedFrom = queriedFrom;
        }

        public static CleanRoomRoomSummary Create(CleanRoom room, IWorldBlockDatastore world, IBlock queriedBlock, IReadOnlyList<double> requiredAirChangeRates)
        {
            // 清浄機一覧はクラス判定と同じ収集関数で集める
            // The purifier list is gathered with the same collection function as the class decision
            var entries = CleanRoomAirFilterCollector.Collect(room, world);
            var airFilters = entries.Select(entry => new CleanRoomAirFilterSummary(entry.Block.BlockPositionInfo.OriginalPos, entry.Filter.GetStatus())).ToList();

            // 換気回数はクラス判定と同じ関数で出す（体積0の部屋は0）
            // The air change rate comes from the same function as the class decision (zero for a zero-volume room)
            var airChangeRate = CleanRoomAirFilterCollector.AirChangeRate(room, entries);

            // 止まっている台は、クラス判定で除去0として数えられる台
            // A stopped unit is one the class decision counts as removing nothing
            var stoppedCount = entries.Count(entry => entry.Filter.RemovalVolumePerSecond <= 0);
            var queriedFrom = CleanRoomQueriedFrom.Of(room, entries, queriedBlock, requiredAirChangeRates);
            return new CleanRoomRoomSummary(CleanRoomClassStanding.Of(room), airChangeRate, room.Volume, airFilters, entries.Count, stoppedCount, queriedFrom);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋の照会をどのブロックから引いたか。清浄機以外・清浄機 のどちらか1つだけで、清浄機から引いたときだけ自身の状態と次のクラスまでの見通しを必ず持つ
    ///     Which block the room query came from: exactly one of non-purifier or purifier, and only the purifier kind always carries its own state and the outlook to the next class
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomQueriedFrom
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの2つの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the two types in this file
        private protected CleanRoomQueriedFrom()
        {
        }

        public static CleanRoomQueriedFrom Of(CleanRoom room, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilterEntry> entries, IBlock queriedBlock, IReadOnlyList<double> requiredAirChangeRates)
        {
            // 清浄機かどうかはここ1か所で調べる。機械の画面は部屋クラスの1行だけなので、清浄機以外からの照会は自身の状態も台数も持たない
            // The purifier check lives only here; the machine screen shows only the class line, so a non-purifier query carries neither its own state nor units
            if (!queriedBlock.TryGetComponent<ICleanRoomAirFilter>(out var queriedFilter)) return CleanRoomQueriedFromNonAirFilter.Instance;
            var nextClass = CleanRoomNextClassOutlook.Of(room, entries, queriedBlock, queriedFilter, requiredAirChangeRates);
            return new CleanRoomQueriedFromAirFilter(queriedFilter.GetStatus(), nextClass);
        }
    }

    // 清浄機以外（室内の機械）から引いた照会
    // Queried from something other than a purifier (an interior machine)
    public sealed class CleanRoomQueriedFromNonAirFilter : CleanRoomQueriedFrom
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomQueriedFromNonAirFilter Instance = new();

        private CleanRoomQueriedFromNonAirFilter()
        {
        }
    }

    // 清浄機から引いた照会。清浄機の画面の「この清浄機」の行と「あと何台」
    // Queried from a purifier: the purifier screen's "this purifier" line and its units to the next class
    public sealed class CleanRoomQueriedFromAirFilter : CleanRoomQueriedFrom
    {
        public CleanRoomAirFilterStatus Status { get; }
        public CleanRoomNextClassOutlook NextClass { get; }

        public CleanRoomQueriedFromAirFilter(CleanRoomAirFilterStatus status, CleanRoomNextClassOutlook nextClass)
        {
            Status = status;
            NextClass = nextClass;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     次のクラスまでの台数。組み立ては種別ごとの static factory、台数の読み出しは TryGetUnitsToNextClass に閉じる
    ///     Units to the next class; built only through per-kind static factories and read only through TryGetUnitsToNextClass
    /// </summary>
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind Kind { get; set; }

        // NextClassName は UnitsToNextClass・Unreachable、Units は UnitsToNextClass のときだけ書かれる
        // NextClassName is written only for UnitsToNextClass and Unreachable, Units only for UnitsToNextClass
        [Key(1)] public string NextClassName { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public int Units { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack() { }

        private CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack(CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind kind)
        {
            Kind = kind;
        }

        public static CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack CreateAtBestClass()
        {
            return new CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack(CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.AtBestClass);
        }

        public static CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack CreateUnitsToNextClass(string nextClassName, int units)
        {
            return new CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack(CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.UnitsToNextClass) { NextClassName = nextClassName, Units = units };
        }

        public static CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack CreateUnreachable(string nextClassName)
        {
            return new CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack(CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.Unreachable) { NextClassName = nextClassName };
        }

        public static CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack CreateNotCounted()
        {
            return new CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack(CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.NotCounted);
        }

        // 「（クラスBまであと5台）」を出せるときだけ true
        // True only when "(5 more to class B)" can be shown
        public bool TryGetUnitsToNextClass(out string nextClassName, out int units)
        {
            var hasUnits = Kind == CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.UnitsToNextClass;
            nextClassName = hasUnits ? NextClassName : default;
            units = hasUnits ? Units : default;
            return hasUnits;
        }

        // 外から届いた値が読めるか。未知の種別と、種別に要る値の欠けを弾く
        // Whether a value from outside is readable, rejecting unknown kinds and values a kind needs but lacks
        public bool IsReadable()
        {
            switch (Kind)
            {
                case CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.AtBestClass:
                case CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.NotCounted:
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.UnitsToNextClass:
                    return NextClassName != null && 0 < Units;
                case CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.Unreachable:
                    return NextClassName != null;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
        }
    }

    public enum CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind
    {
        AtBestClass,
        UnitsToNextClass,
        Unreachable,
        NotCounted,
    }
}
```

```csharp
using MessagePack;
using System;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     照会した清浄機自身の状態（清浄機の画面の「この清浄機」の行）。組み立ては種別ごとの static factory、読み出しは TryGetStatus に閉じる
    ///     The queried purifier's own state (the purifier screen's "this purifier" line); built only through per-kind static factories and read only through TryGetStatus
    /// </summary>
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterResponseKind Kind { get; set; }

        // 電力の割合と、装填中のフィルター1個の残量（どちらも0〜1）。AirFilter のときだけ書かれる
        // Power ratio and the loaded filter's remaining life (both 0 to 1); written only for AirFilter
        [Key(1)] public double PowerRatio { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public double FilterRemainingRatio { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack() { }

        {
            return new CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack(CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterResponseKind.NotAirFilter);
        }

        public static CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack CreateAirFilter(double powerRatio, double filterRemainingRatio)
        {
            return new CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack(CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterResponseKind.AirFilter) { PowerRatio = powerRatio, FilterRemainingRatio = filterRemainingRatio };
        }

        // 清浄機から引いた照会のときだけ true
        // True only for a query from a purifier
        public bool TryGetStatus(out double powerRatio, out double filterRemainingRatio)
        {
            var isAirFilter = Kind == CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterResponseKind.AirFilter;
            powerRatio = isAirFilter ? PowerRatio : default;
            filterRemainingRatio = isAirFilter ? FilterRemainingRatio : default;
            return isAirFilter;
        }

        // 外から届いた値が読めるか。未知の種別を弾く
        // Whether a value from outside is readable, rejecting unknown kinds
        public bool IsReadable()
        {
            return Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterResponseKind), Kind);
        }
    }

    public enum CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterResponseKind
    {
        NotAirFilter,
        AirFilter,
    }
```
