```csharp
    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomClassResponseKind ClassKind { get; set; }

        // ClassName と ThresholdIndex は Classified のときだけ書かれる。読むのは TryGetClass だけ
        // ClassName and ThresholdIndex are written only when Classified; only TryGetClass reads them
        [Key(1)] public string ClassName { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public int ThresholdIndex { get; set; }
        [Key(3)] public double AirChangeRate { get; set; }
        [Key(4)] public int Volume { get; set; }
        [Key(5)] public List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> AirFilters { get; set; }

        // 清浄機の台数のまとめと、次のクラスまでの台数（清浄機の画面の部屋の行）
        // Purifier totals and units to the next class (the room line of the purifier screen)
        [Key(6)] public int AirFilterCount { get; set; }
        [Key(7)] public int StoppedAirFilterCount { get; set; }
        [Key(8)] public CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack NextClass { get; set; }

        // 照会した清浄機自身の状態（清浄機の画面の「この清浄機」の行）
        // The queried purifier's own state (the purifier screen's "this purifier" line)
        [Key(9)] public CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack QueriedAirFilter { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack() { }

        private CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(CleanRoomClassResponseKind classKind, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters, int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack nextClass, CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack queriedAirFilter)
        {
            ClassKind = classKind;
            AirChangeRate = airChangeRate;
            Volume = volume;
            AirFilters = airFilters;
            AirFilterCount = airFilterCount;
            StoppedAirFilterCount = stoppedAirFilterCount;
            NextClass = nextClass;
            QueriedAirFilter = queriedAirFilter;
        }

        public static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack CreateClassified(string className, int thresholdIndex, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters, int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack nextClass, CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack queriedAirFilter)
        {
            return new CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Classified, airChangeRate, volume, airFilters, airFilterCount, stoppedAirFilterCount, nextClass, queriedAirFilter) { ClassName = className, ThresholdIndex = thresholdIndex };
        }

        public static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack CreateOut(double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters, int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack nextClass, CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack queriedAirFilter)
        {
            return new CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Out, airChangeRate, volume, airFilters, airFilterCount, stoppedAirFilterCount, nextClass, queriedAirFilter);
        }

        // Out なら false。判別子の読み分けはここだけで行う
        // False when Out; the only place that branches on the discriminator
        public bool TryGetClass(out string className, out int thresholdIndex)
        {
            switch (ClassKind)
            {
                case CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Classified:
                    className = ClassName;
                    thresholdIndex = ThresholdIndex;
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Out:
                    className = default;
                    thresholdIndex = default;
                    return false;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(ClassKind), ClassKind, "未対応のクラス種別 / Unsupported class kind");
            }
        }
    }
```

`CleanRoomInfoMessagePackFactory.cs` の `CreateSummary`（29-43）直した後:

```csharp
            static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack CreateSummary(CleanRoomRoomSummary room)
            {
                var filters = room.AirFilters.Select(filter => new CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack(
                    new Vector3IntMessagePack(filter.Position),
                    filter.Status.PowerRatio,
                    filter.Status.RemovalVolumePerSecond,
                    filter.Status.FilterItemCount,
                    filter.Status.CurrentFilterRemainingRatio)).ToList();
                var (nextClass, queriedAirFilter) = CreateQueriedFrom(room.QueriedFrom);
                return room.Class switch
                {
                    CleanRoomClassifiedStanding classified => CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateClassified(classified.ClassName, classified.ThresholdIndex, room.AirChangeRate, room.Volume, filters, room.AirFilterCount, room.StoppedAirFilterCount, nextClass, queriedAirFilter),
                    CleanRoomOutStanding _ => CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateOut(room.AirChangeRate, room.Volume, filters, room.AirFilterCount, room.StoppedAirFilterCount, nextClass, queriedAirFilter),
                    _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(room.Class), room.Class.GetType().Name, "未対応のクラス種別 / Unsupported class standing"),
                };
            }

            // 照会の出どころを、次のクラスと照会した清浄機の状態の2つの欄へ1回の分岐で写す。清浄機以外からの照会は wire の NotCounted と NotAirFilter になる
            // Map the query source onto both the next-class and queried-purifier fields in one branch; a non-purifier query becomes NotCounted and NotAirFilter on the wire
            static (CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack nextClass, CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack queriedAirFilter) CreateQueriedFrom(CleanRoomQueriedFrom queriedFrom)
            {
                return queriedFrom switch
                {
                    CleanRoomQueriedFromAirFilter airFilter => (CreateNextClass(airFilter.NextClass), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateAirFilter(airFilter.Status.PowerRatio, airFilter.Status.CurrentFilterRemainingRatio)),
                    CleanRoomQueriedFromNonAirFilter _ => (CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateNotCounted(), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateNotAirFilter()),
                    _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(queriedFrom), queriedFrom.GetType().Name, "未対応の照会の出どころ / Unsupported query source"),
                };
            }

            // 見通しの種別ごとの型を種別ごとの factory へ写す
            // Map each per-kind outlook type onto its per-kind factory
            static CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack CreateNextClass(CleanRoomNextClassOutlook outlook)
            {
                return outlook switch
                {
                    CleanRoomAtBestClassOutlook _ => CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateAtBestClass(),
                    CleanRoomUnitsToNextClassOutlook units => CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateUnitsToNextClass(units.NextClassName, units.Units),
                    CleanRoomNextClassUnreachableOutlook unreachable => CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateUnreachable(unreachable.NextClassName),
                    _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(outlook), outlook.GetType().Name, "未対応の次のクラスの見通し / Unsupported next-class outlook"),
                };
            }
```

`GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.cs` の `IsReadableRoom`（126-141）直した後:

```csharp
                bool IsReadableRoom()
                {
                    if (Room == null || Room.AirFilters == null) return false;
                    if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CleanRoomClassResponseKind), Room.ClassKind))
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"Unreadable room class: {Room.ClassKind}");
                        return false;
                    }
                    if (Room.ClassKind == CleanRoomClassResponseKind.Classified && Room.ClassName == null) return false;
                    foreach (var filter in Room.AirFilters)
                    {
                        if (filter == null || filter.Position == null) return false;
                    }

                    // 次のクラス・照会した清浄機の状態の欠けや未知の種別も壊れた部屋として読めない（呼び出し元が警告を出す）
                    // A missing or unknown-kind next class or queried-purifier state is a broken room too (the caller warns)
                    if (Room.NextClass == null || !Room.NextClass.IsReadable()) return false;
                    if (Room.QueriedAirFilter == null || !Room.QueriedAirFilter.IsReadable()) return false;

                    // 「清浄機以外から照会した」は NotCounted と NotAirFilter の組でだけ表す。片方だけの応答は2つの種別が食い違った壊れた wire
                    // "Queried from a non-purifier" is only the NotCounted + NotAirFilter pair; a response with just one of them is broken wire whose two kinds disagree
                    var isUncountedNextClass = Room.NextClass.Kind == CleanRoomNextClassResponseKind.NotCounted;
                    var isNonAirFilterQuery = Room.QueriedAirFilter.Kind == CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterResponseKind.NotAirFilter;
                    if (isUncountedNextClass == isNonAirFilterQuery) return true;
                    Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomInfo] Room query-source kinds disagree: nextClass={Room.NextClass.Kind} queriedAirFilter={Room.QueriedAirFilter.Kind}");
                    return false;
                }
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/Ui/State/Modal/ModalTableRequestTest.cs` を作る。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.State.Modal;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.Modal
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 項目名と値の行を載せたモーダルの要求
    /// Modal requests carrying label-and-values rows
    /// </summary>
    public class ModalTableRequestTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 表のモーダルは行を保留の要求に載せ応答で結果を返す()
        {
            var service = new ModalRequestService();
            var rows = new List<ModalTableRow> { new("部屋クラスを B に", "失敗 −13.1%") };
            var (requestId, response) = service.RequestTableModal("失敗率の改善方法", "今: 失敗 50.5%", rows, "閉じる");

            // 入力欄の無い確認の形で、行は要求のまま載る
            // A confirm-style request without input; rows ride along unchanged
            Assert.AreEqual(requestId, service.Pending.Id);
            Assert.IsFalse(service.Pending.RequiresInput);
            Assert.AreEqual(ModalVariant.Confirm, service.Pending.Variant);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, service.Pending.Rows.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual("部屋クラスを B に", service.Pending.Rows[0].Label);
            Assert.AreEqual("失敗 −13.1%", service.Pending.Rows[0].Values);

            // 応答で結果だけが返る
            // The reply resolves the result only
            Assert.IsTrue(service.Respond(requestId, ModalResult.Cancel, null));
            Assert.AreEqual(UniTaskStatus.Succeeded, response.Status);
            Assert.AreEqual(ModalResult.Cancel, response.GetAwaiter().GetResult());
            Assert.IsNull(service.Pending);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 確認と入力のモーダルは行を空で載せる()
        {
            var service = new ModalRequestService();
            service.RequestModal("t", "m", "ok", ModalVariant.Confirm).Forget();
            Assert.AreEqual(0, service.Pending.Rows.Count);

            service.RequestInputModal("t", "m", "ok");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, service.Pending.Rows.Count);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void 表の行は本文とボタンの間に項目名の行と字下げした値の行で描く()
        {
            var view = Mount(new ModalView(ModalRequestSamples.Table(), new RecordingModalCommands(), Observable.Never<Unit>()));
            simulate.FrameUpdate();

            var table = Find<VisualElement>(view, "modal-table");
            Assert.AreEqual(2, table.Query<VisualElement>(className: "modal-view__table-row").ToList().Count);
            StringAssert.EndsWith("部屋クラスを B に", Find<Label>(view, "modal-table-row-0-label").text);
            StringAssert.EndsWith("Lv1 +9.2% / 失敗 −13.1%", Find<Label>(view, "modal-table-row-0-values").text);
            StringAssert.EndsWith("品質モジュールLv1 を追加", Find<Label>(view, "modal-table-row-1-label").text);

            // 値の行は項目名の行の下で、字下げしている
            // The values line sits below the label line and is indented
            var label = Find<Label>(view, "modal-table-row-0-label").worldBound;
            var values = Find<Label>(view, "modal-table-row-0-values").worldBound;
            Assert.GreaterOrEqual(values.yMin, label.yMax - 0.5f);
            Assert.Greater(values.xMin, label.xMin + 0.5f);

            // 表は本文の下、ボタンの上
            // The table sits under the message and above the button
            Assert.LessOrEqual(Find<Label>(view, "modal-message").worldBound.yMax, table.worldBound.yMin + 0.5f);
            Assert.LessOrEqual(table.worldBound.yMax, Find<VisualElement>(view, "modal-button").worldBound.yMin + 0.5f);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 行の無い要求は表を作らない()
        {
            var view = Mount(new ModalView(ModalRequestSamples.Confirm(), new RecordingModalCommands(), Observable.Never<Unit>()));
            simulate.FrameUpdate();
            Assert.IsNull(view.Q<VisualElement>("modal-table"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 表のモーダルのボタンは確認として返る()
        {
            var commands = new RecordingModalCommands();
            var view = Mount(new ModalView(ModalRequestSamples.Table(), commands, Observable.Never<Unit>()));
            simulate.FrameUpdate();
            simulate.Click(Find<VisualElement>(view, "modal-button").worldBound.center);

            Assert.AreEqual(1, commands.Responses.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual("t1", commands.Responses[0].RequestId);
            Assert.AreEqual(ModalResult.Confirm, commands.Responses[0].Result);
        }
    }
}
```

直した後（1行目の下に `using System.Collections.Generic;` を足し、37-73行目を次の全文に替える。74-78行目〈通知・旧要求の取消・return〉は変えない）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
```

```csharp
        // モーダルを出して結果を待つ
        // Show a modal and await its result
        public async UniTask<ModalResult> RequestModal(string title, string message, string buttonText, ModalVariant variant)
        {
            var (_, response) = RequestCore(title, message, buttonText, variant, false, Array.Empty<ModalTableRow>());
            var (result, _) = await response;
            return result;
        }

        // 入力付きモーダルを出し、自分の要求IDと (結果, 入力テキスト) の待ちを返す（キャンセル時 text は null）
        // Show an input modal and return its own request id with the wait for (result, entered text); text is null on cancel
        public (string requestId, UniTask<(ModalResult result, string text)> response) RequestInputModal(string title, string message, string buttonText)
        {
            return RequestCore(title, message, buttonText, ModalVariant.Confirm, true, Array.Empty<ModalTableRow>());
        }

        // 項目名と値の行を並べたモーダルを出し、自分の要求IDと結果の待ちを返す（入力欄なし）
        // Show a modal listing label-and-values rows and return its own request id with the wait for the result (no input field)
        public (string requestId, UniTask<ModalResult> response) RequestTableModal(string title, string message, IReadOnlyList<ModalTableRow> rows, string buttonText)
        {
            var (requestId, response) = RequestCore(title, message, buttonText, ModalVariant.Confirm, false, rows);
            return (requestId, ResultOnly());

            #region Internal

            async UniTask<ModalResult> ResultOnly()
            {
                var (result, _) = await response;
                return result;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private (string requestId, UniTask<(ModalResult result, string text)> response) RequestCore(string title, string message, string buttonText, ModalVariant variant, bool requiresInput, IReadOnlyList<ModalTableRow> rows)
        {
            // 最新要求の状態を先に確定し、既存要求は再入しても上書きしない順序で cancel 解決する
            // Commit the latest request state first, then cancel the previous request without reentrant overwrites
            var previousSource = _pendingSource;

            _nextId++;
            var requestId = _nextId.ToString();
            _latestIssuedId = requestId;
            var source = new UniTaskCompletionSource<(ModalResult result, string text)>();
            _pendingSource = source;

            Pending = new ModalRequest
            {
                Id = requestId,
                Title = title,
                Message = message,
                ButtonText = buttonText,
                Variant = variant,
                RequiresInput = requiresInput,
                Rows = rows,
            };
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui/Screens/Modal/ModalView.cs` を次の全文に替える（変えたのは using 1行・47-49行目の表の差し込み・`CreateTable`/`TableLabel` のローカル関数。ほかは今のまま）。

```csharp
using System;
using Client.Input;
using Client.Ui.Components.Controls;
using Client.Ui.Components.Panels;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Layout;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Text;
using Client.Ui.State.Modal;
using Client.Ui.State.Modal.Logic;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.Modal
{
    /// <summary>
    /// モーダル 1 件の中身（Web ModalBody）。要求ごとに作り直し、入力の持ち越しを構造で無くす（Web の key={id}）。確定・ESC・幕の押下をすべて自分で IModalCommands へ返す（設計書 A-8）
    /// One modal's contents (Web ModalBody); rebuilt per request so input never carries over (Web key={id}). It returns confirm, ESC and backdrop presses to IModalCommands itself (design A-8)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ModalView : VisualElement
    {
        private readonly ModalRequest _request;
        private readonly IModalCommands _commands;
        private readonly IObservable<Unit> _backdropClicked;
        private readonly FormButton _button;
        private bool _confirmable;
        private string _confirmedText;
        private IDisposable _backdropSubscription;

        public ModalView(ModalRequest request, IModalCommands commands, IObservable<Unit> backdropClicked)
        {
            _request = request;
            _commands = commands;
            _backdropClicked = backdropClicked;
            AddToClassList("modal-view");

            // 題・本文（Web Modal.Title fz=h4・Text size=sm c=dimmed mb=lg）。文は要求側が解いた文なので FromVerbatim（A-40）
            // Title and message (Web Modal.Title fz=h4, Text size=sm c=dimmed mb=lg); requester-resolved text, so FromVerbatim (A-40)
            var frame = new DialogFrame("modal");
            frame.SetTitle(UiText.FromVerbatim(request.Title));
            Add(frame);
            var message = new LocalizedLabel { name = "modal-message" };
            message.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextSm);
            message.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextDimmed);
            message.AddToClassList("modal-view__message");
            message.SetText(UiText.FromVerbatim(request.Message));
            frame.Add(message);

            // 項目名と値の行は行のある要求だけ（visual-vocabulary §3。ADR 0105 §4）
            // Label-and-values rows only for requests that carry them (visual-vocabulary §3, ADR 0105 §4)
            if (request.Rows.Count > 0) frame.Add(CreateTable());

            // 入力欄は入力付きのみ、ボタンは全幅
            // The field only for input requests; the button spans the width
            if (request.RequiresInput) frame.Add(CreateInput());
            _button = new FormButton("modal-button", UiText.FromVerbatim(request.ButtonText), ModalButtonVariants.From(ModalLogic.ConfirmButtonTone(request.Variant)));
            _button.OnClicked.Subscribe(_ => Confirm());
            frame.AddAction(_button);
            SetEnteredText("");

            // 幕の押下は載っている間だけ聞く。フォーカスの無い ESC は聞かない（既存のゲーム入力の経路が取り消す。計画 D-11・設計書 A-83）
            // Listen for backdrop presses only while attached; focus-less ESC is not heard here (the existing game input path cancels; plan D-11, design A-83)
            RegisterCallback<AttachToPanelEvent>(OnAttached);
            RegisterCallback<DetachFromPanelEvent>(OnDetached);

            #region Internal

            VisualElement CreateTable()
            {
                // 1行は項目名の行と、その下に字下げした値の行の2行1組。罫線・列そろえは作らない
                // Each row is a label line with an indented values line below; no rules or column alignment
                var table = new UiStack(UiGap.Sm) { name = "modal-table" };
                table.AddToClassList("modal-view__table");
                for (var i = 0; i < request.Rows.Count; i++)
                {
                    var row = new UiStack(UiGap.Px2) { name = $"modal-table-row-{i}" };
                    row.AddToClassList("modal-view__table-row");
                    row.AddItem(TableLabel($"modal-table-row-{i}-label", request.Rows[i].Label, null));
                    row.AddItem(TableLabel($"modal-table-row-{i}-values", request.Rows[i].Values, "modal-view__table-values"));
                    table.AddItem(row);
                }
                return table;
            }

            LocalizedLabel TableLabel(string testid, string text, string extraClassName)
            {
                var label = new LocalizedLabel { name = testid };
                label.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextSm);
                label.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextDefault);
                if (extraClassName != null) label.AddToClassList(extraClassName);
                label.SetText(UiText.FromVerbatim(text));
                return label;
            }

            GameTextField CreateInput()
            {
                var input = new GameTextField("modal-input", false, GameTextFieldLook.MantineInput);
                input.AddToClassList("modal-view__input");
                input.OnValueChanged.Subscribe(SetEnteredText);

                // 入力欄の ESC は GameUiInputRules が消費してフォーカスを外す。その外れを見て 1 回で取り消す（Web の Mantine と同じ 1 回。計画 D-11）
                // GameUiInputRules consumes ESC in the field and drops focus; seeing that blur, cancel in one press (one press like Mantine on the Web; plan D-11)
                input.Field.RegisterCallback<FocusOutEvent>(_ => CancelIfEscapeBlurred());

                // 表示時に入力欄へフォーカス（Web autoFocus）。載った直後はスタイルが未解決なので次のフレームで当てる
                // Focus the field when shown (Web autoFocus); styles are unresolved right after attaching, so apply next frame
                input.RegisterCallback<AttachToPanelEvent>(_ => input.schedule.Execute(() => input.Field.Focus()));
                return input;
            }

            void CancelIfEscapeBlurred()
            {
                // silent-ok: ESC 以外の外れ（クリック・閉じたとき）と変換中の ESC は取り消さない / ModalScreenPresenterTest「入力欄のESCは1回で取り消す」「欄の外を押しても閉じない」「変換中のESCでは取り消さない」が見る
                if (!UiInputExclusivity.IsEscapeBlurredTextFieldThisFrame) return;
                Respond(ModalResponse.Cancel(_request));
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private void OnAttached(AttachToPanelEvent evt)
        {
            _backdropSubscription = _backdropClicked.Subscribe(_ => Respond(ModalResponse.Cancel(_request)));
        }

        private void OnDetached(DetachFromPanelEvent evt)
        {
            _backdropSubscription?.Dispose();
            _backdropSubscription = null;
        }

        // 可否と確定の文は文の変化ごとに 1 回だけ導き、ボタンと確定の両方がそれを読む（ModalLogic.TryGetConfirmableText）
        // Derive eligibility and the confirmed text once per text change; both the button and Confirm read it (ModalLogic.TryGetConfirmableText)
        private void SetEnteredText(string text)
        {
            _confirmable = ModalLogic.TryGetConfirmableText(_request, text, out _confirmedText);
            _button.SetEnabled(_confirmable);
        }

        private void Confirm()
        {
            if (!_confirmable)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[Modal] confirm ignored for request {_request.Id}: entered text is whitespace only");
                return;
            }
            Respond(ModalResponse.Confirm(_request, _confirmedText));
        }

        private void Respond(ModalResponse response)
        {
            _commands.Respond(response);
        }
    }
}
```

  - `CleanRoomYieldLogic.Lines(CleanRoomYieldOdds)`・`internal const string ZeroPercent`・`internal static string Percent(double rate)`・`internal static bool ShowsZero(double value)`（表示〈絶対値の小数1桁〉が 0.0 になるかの判定の1か所。`ShownLevels` と改善の差分の符号〈`Signed`〉が呼ぶ）・`internal static List<int> ShownLevels(IReadOnlyList<double> levelValues)`（表示が 0.0 にならない Lv の番号。欄の行・「今」・差分の3か所が使う。判断 D-8・D-28）
  - `CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.CurrentValues(CleanRoomYieldOdds) : IReadOnlyList<UiText>`・`Rows(CleanRoomYieldOdds) : IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovementRow>`、`CleanRoomYieldImprovementRow { UiText Label; IReadOnlyList<UiText> Values }`
  - `ContextViewConversion.Yield(BlockInfoFetchState, CleanRoomYieldView, out string) : SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>`、`BlockContextViewModel.CleanRoomYield : SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>`
  - 行の testid: `clean-room-yield-output-count`・`clean-room-yield-level-rate-{n}`・`clean-room-yield-failed-rate`（EUV も失敗の行はこの id）。消える: `clean-room-yield-layer-fail-rate`・`-quality-tier`・`-die-loss-rate`・`-pending-*`・`-pending-label`・`-next-label`
  - テスト用: `CleanRoomWireSamples`・`SectionContentAssert`（Interfaces 一覧）

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/Ui/State/BlockInventory/Context/CleanRoomWireSamples.cs` を作る（C7 で旧項目が外れたとき、テストで直すのはこのファイルだけになる。「サーバー側の下書きへの注文」1）。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 部屋と確率の照会の型を組む。C7 で旧項目が外れたらこのファイルだけを直す
    /// Builds room and odds query packs; when C7 drops the old fields only this file changes
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomWireSamples
    {
        // 換気回数・体積・清浄機の一覧は C7 で消える旧項目。クライアントは読まないので空で渡す
        // Air change rate, volume and the purifier list are old fields C7 removes; the client reads none, so pass empties
        public static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack ClassifiedRoom(string className, int thresholdIndex, int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack nextClass, CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack queriedAirFilter)
        {
            return CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateClassified(className, thresholdIndex, 0, 0, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack>(), airFilterCount, stoppedAirFilterCount, nextClass, queriedAirFilter);
        }

        public static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack OutRoom(int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack nextClass, CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack queriedAirFilter)
        {
            return CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack.CreateOut(0, 0, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack>(), airFilterCount, stoppedAirFilterCount, nextClass, queriedAirFilter);
        }

        // 第1・第2引数（今の層の失敗率と出力待ちの抽選）は C7 で消える旧項目。クライアントは読まないので null
        // The first two arguments (current layer fail rate and the output-wait draw) are old fields C7 removes; the client reads neither, so null
        public static CleanRoomYieldLayerExposureView LayerExposure(double failedRate, List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> improvements)
        {
            return new CleanRoomYieldLayerExposureView(null, null, new LayerExposureOddsMessagePack(failedRate), improvements);
        }

        public static CleanRoomYieldDicingView Dicing(int outputCount, double[] levelRates, double failedRate, List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> improvements)
        {
            return new CleanRoomYieldDicingView(null, null, new DicingOddsMessagePack(outputCount, levelRates, failedRate), improvements);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/Ui/State/BlockInventory/Context/SectionContentAssert.cs` を作る（今 `ContextViewConversionTest` の中にある `PresentValue`・`UnavailableState` と同じ中身。2つのテストクラスで使うので出す）。

```csharp
using Client.Game.InGame.BlockInfoPolling;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 欄の3値（在る・取得不可・無し）のうち在る・取得不可を取り出して確かめる
    /// Extracts and asserts the present or unavailable state of an entry
    /// </summary>
    public static class SectionContentAssert
    {
        public static T Present<T>(SectionContent<T> entry)
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(entry.TryGetPresent(out var value), "取得済みの欄である");
            return value;
        }

        public static BlockInfoFetchState Unavailable<T>(SectionContent<T> entry)
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(entry.TryGetUnavailable(out var fetchState), "取得できない欄である");
            return fetchState;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/Ui/State/BlockInventory/Context/ContextYieldConversionTest.cs` を作る。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Game.InGame.BlockInfoPolling;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 確率の照会から欄への写し（最終の内訳と改善の行だけを読む）
    /// Mapping the odds query onto the entry (reads only final odds and improvement rows)
    /// </summary>
    public class ContextYieldConversionTest
    {
        private const BlockInfoFetchState Fetched = BlockInfoFetchState.Fetched;

        [Test]
        public void 未取得は取得状態で_役割なしと稼働できない機械は欄なし()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoFetchState.TransportFailed, SectionContentAssert.Unavailable(ContextViewConversion.Yield(BlockInfoFetchState.TransportFailed, null, out _)));
            Assert.IsTrue(ContextViewConversion.Yield(Fetched, CleanRoomYieldNoRoleView.Instance, out _).IsAbsent);
            Assert.IsTrue(ContextViewConversion.Yield(Fetched, CleanRoomYieldNotOperableView.Instance, out _).IsAbsent);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 露光は失敗の割合と改善の行を写す()
        {
            var improvements = new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> { CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateRoomClassUp("B", new double[0], -0.15) };
            var odds = (LayerExposureYieldOdds)Converted(CleanRoomWireSamples.LayerExposure(0.35, improvements));

            Assert.AreEqual(0.35, odds.FailedRate);
            Assert.IsTrue(odds.HasImprovements);
            var classUp = (RoomClassUpOddsImprovement)odds.Improvements[0];
            Assert.AreEqual("B", classUp.TargetClassName);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, classUp.LevelRateDeltas.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(-0.15, classUp.FailedRateDelta);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ダイシングは出力個数とLv別の最終割合と失敗と改善の行を並びのまま写す()
        {
            var improvements = new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack>
            {
                CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateRoomClassUp("B", new[] { 0.092, 0.038 }, -0.131),
                CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateAddQualityModule(1, new[] { 0.012, 0.015 }, -0.027),
            };
            var odds = (DicingYieldOdds)Converted(CleanRoomWireSamples.Dicing(300, new[] { 0.423, 0.072 }, 0.505, improvements));

            Assert.AreEqual(300, odds.OutputCount);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { 0.423, 0.072 }, odds.LevelRates);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.505, odds.FailedRate);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, odds.Improvements.Count);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<RoomClassUpOddsImprovement>(odds.Improvements[0]);
            var module = (AddQualityModuleOddsImprovement)odds.Improvements[1];
            Assert.AreEqual(1, module.ModuleTier);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { 0.012, 0.015 }, module.LevelRateDeltas);
            Assert.AreEqual(-0.027, module.FailedRateDelta);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 改善の行が空なら空のまま写しボタンの条件は偽()
        {
            var odds = Converted(CleanRoomWireSamples.LayerExposure(0.1, new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack>()));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, odds.Improvements.Count);
            Assert.IsFalse(odds.HasImprovements);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 写せない種別の改善の行は欄を出さず異常を返す()
        {
            // 種別を足して写しを直し忘れたときの代わりに、写しに無い値を入れる
            // Stand in for a kind added without updating the mapping by setting a value the mapping lacks
            var unmapped = CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateAddQualityModule(1, new double[0], -0.1);
            unmapped.Kind = (CleanRoomYieldImprovementKind)99;
            var entry = ContextViewConversion.Yield(Fetched, CleanRoomWireSamples.LayerExposure(0.2, new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> { unmapped }), out var anomaly);

            Assert.IsTrue(entry.IsAbsent);
            Assert.AreEqual("[ContextViewConversion] unmapped improvement kind: 99", anomaly, "ログは出さず異常の文面を返す");
        }

        private static CleanRoomYieldOdds Converted(CleanRoomYieldView view)
        {
            var odds = SectionContentAssert.Present(ContextViewConversion.Yield(Fetched, view, out var anomaly));
            Assert.IsNull(anomaly);
            return odds;
        }
    }
}
```

改善の行の差分の長さ・未定義の種別・クラス名が壊れた応答のテストは D に置かない（`写せない種別の…` は写しの直し忘れの検査で、wire の検査ではない）。検査は C の `CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.AreReadable` の1か所にあり、読み口が警告つきで読めない応答にすることは C4 の `CleanRoomYieldOddsProtocolTest.BrokenImprovementsAreUnreadableWithWarningTest` が見る。読めない応答の間の欄は `CleanRoomYieldSectionTest.読めない応答の間は取得状態の1行だけを描き率を出さない` が見る（判断 D-14）。

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/Ui/State/BlockInventory/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogicTest.cs` を作る。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Tests.Ui.TestDoubles;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 「失敗率の改善方法」の今の値と改善ごとの差分の文（ADR 0105 §4）
    /// Current values and per-improvement delta texts of the improvement modal (ADR 0105 §4)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogicTest
    {
        private const string Minus = "−";

        [Test]
        public void 今の値は表示が0でないLvと失敗を短い形で並べる()
        {
            var values = CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.CurrentValues(CleanRoomYieldOdds.Dicing(300, new[] { 0.423, 0.072, 0 }, 0.505, Improvements()));

            Assert.AreEqual(3, values.Count);
            AssertLevel(values[0], "1", "42.3");
            AssertLevel(values[1], "2", "7.2");
            AssertFailed(values[2], "50.5");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 露光の今の値は失敗だけ()
        {
            var values = CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.CurrentValues(CleanRoomYieldOdds.LayerExposure(0.308, new List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement>()));

            Assert.AreEqual(1, values.Count);
            AssertFailed(values[0], "30.8");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 改善の行は項目名と符号つきの差分で_表示が0のLvは出さず失敗はいつも出す()
        {
            var rows = CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.Rows(CleanRoomYieldOdds.Dicing(300, new[] { 0.423, 0.072, 0 }, 0.505, Improvements()));

            Assert.AreEqual(3, rows.Count);
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldImproveRoomClass, new[] { "className", "B" }, rows[0].Label);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, rows[0].Values.Count);
            AssertLevel(rows[0].Values[0], "1", "+9.2");
            AssertLevel(rows[0].Values[1], "2", "+3.8");
            AssertFailed(rows[0].Values[2], Minus + "13.1");

            // 1つ上の品質モジュールは Lv1 が減り Lv2・Lv3 が増える
            // The next-tier module lowers Lv1 and raises Lv2 and Lv3
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldImproveAddModule, new[] { "tier", "2" }, rows[1].Label);
            Assert.AreEqual(4, rows[1].Values.Count);
            AssertLevel(rows[1].Values[0], "1", Minus + "36.9");
            AssertLevel(rows[1].Values[1], "2", "+37.0");
            AssertLevel(rows[1].Values[2], "3", "+8.2");
            AssertFailed(rows[1].Values[3], Minus + "8.2");

            // 差分がどれも表示 0.0 の行は失敗の「0.0」だけ（符号なし）
            // A row whose deltas all show 0.0 keeps only the failure "0.0" (no sign)
            Assert.AreEqual(1, rows[2].Values.Count);
            AssertFailed(rows[2].Values[0], "0.0");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 露光の改善の行は失敗の差分だけ()
        {
            var improvements = new List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> { CleanRoomOddsImprovement.RoomClassUp("A", new double[0], -0.1) };
            var rows = CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.Rows(CleanRoomYieldOdds.LayerExposure(0.2, improvements));

            Assert.AreEqual(1, rows[0].Values.Count);
            AssertFailed(rows[0].Values[0], Minus + "10.0");
        }

        private static List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> Improvements()
        {
            return new List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement>
            {
                CleanRoomOddsImprovement.RoomClassUp("B", new[] { 0.092, 0.038, 0.0 }, -0.131),
                CleanRoomOddsImprovement.AddQualityModule(2, new[] { -0.369, 0.370, 0.082 }, -0.082),
                CleanRoomOddsImprovement.AddQualityModule(1, new[] { 0.0, 0.0002, 0.0 }, 0.0001),
            };
        }

        private static void AssertLevel(UiText text, string level, string percent)
        {
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldLevelValue, new[] { "level", level, "percent", percent }, text);
        }

        private static void AssertFailed(UiText text, string percent)
        {
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldFailedValue, new[] { "percent", percent }, text);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldRates.cs` と `CleanRoomYieldRates.cs.meta` を消す（`git rm`）。

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldOdds.cs` を作る。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 役割ごとの最終の確率と「失敗率の改善方法」の行。値はサーバーが計算したものを運ぶだけ（ADR 0105 §2・§4）
    /// Per-role final odds plus the improvement rows; carries server-computed values only (ADR 0105 §2, §4)
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomYieldOdds
    {
        // サーバーの並び（部屋クラス → 最高 Lv を増やす → 1つ上を刺す）のまま。空ならボタンを出さない
        // Server order (room class, more of the top tier, the next tier); empty means no button
        public IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> Improvements { get; }

        public bool HasImprovements => Improvements.Count > 0;

        private protected CleanRoomYieldOdds(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> improvements)
        {
            Improvements = improvements;
        }

        public static CleanRoomYieldOdds LayerExposure(double failedRate, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> improvements)
        {
            return new LayerExposureYieldOdds(failedRate, improvements);
        }

        public static CleanRoomYieldOdds Dicing(int outputCount, IReadOnlyList<double> levelRates, double failedRate, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> improvements)
        {
            return new DicingYieldOdds(outputCount, levelRates, failedRate, improvements);
        }
    }

    // 露光（EUV）は失敗の割合だけ
    // Exposure (EUV) carries only the failure share
    public sealed class LayerExposureYieldOdds : CleanRoomYieldOdds
    {
        public double FailedRate { get; }

        internal LayerExposureYieldOdds(double failedRate, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> improvements) : base(improvements)
        {
            FailedRate = failedRate;
        }
    }

    // ダイシングはウェハ1枚のダイ数・Lv1 から順の最終割合（0 の Lv も入る）・失敗の割合
    // Dicing carries dies per wafer, final shares from Lv1 (zero levels included) and the failure share
    public sealed class DicingYieldOdds : CleanRoomYieldOdds
    {
        public int OutputCount { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<double> LevelRates { get; }
        public double FailedRate { get; }

        internal DicingYieldOdds(int outputCount, IReadOnlyList<double> levelRates, double failedRate, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> improvements) : base(improvements)
        {
            OutputCount = outputCount;
            LevelRates = levelRates;
            FailedRate = failedRate;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 「失敗率の改善方法」の1行。何をするかと、今との差分（サーバーが抽選と同じ式で計算した値）
    /// One improvement row: what to do and the deltas from now (computed by the server with the draw's formula)
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomOddsImprovement
    {
        // Lv1 から順の差分（露光は空）と失敗の差分（負なら失敗が減る）
        // Deltas from Lv1 (empty for exposure) and the failure delta (negative means fewer failures)
        public IReadOnlyList<double> LevelRateDeltas { get; }
        public double FailedRateDelta { get; }

        private protected CleanRoomOddsImprovement(IReadOnlyList<double> levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta)
        {
            LevelRateDeltas = levelRateDeltas;
            FailedRateDelta = failedRateDelta;
        }

        public static CleanRoomOddsImprovement RoomClassUp(string targetClassName, IReadOnlyList<double> levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta)
        {
            return new RoomClassUpOddsImprovement(targetClassName, levelRateDeltas, failedRateDelta);
        }

        public static CleanRoomOddsImprovement AddQualityModule(int moduleTier, IReadOnlyList<double> levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta)
        {
            return new AddQualityModuleOddsImprovement(moduleTier, levelRateDeltas, failedRateDelta);
        }
    }

    // 部屋クラスを1つ上げる（「部屋クラスを B に」）
    // Raise the room class by one ("Raise room class to B")
    public sealed class RoomClassUpOddsImprovement : CleanRoomOddsImprovement
    {
        public string TargetClassName { get; }

        internal RoomClassUpOddsImprovement(string targetClassName, IReadOnlyList<double> levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta) : base(levelRateDeltas, failedRateDelta)
        {
            TargetClassName = targetClassName;
        }
    }

    // その Lv の品質モジュールを1個足す（「品質モジュールLv1 を追加」）
    // Add one quality module of that tier ("Add quality module Lv1")
    public sealed class AddQualityModuleOddsImprovement : CleanRoomOddsImprovement
    {
        public int ModuleTier { get; }

        internal AddQualityModuleOddsImprovement(int moduleTier, IReadOnlyList<double> levelRateDeltas, double failedRateDelta) : base(levelRateDeltas, failedRateDelta)
        {
            ModuleTier = moduleTier;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldLogic.cs` を次の全文に替える（今の9-12行目の重複したコメントもここで消える）。

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Localization;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    // 確率の欄の1行。行の識別子は VisualElement の name に使う
    // One odds row; the row id is used as the VisualElement name
    public sealed class CleanRoomYieldLine
    {
        public string RowId { get; }
        public UiText Text { get; }

        public CleanRoomYieldLine(string rowId, UiText text)
        {
            RowId = rowId;
            Text = text;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 確率の欄の行を作る。割合は小数1桁の百分率で、表示が 0.0% になる Lv は行を作らない（ADR 0105 §2）
    /// Builds the odds rows; shares are one-decimal percentages and a level showing 0.0% gets no row (ADR 0105 §2)
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomYieldLogic
    {
        // 小数1桁で 0 と表示される値
        // The one-decimal text of zero
        internal const string ZeroPercent = "0.0";

        // 確率はいつも今の条件の1組だけ（出力の空き待ちの組は無い。ADR 0105 §3）
        // Always the single set for current conditions (no output-wait set; ADR 0105 §3)
        public static List<CleanRoomYieldLine> Lines(CleanRoomYieldOdds odds)
        {
            switch (odds)
            {
                case LayerExposureYieldOdds layer:
                    return new List<CleanRoomYieldLine> { FailedLine(layer.FailedRate) };
                case DicingYieldOdds dicing:
                    return DicingLines(dicing);
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(odds), odds.GetType().Name, null);
            }

            #region Internal

            // 出力の個数・Lv の割合・失敗の順
            // Output count, level shares, then failure
            List<CleanRoomYieldLine> DicingLines(DicingYieldOdds dicing)
            {
                var lines = new List<CleanRoomYieldLine>
                {
                    new("clean-room-yield-output-count", new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldOutputCount, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("count", UiNumberFormat.Integer(dicing.OutputCount)) })),
                };
                foreach (var level in ShownLevels(dicing.LevelRates))
                {
                    var levelText = UiNumberFormat.Integer(level);
                    var percent = Percent(dicing.LevelRates[level - 1]);
                    lines.Add(new CleanRoomYieldLine($"clean-room-yield-level-rate-{levelText}", new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldLevelRate, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("level", levelText), new LocalizationTextParam("percent", percent) })));
                }
                lines.Add(FailedLine(dicing.FailedRate));
                return lines;
            }

            CleanRoomYieldLine FailedLine(double failedRate)
            {
                return new CleanRoomYieldLine("clean-room-yield-failed-rate", new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldFailedRate, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("percent", Percent(failedRate)) }));
            }

            #endregion
        }

        // 0..1 の割合を小数1桁の百分率の文にする（モーダルの文も同じ書式）
        // A 0..1 share as a one-decimal percentage text (the modal texts share the format)
        internal static string Percent(double rate)
        {
            return UiNumberFormat.Fixed(rate * 100, 1);
        }

        // 表示（絶対値の小数1桁）が 0.0 になるか。0.0 の判定はここ1か所（行を出すか・符号を付けるかの両方。D-8）
        // Whether the one-decimal magnitude shows 0.0; the only zero check (both row visibility and sign; D-8)
        internal static bool ShowsZero(double value)
        {
            return Percent(Math.Abs(value)) == ZeroPercent;
        }

        // 表示が 0.0 にならない Lv の番号（1 から）。欄の行・「今」の値・改善の差分はどれもこの Lv だけを出す（D-8）
        // Level numbers (from 1) whose value does not show 0.0; section rows, current values and improvement deltas all show only these (D-8)
        internal static List<int> ShownLevels(IReadOnlyList<double> levelValues)
        {
            var levels = new List<int>();
            for (var i = 0; i < levelValues.Count; i++)
            {
                if (ShowsZero(levelValues[i])) continue;
                levels.Add(i + 1);
            }
            return levels;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.cs` を作る。

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Localization;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    // 改善の1行: 何をするか（項目名）と、今との差分の並び
    // One improvement row: what to do (label) and the deltas from now
    public sealed class CleanRoomYieldImprovementRow
    {
        public UiText Label { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<UiText> Values { get; }

        public CleanRoomYieldImprovementRow(UiText label, IReadOnlyList<UiText> values)
        {
            Label = label;
            Values = values;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 「失敗率の改善方法」の今の値と改善ごとの差分を作る。差分は符号つき小数1桁で、表示が 0.0 の Lv は出さず失敗はいつも出す
    /// Builds the current values and per-improvement deltas; deltas are signed one-decimal, a level showing 0.0 is dropped and failure always shows
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic
    {
        // 減る向きは全角幅のマイナス記号（U+2212。ADR 0105 §4 の例）
        // The decrease sign is the minus sign U+2212 (ADR 0105 §4 example)
        private const string MinusSign = "−";

        // 「今: Lv1 42.3% / Lv2 7.2% / 失敗 50.5%」の値の並び（欄と同じく表示が 0.0% の Lv は出さない）
        // Values of "Now: Lv1 42.3% / Lv2 7.2% / Failed 50.5%" (levels showing 0.0% are dropped like the section)
        public static IReadOnlyList<UiText> CurrentValues(CleanRoomYieldOdds odds)
        {
            var values = new List<UiText>();
            switch (odds)
            {
                case LayerExposureYieldOdds layer:
                    values.Add(FailedValue(CleanRoomYieldLogic.Percent(layer.FailedRate)));
                    return values;
                case DicingYieldOdds dicing:
                    foreach (var level in CleanRoomYieldLogic.ShownLevels(dicing.LevelRates)) values.Add(LevelValue(level, CleanRoomYieldLogic.Percent(dicing.LevelRates[level - 1])));
                    values.Add(FailedValue(CleanRoomYieldLogic.Percent(dicing.FailedRate)));
                    return values;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(odds), odds.GetType().Name, null);
            }
        }

        // サーバーの並びのまま、改善ごとに項目名と差分を作る
        // Builds a label and deltas per improvement, in server order
        public static IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovementRow> Rows(CleanRoomYieldOdds odds)
        {
            var rows = new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementRow>();
            foreach (var improvement in odds.Improvements) rows.Add(new CleanRoomYieldImprovementRow(Label(improvement), Deltas(improvement)));
            return rows;

            #region Internal

            UiText Label(CleanRoomOddsImprovement improvement)
            {
                switch (improvement)
                {
                    case RoomClassUpOddsImprovement classUp:
                        return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldImproveRoomClass, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("className", classUp.TargetClassName) });
                    case AddQualityModuleOddsImprovement module:
                        return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldImproveAddModule, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("tier", UiNumberFormat.Integer(module.ModuleTier)) });
                    default:
                        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(improvement), improvement.GetType().Name, null);
                }
            }

            // 表示が 0.0 になる Lv の差分は出さず（変わらない Lv で行が長くなるため）、失敗の差分はいつも出す（失敗率の改善が主題のため）
            // Drop level deltas showing 0.0 (unchanged levels only lengthen the line); always show the failure delta (failure is the subject)
            IReadOnlyList<UiText> Deltas(CleanRoomOddsImprovement improvement)
            {
                var values = new List<UiText>();
                foreach (var level in CleanRoomYieldLogic.ShownLevels(improvement.LevelRateDeltas)) values.Add(LevelValue(level, Signed(improvement.LevelRateDeltas[level - 1])));
                values.Add(FailedValue(Signed(improvement.FailedRateDelta)));
                return values;
            }

            // 絶対値を小数1桁にし、0.0 でなければ +/− を付ける
            // One-decimal magnitude with + or − unless it shows 0.0
            string Signed(double delta)
            {
                if (CleanRoomYieldLogic.ShowsZero(delta)) return CleanRoomYieldLogic.ZeroPercent;
                return (0 < delta ? "+" : MinusSign) + CleanRoomYieldLogic.Percent(Math.Abs(delta));
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private static UiText LevelValue(int level, string percent)
        {
            return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldLevelValue, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("level", UiNumberFormat.Integer(level)), new LocalizationTextParam("percent", percent) });
        }

        private static UiText FailedValue(string percent)
        {
            return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldFailedValue, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("percent", percent) });
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: 照会の写しを替える**

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Context/ContextViewConversion.cs` を次の全文に替える（`Stall` は今のまま。直す前は `Yield` の22-28行目が `layer.LayerExposure.LayerFailRate`・`layer.PendingDraw`・`dicing.Dicing`・`dicing.PendingDraw` を読み、45行目の `Dicing(DicingYieldMessagePack)` が `DieLossRate`・`QualityTier` を読む）。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Game.InGame.BlockInfoPolling;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Core.Master;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 確率と搬入停止の照会を欄へ写す。未知のビュー・写せない改善の種別は異常の文面を返し、ログは呼び手の AnomalyReportGate が継続中 1 回だけ出す。壊れた改善の行は読み口が読めない応答にする
    /// Maps the odds and stall queries onto entries; unknown views or unmapped improvement kinds return the anomaly text, logged once while it persists by the caller's AnomalyReportGate; the reader turns broken improvement rows into an unreadable response
    /// </summary>
    public static class ContextViewConversion
    {
        // 確率は最終の内訳と改善の行だけを読む（出力待ちの組・損失率・品質 Tier は読まない。ADR 0105 §2・§3）
        // Reads only the final odds and improvement rows (no output-wait set, loss rate or quality tier; ADR 0105 §2, §3)
        public static SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds> Yield(BlockInfoFetchState fetchState, CleanRoomYieldView view, out string anomaly)
        {
            anomaly = null;
            if (fetchState != BlockInfoFetchState.Fetched) return SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Unavailable(fetchState);
            switch (view)
            {
                case CleanRoomYieldLayerExposureView layer:
                    if (!TryConvertImprovements(layer.Improvements, out var layerImprovements, out anomaly)) return SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Absent;
                    return SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Present(CleanRoomYieldOdds.LayerExposure(layer.Odds.FailedRate, layerImprovements));
                case CleanRoomYieldDicingView dicing:
                    var odds = dicing.Odds;
                    if (!TryConvertImprovements(dicing.Improvements, out var dicingImprovements, out anomaly)) return SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Absent;
                    return SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Present(CleanRoomYieldOdds.Dicing(odds.OutputCount, odds.LevelRates, odds.FailedRate, dicingImprovements));
                // 役割の無いレシピ等は欄を出さない
                // Role-less recipes and machines that cannot operate show no entry; the room entry shows the halt reason
                case CleanRoomYieldNoRoleView _:
                case CleanRoomYieldNotOperableView _:
                    return SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Absent;
            }

            // 未知の型は欄を出さず開発者へ知らせる（購読の中で投げると購読ごと止まる。D-6）
            // An unknown view hides the entry and tells developers (throwing inside the subscription would kill it; D-6)
            anomaly = $"[ContextViewConversion] unsupported yield view: {view.GetType().Name}";
            return SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Absent;
        }

        // 改善の行をサーバーの並びのまま写す。差分の長さ・未定義の種別・クラス名は読み口（CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.AreReadable）が検査済みなので、ここでは検査しない（D-14）
        // Copies improvement rows in server order; delta length, undefined kinds and class names were checked by the reader (AreReadable), so nothing is re-checked here (D-14)
        private static bool TryConvertImprovements(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> packs, out List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement> improvements, out string anomaly)
        {
            improvements = new List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement>();
            anomaly = null;
            foreach (var pack in packs)
            {
                if (pack.TryGetRoomClassUp(out var targetClassName))
                {
                    improvements.Add(CleanRoomOddsImprovement.RoomClassUp(targetClassName, pack.LevelRateDeltas, pack.FailedRateDelta));
                    continue;
                }
                if (pack.TryGetAddQualityModule(out var moduleTier))
                {
                    improvements.Add(CleanRoomOddsImprovement.AddQualityModule(moduleTier, pack.LevelRateDeltas, pack.FailedRateDelta));
                    continue;
                }

                // 写せない種別は、種別を足してこの写しを直し忘れたとき（定義済みの種別は AreReadable を通る）。欄を出さず開発者へ知らせる（購読の中で投げると購読ごと止まる。D-6）
                // An unmapped kind means one was added without updating this mapping (defined kinds pass AreReadable); hide the entry and tell developers (throwing inside the subscription would kill it; D-6)
                anomaly = $"[ContextViewConversion] unmapped improvement kind: {pack.Kind}";
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        public static SectionContent<MachineInputStall> Stall(BlockInfoFetchState fetchState, MachineInputStallView view, out string anomaly)
        {
            anomaly = null;
            if (fetchState != BlockInfoFetchState.Fetched) return SectionContent<MachineInputStall>.Unavailable(fetchState);
            switch (view)
            {
                case MachineInputStalledView stalled:
                    return SectionContent<MachineInputStall>.Present(new MachineInputStall(stalled.Stall.Reason, new ItemId(stalled.Stall.WaitingItemId)));
                case MachineInputNotStalledView _:
                    return SectionContent<MachineInputStall>.Absent;
            }

            // 未知の型は欄を出さず開発者へ知らせる（D-6）
            // An unknown view hides the entry and tells developers (D-6)
            anomaly = $"[ContextViewConversion] unsupported stall view: {view.GetType().Name}";
            return SectionContent<MachineInputStall>.Absent;
        }
    }
}
```

### Task D4: 部屋欄を照会元ごとに分ける（機械は部屋クラス1行、清浄機は台数つき）

室内機械の部屋欄は「部屋クラス C」の1行と停止理由だけにする（ADR 0105 §1）。清浄機の部屋欄は「クラスC（クラスBまであと5台）」「清浄機 6台（うち1台が止まっています）」「この清浄機: 電力 100% / 残量 50%」の3行にし、換気回数・清浄機ごとの行・清浄機なしの行を消す（ADR 0105 §5）。クライアントは C6 の `AirFilterCount`・`StoppedAirFilterCount`・`NextClass`・`QueriedAirFilter` だけを読み、C7 で消える `AirChangeRate`・`AirFilters` を読まない。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Tests.Ui.TestDoubles;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 部屋欄の行（室内機械は部屋クラスだけ、清浄機は台数つき。ADR 0105 §1・§5）
    /// Room section rows (class only for machines; counts for purifiers; ADR 0105 §1, §5)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomLogicTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void 室内機械は部屋クラスの1行だけを出す()
        {
            var view = CleanRoomLogic.Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForMachine(CleanRoomHeadline.Class("C")), CleanRoomHaltReason.None));

            Assert.IsInstanceOf<HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay>(view);
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomClass, new[] { "className", "C" }, view.Headline);
            Assert.IsFalse(view.HeadlineInsufficient);
            Assert.IsFalse(view.TryGetHaltReason(out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 室内機械のOutは赤で示し停止理由を出す()
        {
            var view = CleanRoomLogic.Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForMachine(CleanRoomHeadline.ClassOut), CleanRoomHaltReason.ClassOut));

            Assert.IsInstanceOf<HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay>(view);
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomClassOut, view.Headline);
            Assert.IsTrue(view.HeadlineInsufficient);
            Assert.IsTrue(view.TryGetHaltReason(out var haltReason));
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomHaltClassOut, haltReason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 清浄機は次のクラスまでの台数つきの見出しと台数とこの清浄機を出す()
        {
            var status = CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.WithUnitsToNextClass(6, 0, 0.756, 0.5, "B", 5);
            var view = (AirFilterCleanRoomDisplay)CleanRoomLogic.Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForAirFilter(CleanRoomHeadline.Class("C"), status), CleanRoomHaltReason.None));

            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomPurifierClassUnitsToNext, new[] { "className", "C", "nextClassName", "B", "units", "5" }, view.Headline);
            Assert.IsFalse(view.HeadlineInsufficient);
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomAirFilterCount, new[] { "count", "6" }, view.AirFilterCount);
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomQueriedAirFilter, new[] { "power", "76", "remaining", "50" }, view.QueriedAirFilter);
            Assert.IsFalse(view.TryGetHaltReason(out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 台数で次のクラスへ届かない清浄機の見出しはクラスだけ()
        {
            var status = CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.WithoutUnitsToNextClass(3, 0, 1, 1);
            var view = CleanRoomLogic.Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForAirFilter(CleanRoomHeadline.Class("A"), status), CleanRoomHaltReason.None));

            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomPurifierClass, new[] { "className", "A" }, view.Headline);
        }

        [Test]
        public void クラス未達の清浄機は赤で_台数で届くなら次のクラスまでの台数を添える()
        {
            var withUnits = CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.WithUnitsToNextClass(1, 0, 1, 1, "D", 2);
            var view = CleanRoomLogic.Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForAirFilter(CleanRoomHeadline.ClassOut, withUnits), CleanRoomHaltReason.None));
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomPurifierClassOutUnitsToNext, new[] { "nextClassName", "D", "units", "2" }, view.Headline);
            Assert.IsTrue(view.HeadlineInsufficient);

            var withoutUnits = CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.WithoutUnitsToNextClass(1, 0, 1, 1);
            var unreachable = CleanRoomLogic.Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForAirFilter(CleanRoomHeadline.ClassOut, withoutUnits), CleanRoomHaltReason.None));
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomClassOut, unreachable.Headline);
            Assert.IsTrue(unreachable.HeadlineInsufficient);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 止まった清浄機があれば台数の行にうち何台かを添える()
        {
            var status = CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.WithoutUnitsToNextClass(6, 1, 0, 0.25);
            var view = (AirFilterCleanRoomDisplay)CleanRoomLogic.Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForAirFilter(CleanRoomHeadline.Class("C"), status), CleanRoomHaltReason.None));

            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomAirFilterCountStopped, new[] { "count", "6", "stopped", "1" }, view.AirFilterCount);
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomQueriedAirFilter, new[] { "power", "0", "remaining", "25" }, view.QueriedAirFilter);
        }

        private static IEnumerable<TestCaseData> UnsealedCases()
        {
            yield return new TestCaseData(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Openings(3, CleanRoomHaltReason.NotEnclosed), "ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomNotSealed", new[] { "count", "3" }, true).SetName("未密閉_開口あり");
            yield return new TestCaseData(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.NoEnclosure(CleanRoomHaltReason.NotEnclosed), "ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomNoEnclosure", new string[0], true).SetName("未密閉_囲い無し");
            yield return new TestCaseData(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.TooLarge(4096, CleanRoomHaltReason.NotEnclosed), "ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomTooLarge", new[] { "max", "4096" }, true).SetName("未密閉_大きすぎ");
            yield return new TestCaseData(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Detecting(CleanRoomHaltReason.NotEnclosed), "ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomDetecting", new string[0], false).SetName("未密閉_検出中");
        }

        /// <web-test file="src/features/blockInventory/details/cleanRoom/__tests__/cleanRoomLogic.test.ts">未密閉 %j は見出しだけを出す</web-test>
        [TestCaseSource(nameof(UnsealedCases))]
        public void 未密閉の部屋は見出しだけを出す(CleanRoomFetchedDetail cleanRoom, string headlineKey, string[] headlineParams, bool insufficient)
        {
            var view = CleanRoomLogic.Display(cleanRoom);
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(headlineKey, headlineParams, view.Headline);
            Assert.AreEqual(insufficient, view.HeadlineInsufficient);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay>(view);
            Assert.IsTrue(view.TryGetHaltReason(out var haltReason));
            UiTextAssert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomHaltNotEnclosed, haltReason);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/Ui/State/BlockInventory/Context/ContextViewConversionTest.cs` を次の全文に替える（D3 で確率のテストを外した後の形から、部屋のテストを新しい項目で書き直す。詰まり・区画の2本は中身を変えない）。

```csharp
using Client.Game.InGame.BlockInfoPolling;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockDetail.CleanRoom;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 部屋と搬入停止の照会から欄への写し（部屋は照会元ごとに読む項目が違う。ADR 0105 §1・§5）
    /// Mapping the room and stall queries onto entries (the room reads different fields per query source; ADR 0105 §1, §5)
    /// </summary>
    public class ContextViewConversionTest
    {
        private const BlockInfoFetchState Fetched = BlockInfoFetchState.Fetched;
        private static readonly CleanRoomDetailTarget Machine = CleanRoomDetailTarget.Machine;
        private static readonly CleanRoomDetailTarget AirFilter = CleanRoomDetailTarget.AirFilter;

        // クラスC・清浄機6台（うち1台停止）・Bまであと5台・照会した清浄機は電力 100%・残量 50%
        // Class C, six purifiers (one stopped), five more to B, the queried purifier at full power and half life
        private static CleanRoomEnclosedView ClassC(CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack nextClass, CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack queriedAirFilter)
        {
            return new CleanRoomEnclosedView(CleanRoomWireSamples.ClassifiedRoom("C", 2, 6, 1, nextClass, queriedAirFilter));
        }

        private static CleanRoomEnclosedView ClassC()
        {
            return ClassC(CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateUnitsToNextClass("B", 5), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateAirFilter(1, 0.5));
        }

        private static CleanRoomFetchedDetail Machined(CleanRoomInfoView view, CleanRoomOperability operability) =>
            SectionContentAssert.Present(CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(Machine, Fetched, view, new CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail(operability), out _));

        private static CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus AirFiltered(CleanRoomInfoView view)
        {
            var detail = (EnclosedCleanRoomDetail)SectionContentAssert.Present(CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(AirFilter, Fetched, view, null, out var anomaly));
            Assert.IsNull(anomaly);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<AirFilterCleanRoomSummary>(detail.Room, "清浄機の照会は清浄機から見た部屋を持つ");
            return ((AirFilterCleanRoomSummary)detail.Room).AirFilter;
        }

        [Test]
        public void 部屋の未取得は取得状態の1行で_室内機械は部屋クラスだけを写す()
        {
            var unavailable = CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(Machine, BlockInfoFetchState.NotFetched, null, null, out _);
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoFetchState.NotFetched, SectionContentAssert.Unavailable(unavailable), "稼働可否の詳細が無くても取得状態を先に見る");

            var enclosed = (EnclosedCleanRoomDetail)Machined(ClassC(), CleanRoomOperability.Operable);
            Assert.AreEqual("C", ((ClassCleanRoomHeadline)enclosed.Room.Headline).ClassName);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<MachineCleanRoomSummary>(enclosed.Room, "室内機械は清浄機の行を持たない");

            var outRoom = new CleanRoomEnclosedView(CleanRoomWireSamples.OutRoom(1, 0, CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateNotCounted(), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateNotAirFilter()));
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<ClassOutCleanRoomHeadline>(((EnclosedCleanRoomDetail)Machined(outRoom, CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut)).Room.Headline);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 清浄機は台数と止まった台数と次のクラスまでの台数と自分の電力と残量を写す()
        {
            var status = AirFiltered(ClassC());

            Assert.AreEqual(6, status.AirFilterCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, status.StoppedAirFilterCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(1.0, status.PowerRatio);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.5, status.FilterRemainingRatio);
            Assert.IsTrue(status.TryGetUnitsToNextClass(out var nextClassName, out var units));
            Assert.AreEqual("B", nextClassName);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, units);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 最上位_届かないときは次のクラスまでの台数を持たない()
        {
            var queried = CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateAirFilter(1, 1);
            Assert.IsFalse(AirFiltered(ClassC(CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateAtBestClass(), queried)).TryGetUnitsToNextClass(out _, out _));
            Assert.IsFalse(AirFiltered(ClassC(CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateUnreachable("A"), queried)).TryGetUnitsToNextClass(out _, out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 清浄機の照会なのに自分の状態が無ければ欄を出さず異常を返す()
        {
            var view = ClassC(CleanRoomNextClassMessagePack.CreateNotCounted(), CleanRoomQueriedAirFilterMessagePack.CreateNotAirFilter());
            var entry = CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(AirFilter, Fetched, view, null, out var anomaly);

            Assert.IsTrue(entry.IsAbsent);
            Assert.AreEqual("[CleanRoomViewConversion] air-filter room query carries no queried air-filter status", anomaly, "ログは出さず異常の文面を返す");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 部屋の漏れは種類ごとの値を写す()
        {
            var openings = (OpeningsCleanRoomDetail)Machined(new CleanRoomNotEnclosedView(new CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView(7)), CleanRoomOperability.Operable);
            Assert.AreEqual(7, openings.OpeningCount);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<NoEnclosureCleanRoomDetail>(Machined(new CleanRoomNotEnclosedView(CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView.Instance), CleanRoomOperability.Operable));
            Assert.AreEqual(900, ((TooLargeCleanRoomDetail)Machined(new CleanRoomNotEnclosedView(new CleanRoomTooLargeLeakView(900)), CleanRoomOperability.Operable)).MaxRoomVolume);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<DetectingCleanRoomDetail>(Machined(new CleanRoomNotEnclosedView(CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView.Instance), CleanRoomOperability.Operable));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 停止理由は室内機械の稼働可否から_清浄機はNone()
        {
            var view = ClassC();
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomHaltReason.NotEnclosed, Machined(view, CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed).HaltReason);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomHaltReason.ClassOut, Machined(view, CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut).HaltReason);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomHaltReason.None, Machined(view, CleanRoomOperability.Operable).HaltReason);
            var airFilter = CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(AirFilter, Fetched, view, null, out _);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomHaltReason.None, SectionContentAssert.Present(airFilter).HaltReason);

            Assert.IsFalse(CleanRoomViewConversion.TryGetHaltReason((CleanRoomOperability)99, out _, out var anomaly));
            Assert.AreEqual("[CleanRoomViewConversion] unsupported operability: 99", anomaly, "ログは出さず異常の文面を返す");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 室内機械で取得済みなのに稼働可否の詳細が無い_または列挙外なら欄なし()
        {
            var view = ClassC();
            Assert.IsTrue(CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(Machine, Fetched, view, null, out _).IsAbsent);
            Assert.IsTrue(CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(CleanRoomDetailTarget.None, Fetched, view, null, out _).IsAbsent);

            Assert.IsTrue(CleanRoomViewConversion.Build(Machine, Fetched, view, new CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail((CleanRoomOperability)99), out var anomaly).IsAbsent);
            Assert.AreEqual("Unreadable clean-room operability: 99", anomaly, "ログは出さず異常の文面を返す");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 詰まりは未取得なら取得状態_停止なら理由と品_止まっていなければ欄なし()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoFetchState.NotFetched, SectionContentAssert.Unavailable(ContextViewConversion.Stall(BlockInfoFetchState.NotFetched, null, out _)));
            var stalled = ContextViewConversion.Stall(Fetched, new MachineInputStalledView(new MachineInputStallMessagePack(MachineInputStallReasonKind.AboveCraftCap, 5)), out _);
            Assert.IsTrue(stalled.TryGetPresent(out var stall));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineInputStallReasonKind.AboveCraftCap, stall.Reason);
            Assert.AreEqual(new ItemId(5), stall.WaitingItemId);
            Assert.IsTrue(ContextViewConversion.Stall(Fetched, MachineInputNotStalledView.Instance, out _).IsAbsent);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 区画を出すのは機械でなく_3欄のどれかが無しでないときだけ()
        {
            var stall = SectionContent<MachineInputStall>.Present(new MachineInputStall(MachineInputStallReasonKind.MixedLevel, new ItemId(1)));
            var withStall = new BlockContextViewModel(SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent, SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Absent, stall);
            var unavailableRoom = new BlockContextViewModel(SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Unavailable(BlockInfoFetchState.NotFetched), SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Absent, SectionContent<MachineInputStall>.Absent);

            Assert.IsFalse(ContextSectionVisibility.Shows(true, withStall), "機械は専用の区画");
            Assert.IsFalse(ContextSectionVisibility.Shows(false, BlockContextViewModel.None), "3 欄とも無し");
            Assert.IsTrue(ContextSectionVisibility.Shows(false, withStall));
            Assert.IsTrue(ContextSectionVisibility.Shows(false, unavailableRoom), "未取得も無しではない");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Ui.Components.Controls;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Machine.RecipeSelection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// ウィンドウが低いときの清浄室の配置（舞台 1280×720 と縮めた 600。部屋欄は台数に関係なく最大3行。ADR 0105 §5）
    /// Clean-room layout with low windows (the 1280x720 stage and a shrunk 600; the room section is at most three lines whatever the count; ADR 0105 §5)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomLayoutTest : CleanRoomLayoutTestHost
    {
        private const string NaturalScrollName = "block-inventory-natural-scroll";

        [TestCase(600f)]
        [TestCase(720f)]
        public void 清浄機パネルは部屋欄の最後の行とフィルタ枠へ届き枠が安全帯へ潜らない(float stageHeight)
        {

            // 部屋欄とフィルタ枠は入れ子なしの同じ視口
            // Room rows and the filter grid share one viewport with no nested vertical scroller
            Assert.IsNotNull(scroll.contentContainer.Q("clean-room-section"));
            Assert.IsNull(scroll.GetFirstAncestorOfType<GameScrollView>());
        }

        [Test]
        public void 清浄機パネルは自然高のままスクロールしない()
        {
            var shell = OpenAirFilterPanel();
            var scroll = shell.View.Q("clean-room-filter-grid").GetFirstAncestorOfType<GameScrollView>();
            Assert.AreEqual(NaturalScrollName, scroll.name);
            Assert.LessOrEqual(scroll.GetContentHeight(), scroll.GetViewportHeight() + 0.01f);
            ExpectPanelAboveSafeBand(shell);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 部屋の中の室内機械で液体行が電力行と状態行に重ならない()
        {
            var shell = OpenCleanRoomMachine(true);
            Assert.IsNotNull(shell.View.Q("clean-room-headline"));

            // 本文側は視口で切った可視矩形で比べる
            // Compare the body side by its rect clipped to the scroll viewport
            var fluids = shell.View.Q("machine-fluid-slots");
            var viewport = fluids.GetFirstAncestorOfType<GameScrollView>().contentViewport.worldBound;
            var visibleFluids = Intersect(fluids.worldBound, viewport);
            foreach (var name in new[] { "machine-power-rate", "machine-state-label" })
            {
                var overlap = Intersect(visibleFluids, shell.View.Q(name).worldBound);
                Assert.IsFalse(0 < overlap.width && 0 < overlap.height, $"{name} overlap {overlap.width}x{overlap.height}");
            }
            ExpectFooterClearOfBody(shell);
        }

        [TestCase(600f)]
        [TestCase(720f)]
        public void 部屋の中の室内機械は部屋欄ごと本文がレシピとスロットと液体に届きフッタが読める(float stageHeight)
        {
            var shell = OpenCleanRoomMachine(true);
            SetStageHeight(shell, stageHeight);
            ExpectFooterClearOfBody(shell);
            ExpectReachable(shell, "clean-room-headline");
            ExpectInventoryBodyReachable(shell);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 部屋の中の室内機械のレシピ選択でも部屋欄と同じ視口で最後のレシピ行へ届く()
        {
            var shell = OpenCleanRoomMachine(true);
            ExpectReachable(shell, "machine-selected-recipe");
            simulate.Click(shell.View.Q("machine-selected-recipe").worldBound.center);
            simulate.FrameUpdate();
            simulate.FrameUpdate();
            ExpectFooterReadable(shell);
            var rows = shell.View.Q(MachineRecipeSelectionList.ListTestid).Query<MachineRecipeSelectionRowView>().ToList();
            Assert.Greater(rows.Count, 0);
            var scroll = rows[0].GetFirstAncestorOfType<GameScrollView>();
            ExpectReachableInScrollViewport(scroll, rows[0]);
            ExpectReachableInScrollViewport(scroll, rows[rows.Count - 1]);
            ExpectSharedBodyViewport(shell, MachineRecipeSelectionList.ListTestid);
        }

        /// <web-test file="e2e/tests/block/cleanRoom/cleanRoomManyFilters.spec.ts">部屋の無い大型機械は部屋欄なしで本文に届き、フッタが読める</web-test>
        [Test]
        public void 部屋の無い大型機械は部屋欄なしで本文に届きフッタが読める()
        {
            var shell = OpenCleanRoomMachine(false);
            Assert.IsNull(shell.View.Q("clean-room-section"));
            foreach (var name in new[] { "machine-selected-recipe", "machine-input-slots", "machine-fluid-slots" }) ExpectReachable(shell, name);
            ExpectFooterReadable(shell);
        }

        // Web expectPanelAboveHotbar の写し
        // Web expectPanelAboveHotbar: the panel bottom stays above the safe band
        private static void ExpectPanelAboveSafeBand(BlockInventoryTestShell shell)
        {
            Assert.LessOrEqual(shell.View.worldBound.yMax, shell.Stage.worldBound.yMax - BlockInventoryTestShell.MenuLowerSafeArea + 0.5f);
        }

        // Web expectFooterClearOfBody
        // Web expectFooterClearOfBody: the footer stays below the body viewport
        private static void ExpectFooterClearOfBody(BlockInventoryTestShell shell)
        {
            var panel = shell.View.worldBound;
            var viewport = shell.View.Q("machine-inventory-body").GetFirstAncestorOfType<GameScrollView>().contentViewport.worldBound;
            foreach (var name in new[] { "machine-state-label", "machine-power-rate" })
            {
                var footer = shell.View.Q(name).worldBound;
                Assert.LessOrEqual(footer.yMax, panel.yMax + 0.5f, $"{name} inside panel");
                Assert.LessOrEqual(viewport.yMax, footer.yMin + 0.5f, $"viewport above {name}");
            }
        }

        private static Rect Intersect(Rect a, Rect b)
        {
            var xMin = Mathf.Max(a.xMin, b.xMin);
            var yMin = Mathf.Max(a.yMin, b.yMin);
            return new Rect(xMin, yMin, Mathf.Min(a.xMax, b.xMax) - xMin, Mathf.Min(a.yMax, b.yMax) - yMin);
        }
    }
}
```
