- [ ] **Step 6: 清浄機から見た部屋の型を作り、部屋の要約を分ける**

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.cs` を作る。

```csharp
namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 清浄機から見た部屋: 台数・止まっている台数・次のクラスまでの台数・照会した清浄機の電力と残量（値はサーバーが数えたもの。ADR 0105 §5）
    /// The room as a purifier sees it: counts, stopped count, units to the next class and the queried purifier's power and life (server-counted; ADR 0105 §5)
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus
    {
        public int AirFilterCount { get; }
        public int StoppedAirFilterCount { get; }
        public double PowerRatio { get; }
        public double FilterRemainingRatio { get; }

        // 次のクラスまでの台数。台数で届くときだけ台数を持つ型（最上位・届かない・数えていないは持たない型）
        // Units to the next class; only the reachable type carries numbers (not at best, unreachable or not counted)
        private readonly CleanRoomUnitsToNextClass _unitsToNextClass;

        private CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus(int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, double powerRatio, double filterRemainingRatio, CleanRoomUnitsToNextClass unitsToNextClass)
        {
            AirFilterCount = airFilterCount;
            StoppedAirFilterCount = stoppedAirFilterCount;
            PowerRatio = powerRatio;
            FilterRemainingRatio = filterRemainingRatio;
            _unitsToNextClass = unitsToNextClass;
        }

        public static CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus WithUnitsToNextClass(int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, double powerRatio, double filterRemainingRatio, string nextClassName, int units)
        {
            return new CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus(airFilterCount, stoppedAirFilterCount, powerRatio, filterRemainingRatio, new ReachableUnitsToNextClass(nextClassName, units));
        }

        public static CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus WithoutUnitsToNextClass(int airFilterCount, int stoppedAirFilterCount, double powerRatio, double filterRemainingRatio)
        {
            return new CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus(airFilterCount, stoppedAirFilterCount, powerRatio, filterRemainingRatio, NoUnitsToNextClass.Instance);
        }

        public bool TryGetUnitsToNextClass(out string nextClassName, out int units)
        {
            if (_unitsToNextClass is ReachableUnitsToNextClass reachable)
            {
                nextClassName = reachable.NextClassName;
                units = reachable.Units;
                return true;
            }
            nextClassName = default;
            units = default;
            return false;
        }
    }

    // 次のクラスまでの台数の種別。台数と次のクラス名は届く型だけが持つ
    // Kinds of units-to-next-class; only the reachable kind holds the count and next class name
    internal abstract class CleanRoomUnitsToNextClass
    {
        private protected CleanRoomUnitsToNextClass()
        {
        }
    }

    internal sealed class ReachableUnitsToNextClass : CleanRoomUnitsToNextClass
    {
        public string NextClassName { get; }
        public int Units { get; }

        internal ReachableUnitsToNextClass(string nextClassName, int units)
        {
            NextClassName = nextClassName;
            Units = units;
        }
    }

    internal sealed class NoUnitsToNextClass : CleanRoomUnitsToNextClass
    {
        public static readonly NoUnitsToNextClass Instance = new();

        private NoUnitsToNextClass()
        {
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        public double AirChangeRate { get; }

        public CleanRoomSummary(CleanRoomHeadline headline, double airChangeRate, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomAirFilter> airFilters)

            AirFilters = airFilters;
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomDisplay.cs` を次の全文に替える（`TryGetHaltReason` は今のまま。`EnclosedCleanRoomDisplay` を `AirFilterCleanRoomDisplay` に替える）。

```csharp
using System;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 部屋欄の各行。台数とこの清浄機の行は清浄機から見た部屋の派生にだけある（ADR 0105 §5）
    /// The room section's rows; the count and own-status rows exist only on the purifier subtype (ADR 0105 §5)
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomDisplay
    {
        public UiText Headline { get; }
        public bool HeadlineInsufficient { get; }
        private readonly CleanRoomHaltReason _haltReason;

        private protected CleanRoomDisplay(UiText headline, bool headlineInsufficient, CleanRoomHaltReason haltReason)
        {
            Headline = headline;
            HeadlineInsufficient = headlineInsufficient;
            _haltReason = haltReason;
        }

        // 停止理由の行。止まっていなければ行なし
        // The halt-reason row; none while not halted
        public bool TryGetHaltReason(out UiText haltReason)
        {
            haltReason = _haltReason switch
            {
                CleanRoomHaltReason.None => null,
                CleanRoomHaltReason.NotEnclosed => new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomHaltNotEnclosed),
                CleanRoomHaltReason.ClassOut => new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomHaltClassOut),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(_haltReason), _haltReason, null),
            };
            return _haltReason != CleanRoomHaltReason.None;
        }
    }

    // 清浄機から見た密閉された部屋。台数の行とこの清浄機の行を持つ
    // An enclosed room seen from a purifier; carries the count row and the own-status row
    public sealed class AirFilterCleanRoomDisplay : CleanRoomDisplay
    {
        public UiText AirFilterCount { get; }
        public UiText QueriedAirFilter { get; }

        internal AirFilterCleanRoomDisplay(UiText headline, bool headlineInsufficient, UiText airFilterCount, UiText queriedAirFilter, CleanRoomHaltReason haltReason) : base(headline, headlineInsufficient, haltReason)
        {
            AirFilterCount = airFilterCount;
            QueriedAirFilter = queriedAirFilter;
        }
    }

    // 室内機械の部屋クラス・密閉されていない・検出中は見出しだけ
    // An interior machine's room class, unsealed or detecting rooms show the headline only
    public sealed class HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay : CleanRoomDisplay
    {
        internal HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay(UiText headline, bool headlineInsufficient, CleanRoomHaltReason haltReason) : base(headline, headlineInsufficient, haltReason)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomLogic.cs` を次の全文に替える（`Display` の switch・未密閉の4つ・`RoundedPercent`・`Line` は今のまま。`EnclosedRows` を書き直す）。

```csharp
using System;
using Client.Localization;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 部屋欄の各行のキーと引数を作る。赤（不足）は稼働を妨げている行だけに付ける
    /// Builds keys and params for each room row; red (insufficient) marks only rows that block operation
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLogic
    {
        public static CleanRoomDisplay Display(CleanRoomFetchedDetail cleanRoom)
        {
            var haltReason = cleanRoom.HaltReason;
            switch (cleanRoom)
            {
                case EnclosedCleanRoomDetail enclosed:
                    return EnclosedRows(enclosed.Room, haltReason);
                case OpeningsCleanRoomDetail openings:
                    return new HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay(Line(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomNotSealed, "count", UiNumberFormat.Integer(openings.OpeningCount)), true, haltReason);
                case NoEnclosureCleanRoomDetail _:
                    return new HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay(new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomNoEnclosure), true, haltReason);
                case TooLargeCleanRoomDetail tooLarge:
                    return new HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay(Line(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomTooLarge, "max", UiNumberFormat.Integer(tooLarge.MaxRoomVolume)), true, haltReason);
                case DetectingCleanRoomDetail _:
                    // 検出待ちは数 tick で解消するので赤にしない
                    // Pending detection resolves within ticks, so it is not red
                    return new HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay(new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomDetecting), false, haltReason);
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(cleanRoom), cleanRoom.GetType().Name, null);
            }

            #region Internal

            CleanRoomDisplay EnclosedRows(CleanRoomSummary room, CleanRoomHaltReason haltReason)
            {
                // Out の判定はサーバーが決めた見出しの種別だけで行う
                // Out is read only from the server-decided headline kind
                var isOut = room.Headline is ClassOutCleanRoomHeadline;

                switch (room)
                {
                    // 室内機械は部屋クラスの1行だけ（ADR 0105 §1）
                    // An interior machine shows only the room-class line (ADR 0105 §1)
                    case MachineCleanRoomSummary _:
                        return new HeadlineOnlyCleanRoomDisplay(MachineHeadline(room.Headline), isOut, haltReason);

                    // 清浄機は台数つきの見出し・台数・この清浄機の3行（ADR 0105 §5）
                    // A purifier shows the headline with units, the count and its own status (ADR 0105 §5)
                    case AirFilterCleanRoomSummary airFilterRoom:
                        var airFilter = airFilterRoom.AirFilter;
                        return new AirFilterCleanRoomDisplay(PurifierHeadline(room.Headline, airFilter), isOut, CountLine(airFilter), QueriedLine(airFilter), haltReason);
                    default:
                        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(room), room.GetType().Name, null);
                }
            }

            UiText MachineHeadline(CleanRoomHeadline headline)
            {
                if (headline is ClassCleanRoomHeadline classHeadline) return Line(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomClass, "className", classHeadline.ClassName);
                return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomClassOut);
            }

            // 台数で次のクラスへ届くときだけ「あとN台」を添える
            // Add "N more" only when units reach the next class
            UiText PurifierHeadline(CleanRoomHeadline headline, CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus airFilter)
            {
                var hasUnits = airFilter.TryGetUnitsToNextClass(out var nextClassName, out var units);
                if (headline is ClassCleanRoomHeadline classHeadline)
                {
                    if (!hasUnits) return Line(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomPurifierClass, "className", classHeadline.ClassName);
                    return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomPurifierClassUnitsToNext, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam("className", classHeadline.ClassName), NextClassParam(nextClassName), UnitsParam(units) });
                }
                if (!hasUnits) return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomClassOut);
                return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomPurifierClassOutUnitsToNext, new[] { NextClassParam(nextClassName), UnitsParam(units) });
            }

            LocalizationTextParam NextClassParam(string nextClassName)
            {
                return new LocalizationTextParam("nextClassName", nextClassName);
            }

            LocalizationTextParam UnitsParam(int units)
            {
                return new LocalizationTextParam("units", UiNumberFormat.Integer(units));
            }

            // 止まった清浄機があるときだけ「うちN台」を添える。稼働を妨げる行ではないので赤にしない
            // Add "N stopped" only when some are stopped; it does not block operation, so it is not red
            UiText CountLine(CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus airFilter)
            {
                var count = new LocalizationTextParam("count", UiNumberFormat.Integer(airFilter.AirFilterCount));
                if (airFilter.StoppedAirFilterCount == 0) return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomAirFilterCount, new[] { count });
                return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomAirFilterCountStopped, new[] { count, new LocalizationTextParam("stopped", UiNumberFormat.Integer(airFilter.StoppedAirFilterCount)) });
            }

            UiText QueriedLine(CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus airFilter)
            {
                return new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomQueriedAirFilter, new[]
                {
                    new LocalizationTextParam("power", RoundedPercent(airFilter.PowerRatio)),
                    new LocalizationTextParam("remaining", RoundedPercent(airFilter.FilterRemainingRatio)),
                });
            }

            // 0..1 の割合を四捨五入した整数の百分率にする（Web の Math.round(x * 100)）
            // A 0..1 ratio as a rounded whole percentage (Web Math.round(x * 100))
            string RoundedPercent(double ratio)
            {
                return UiNumberFormat.Integer(UiNumberFormat.RoundHalfUp(ratio * 100));
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private static UiText Line(LocalizationKey key, string paramName, string paramValue)
        {
            return new UiText(key, new[] { new LocalizationTextParam(paramName, paramValue) });
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: 照会の写しを照会元ごとにする**

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Context/CleanRoomViewConversion.cs` を次の全文に替える（`Build` の分岐の順・`Leak`・`TryGetHaltReason` は今のまま。`Convert` に照会元を渡し、直す前の83-89行目 `static CleanRoomSummary Room(...)`〈`room.AirFilters`・`room.AirChangeRate` を読む〉を `EnclosedRoom` に替える）。

```csharp
using System;
using Client.Game.InGame.BlockInfoPolling;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockDetail.CleanRoom;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 部屋の照会を照会元（室内機械／清浄機）ごとに入力型へ写す
    /// Maps the room query onto the input type per query source (interior machine or purifier)
    /// 未知の型・値は異常の文面を返し、ログは呼び手の AnomalyReportGate が継続中 1 回だけ出す
    /// An unknown view or value returns the anomaly text, logged once while it persists by the caller's AnomalyReportGate
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomViewConversion
    {
        // 部屋欄を状態詳細から決める静的関数
        // Decides the room entry from target kind, fetch state and operability; static function split from the model
        public static SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail> Build(CleanRoomDetailTarget target, BlockInfoFetchState fetchState, CleanRoomInfoView view, CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail operability, out string anomaly)
        {
            anomaly = null;
            if (target == CleanRoomDetailTarget.None) return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent;

            // 未取得は取得状態の 1 行
            // Not fetched yields the fetch-state line for any target, in the Web host's order
            if (fetchState != BlockInfoFetchState.Fetched) return Convert(target, fetchState, view, CleanRoomHaltReason.None, out anomaly);
            if (target == CleanRoomDetailTarget.AirFilter) return Convert(target, fetchState, view, CleanRoomHaltReason.None, out anomaly);

            // 室内機械の停止理由は状態詳細から
            // A fetched interior machine's halt reason comes from its state detail; no entry until present
            // silent-ok: 稼働可否の状態詳細が届く前は欄を出さない（Web ホストと同じ） / 届けば状態変化の購読で出る
            if (operability == null) return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent;
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CleanRoomOperability), operability.Operability))
            {
                anomaly = $"Unreadable clean-room operability: {operability.Operability}";
                return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent;
            }
            if (!TryGetHaltReason(operability.Operability, out var haltReason, out anomaly)) return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent;
            return Convert(target, fetchState, view, haltReason, out anomaly);
        }

        private static SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail> Convert(CleanRoomDetailTarget target, BlockInfoFetchState fetchState, CleanRoomInfoView view, CleanRoomHaltReason haltReason, out string anomaly)
        {
            anomaly = null;
            if (fetchState != BlockInfoFetchState.Fetched) return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Unavailable(fetchState);
            switch (view)
            {
                case CleanRoomEnclosedView enclosed:
                    return EnclosedRoom(enclosed.Room, out anomaly);
                case CleanRoomNotEnclosedView notEnclosed:
                    return Leak(notEnclosed.Leak, out anomaly);
            }

            // 未知の照会の型は欄を出さず開発者へ知らせる（購読の中で投げると購読ごと止まる。D-6）
            // An unknown query view hides the entry and tells developers (throwing inside the subscription would kill it; D-6)
            anomaly = $"[CleanRoomViewConversion] unsupported room query view: {view.GetType().Name}";
            return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent;

            #region Internal

            SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail> EnclosedRoom(CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack room, out string roomAnomaly)
            {
                roomAnomaly = null;
                var headline = room.TryGetClass(out var className, out _) ? CleanRoomHeadline.Class(className) : CleanRoomHeadline.ClassOut;

                // 室内機械は部屋クラスだけを読む（ADR 0105 §1）
                // An interior machine reads only the room class (ADR 0105 §1)
                if (target == CleanRoomDetailTarget.Machine) return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Present(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForMachine(headline), haltReason));

                // 清浄機の照会は自分の状態を必ず持つ。無ければ欄を出さず開発者へ知らせる（D-6）
                // A purifier query always carries its own status; without it hide the entry and tell developers (D-6)
                if (!room.QueriedAirFilter.TryGetStatus(out var powerRatio, out var filterRemainingRatio))
                {
                    roomAnomaly = "[CleanRoomViewConversion] air-filter room query carries no queried air-filter status";
                    return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent;
                }
                var status = room.NextClass.TryGetUnitsToNextClass(out var nextClassName, out var units)
                    ? CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.WithUnitsToNextClass(room.AirFilterCount, room.StoppedAirFilterCount, powerRatio, filterRemainingRatio, nextClassName, units)
                    : CleanRoomAirFilterRoomStatus.WithoutUnitsToNextClass(room.AirFilterCount, room.StoppedAirFilterCount, powerRatio, filterRemainingRatio);
                return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Present(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Enclosed(CleanRoomSummary.ForAirFilter(headline, status), haltReason));
            }

            SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail> Leak(CleanRoomLeakView leak, out string leakAnomaly)
            {
                leakAnomaly = null;
                switch (leak)
                {
                    case CleanRoomOpeningsLeakView openings:
                        return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Present(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Openings(openings.TotalOpeningCount, haltReason));
                    case CleanRoomNoEnclosureLeakView _:
                        return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Present(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.NoEnclosure(haltReason));
                    case CleanRoomTooLargeLeakView tooLarge:
                        return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Present(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.TooLarge(tooLarge.MaxRoomVolume, haltReason));
                    case CleanRoomDetectionPendingLeakView _:
                        return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Present(CleanRoomFetchedDetail.Detecting(haltReason));
                }
                leakAnomaly = $"[CleanRoomViewConversion] unsupported leak kind: {leak.GetType().Name}";
                return SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        // 列挙に無い稼働可否は偽（呼び手が欄を出さない）。新しい値の追加漏れは異常の文面で開発者へ知らせる（D-6）
        // An operability outside the enum returns false (the caller hides the entry); a missed new value comes back as the anomaly text (D-6)
        public static bool TryGetHaltReason(CleanRoomOperability operability, out CleanRoomHaltReason haltReason, out string anomaly)
        {
            anomaly = null;
            switch (operability)
            {
                case CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed:
                    haltReason = CleanRoomHaltReason.NotEnclosed;
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut:
                    haltReason = CleanRoomHaltReason.ClassOut;
                    return true;
                case CleanRoomOperability.Operable:
                    haltReason = CleanRoomHaltReason.None;
                    return true;
            }
            anomaly = $"[CleanRoomViewConversion] unsupported operability: {operability}";
            haltReason = CleanRoomHaltReason.None;
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui/Screens/BlockInventory/Context/CleanRoomSectionView.cs` を次の全文に替える（換気・清浄機ごと・清浄機なしの行を外し、台数とこの清浄機の行を足す。行は作り置きして使い回す今の形のまま）。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Layout;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Text;
using Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Parts;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 部屋欄: 見出し・（清浄機のときだけ）台数・この清浄機・停止理由の順。取得できない間は取得状態の1行だけ
    /// Room section: headline, then (purifiers only) count and own status, then halt reason; only the fetch-state line while unavailable
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class CleanRoomSectionView : VisualElement
    {
        private readonly BlockInfoUnavailableLine _unavailable = new("clean-room-fetch-state", LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomInfoLabel);
        private readonly ContextRowList _section = new("clean-room-section", UiGap.Px2);
        private readonly LackHighlightText _headline = new("clean-room-headline", LackHighlightTextSize.Sm);
        private readonly LocalizedLabel _airFilterCount = new() { name = "clean-room-air-filter-count" };
        private readonly LocalizedLabel _queriedAirFilter = new() { name = "clean-room-queried-air-filter" };
        private readonly LackHighlightText _haltReason = new("clean-room-halt-reason", LackHighlightTextSize.Sm);

        public CleanRoomSectionView()
        {
            name = "clean-room-section-view";
            _airFilterCount.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextSm);
            _airFilterCount.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextDefault);
            _queriedAirFilter.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextXs);
            _queriedAirFilter.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextDefault);
        }

        public void Render(SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail> entry)
        {
            if (entry.TryGetUnavailable(out var fetchState))
            {
                _unavailable.RenderInto(this, fetchState);
                return;
            }
            // 取得不可でも在るでもない（欄が無い）まま届くのは結線の誤りなので知らせて戻る
            // Neither unavailable nor present (absent) means a wiring mistake, so report it and return
            if (!entry.TryGetPresent(out var detail))
            {
                Debug.LogError("[CleanRoomSectionView] Render called with an absent entry; the caller must hide absent sections");
                return;
            }
            RenderFetched(detail);
            ContextRowList.MountOnly(this, _section.Stack);

            #region Internal

            void RenderFetched(CleanRoomFetchedDetail detail)
            {
                var display = CleanRoomLogic.Display(detail);
                var rows = new List<VisualElement>();

                // 赤は不足のときだけ。台数とこの清浄機は清浄機から見た部屋だけ
                // Red only when insufficient; count and own status only for the purifier's view
                _headline.Render(display.Headline, display.HeadlineInsufficient);
                rows.Add(_headline);
                if (display is AirFilterCleanRoomDisplay airFilter)
                {
                    _airFilterCount.SetText(airFilter.AirFilterCount);
                    rows.Add(_airFilterCount);
                    _queriedAirFilter.SetText(airFilter.QueriedAirFilter);
                    rows.Add(_queriedAirFilter);
                }

                // 止まっていなければ停止理由の行は無い
                // No halt-reason row while not halted
                if (display.TryGetHaltReason(out var haltReason))
                {
                    _haltReason.Render(haltReason, true);
                    rows.Add(_haltReason);
                }
                _section.SetRows(rows);
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

### Task D5: 「失敗率の改善方法」のモーダルを開く・出し直す・閉じる橋

プレイヤーが開いたときだけモーダルを出し、開いている間は機械の画面の取り直し（約1秒ごと）で中身が変われば出し直し、機械の画面が閉じた・改善の行が無くなったら閉じる（ADR 0105 §4「数字は今の条件の1組で、条件が変われば次の取り直しで更新される」）。前例は `BlueprintNameInputModalBridge`（状態を購読して `ModalRequestService` へ要求を出し、置き換えを `IsLatestRequest` で見分ける）。

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/Ui/State/BlockInventory/Context/CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridgeTest.cs` を作る（文言は英語の既定で解く前提。判断 D-20）。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Localization;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Client.Ui.State.Modal;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;

namespace Client.Tests.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 「失敗率の改善方法」のモーダルの開閉と、取り直しでの出し直し（ADR 0105 §4）
    /// Opening and closing the improvement modal and re-issuing it on refetch (ADR 0105 §4)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridgeTest
    {
        private const string Minus = "−";
        private FakeBlockContextModel _context;
        private ModalRequestService _modal;
        private CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge _bridge;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            Localize.Initialize();
            _context = new FakeBlockContextModel();
            _modal = new ModalRequestService();
            _bridge = new CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge(_context, _modal);
            _bridge.Initialize();
        }

        [Test]
        public void 開くと今の値を本文に_改善ごとの項目名と差分を行にして出す()
        {
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            _bridge.Open();

            var pending = _modal.Pending;
            Assert.AreEqual("How to lower the failure rate", pending.Title);
            Assert.AreEqual("Now: Lv1 42.3% / Lv2 7.2% / Failed 50.5%", pending.Message);
            Assert.AreEqual("Close", pending.ButtonText);
            Assert.IsFalse(pending.RequiresInput);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, pending.Rows.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual("Raise room class to B", pending.Rows[0].Label);
            Assert.AreEqual($"Lv1 +9.2% / Lv2 +3.8% / Failed {Minus}13.1%", pending.Rows[0].Values);
            Assert.AreEqual("Add quality module Lv2", pending.Rows[1].Label);
            Assert.AreEqual($"Lv1 {Minus}36.9% / Lv2 +37.0% / Lv3 +8.2% / Failed {Minus}8.2%", pending.Rows[1].Values);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 開くまでは取り直しがあってもモーダルを出さない()
        {
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.4));
            Assert.IsNull(_modal.Pending);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 開いている間は中身が変われば出し直し_同じなら出し直さない()
        {
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            _bridge.Open();
            var firstId = _modal.Pending.Id;

            // 同じ値の取り直し（別の実体）では要求を替えない
            // A refetch with equal values (a new instance) keeps the request
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            Assert.AreEqual(firstId, _modal.Pending.Id);

            // 失敗の割合が変わると新しい要求で出し直す
            // A changed failure share re-issues a new request
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.48));
            Assert.AreNotEqual(firstId, _modal.Pending.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual("Now: Lv1 42.3% / Lv2 7.2% / Failed 48.0%", _modal.Pending.Message);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 閉じるボタンで閉じた後は取り直しでも出さない()
        {
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            _bridge.Open();
            Assert.IsTrue(_modal.Respond(_modal.Pending.Id, ModalResult.Confirm, null));

            _context.Set(Dicing(0.4));
            Assert.IsNull(_modal.Pending);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 機械の画面が閉じる_または改善の行が無くなるとモーダルを閉じる()
        {
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            _bridge.Open();
            _context.Set(BlockContextViewModel.None);
            Assert.IsNull(_modal.Pending, "機械の画面を閉じると文脈が無しになる");

            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            _bridge.Open();
            _context.Set(WithOdds(CleanRoomYieldOdds.LayerExposure(0.01, new List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement>())));
            Assert.IsNull(_modal.Pending, "改善の行が無い");
        }

        [Test]
        public void 別のモーダルに置き換わったら閉じたままで_それを取り消さない()
        {
            _context.Set(Dicing(0.505));
            _bridge.Open();
            var ownId = _modal.Pending.Id;
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, $"[CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge] modal request {ownId} was replaced by another modal; the improvement modal stays closed");
            _modal.RequestModal("other", "other", "OK", ModalVariant.Confirm).Forget();
            var otherId = _modal.Pending.Id;

            _context.Set(Dicing(0.4));
            _context.Set(BlockContextViewModel.None);
            Assert.AreEqual(otherId, _modal.Pending.Id);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 改善の行が無いときに開いても出さず警告だけを残す()
        {
            _context.Set(WithOdds(CleanRoomYieldOdds.LayerExposure(0.01, new List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement>())));
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, "[CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge] open ignored: the tracked machine has no improvement rows now");
            _bridge.Open();
            Assert.IsNull(_modal.Pending);
        }

        // ADR 0105 §4 の形の例（ダイシング 300 個・Lv1 42.3%・Lv2 7.2%・失敗は引数）
        // An ADR 0105 §4 shaped example (dicing 300 dies, Lv1 42.3%, Lv2 7.2%, failure from the argument)
        private static BlockContextViewModel Dicing(double failedRate)
        {
            var improvements = new List<CleanRoomOddsImprovement>
            {
                CleanRoomOddsImprovement.RoomClassUp("B", new[] { 0.092, 0.038, 0.0 }, -0.131),
                CleanRoomOddsImprovement.AddQualityModule(2, new[] { -0.369, 0.370, 0.082 }, -0.082),
            };
            return WithOdds(CleanRoomYieldOdds.Dicing(300, new[] { 0.423, 0.072, 0.0 }, failedRate, improvements));
        }

        private static BlockContextViewModel WithOdds(CleanRoomYieldOdds odds)
        {
            return new BlockContextViewModel(SectionContent<CleanRoomFetchedDetail>.Absent, SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds>.Present(odds), SectionContent<MachineInputStall>.Absent);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Logic/CleanRoom/CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent.cs` を作る。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using Client.Ui.State.Modal;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 「失敗率の改善方法」のモーダルの本文と行（要求時の言語で解いた文）。取り直しで中身が変わったかを比べる
    /// The improvement modal's message and rows, resolved in the request-time language; compared to detect changes on refetch
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent
    {
        public string Message { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<ModalTableRow> Rows { get; }

        private CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent(string message, IReadOnlyList<ModalTableRow> rows)
        {
            Message = message;
            Rows = rows;
        }

        // 確率が在り改善の行が1つ以上あるときだけ組める（ボタンの出る条件と同じ）
        // Buildable only when odds are present with at least one improvement row (same as the button's condition)
        public static bool TryBuild(SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds> entry, out CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent content)
        {
            content = null;
            if (!entry.TryGetPresent(out var odds) || !odds.HasImprovements) return false;

            // 「今: Lv1 42.3% / … / 失敗 50.5%」を本文に、改善ごとに項目名と差分を1行に
            // "Now: Lv1 42.3% / … / Failed 50.5%" as the message; one label and deltas per improvement
            var message = UiText.Join(": ", new[] { new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldImprovementNow), UiText.Join(" / ", CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.CurrentValues(odds)) }).Resolve();
            var rows = new List<ModalTableRow>();
            foreach (var row in CleanRoomYieldImprovementLogic.Rows(odds)) rows.Add(new ModalTableRow(row.Label.Resolve(), UiText.Join(" / ", row.Values).Resolve()));
            content = new CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent(message, rows);
            return true;
        }

        // 解いた文で比べるので、値の変化も言語の切り替えも「違う」になる
        // Compares resolved text, so both value changes and language switches count as different
        public bool SameAs(CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent other)
        {
            if (Message != other.Message || Rows.Count != other.Rows.Count) return false;
            for (var i = 0; i < Rows.Count; i++)
            {
                if (Rows[i].Label != other.Rows[i].Label || Rows[i].Values != other.Rows[i].Values) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui.State/BlockInventory/Context/CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge.cs` を作る。

```csharp
using Client.Localization;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Client.Ui.State.Modal;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;
using VContainer.Unity;

namespace Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 「失敗率の改善方法」のモーダルを開き、開いている間は取り直しで中身が変われば出し直し、文脈が消えれば閉じる
    /// Opens the improvement modal, re-issues it while open when a refetch changes its contents, and closes it when the context goes away
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge : ICleanRoomYieldImprovementCommands, IInitializable
    {
        private readonly IBlockContextModel _context;
        private readonly ModalRequestService _modalService;

        // プレイヤーが開いてから閉じるまで真。開くまで勝手に出さない
        // True from the player's open until close; never shown before the player opens it
        private bool _isOpen;
        private string _ownRequestId;
        private CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent _shown;

        public CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge(IBlockContextModel context, ModalRequestService modalService)
        {
            _context = context;
            _modalService = modalService;
        }

        public void Initialize()
        {
            _context.Current.Subscribe(_ => Sync());
        }

        public void Open()
        {
            // ボタンは改善の行があるときだけ出るので、ここに来るのは取り直しと押下が入れ違ったとき
            // The button shows only with improvement rows, so this happens only when a refetch races the press
            if (!CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent.TryBuild(_context.Current.Value.CleanRoomYield, out var content))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("[CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge] open ignored: the tracked machine has no improvement rows now");
                return;
            }
            _isOpen = true;
            Issue(content);
        }

        private void Sync()
        {
            // silent-ok: 開いていない間の取り直しは何もしない / プレイヤーがボタンで開けば今の中身で出る
            if (!_isOpen) return;

            // 機械の画面が閉じた（文脈が無し）・取得できない・改善の行が無くなったら閉じる
            // Close when the machine screen closed (no context), the odds are unavailable or no improvement rows remain
            if (!CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent.TryBuild(_context.Current.Value.CleanRoomYield, out var content))
            {
                Close();
                return;
            }

            // silent-ok: 中身が同じ取り直しでは出し直さない / 中身が変われば次の取り直しで出し直す
            if (content.SameAs(_shown)) return;
            Issue(content);
        }

        private void Issue(CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalContent content)
        {
            // 出し直しで旧要求が同期に取り消されても自分の閉じとみなさないよう、先に自分の ID を外す
            // Drop our id first so the old request's synchronous cancel on re-issue is not taken as our close
            _ownRequestId = null;
            _shown = content;
            var (requestId, response) = _modalService.RequestTableModal(
                Localize.Get(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldImprovementOpen),
                content.Message,
                content.Rows,
                Localize.Get(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Common.Close));
            _ownRequestId = requestId;
            WaitClosed(requestId, response).Forget();
        }

        private async UniTaskVoid WaitClosed(string requestId, UniTask<ModalResult> response)
        {
            await response;

            // silent-ok: 出し直しで外した旧要求の解決は閉じではない / 新しい要求が画面に出ている
            if (requestId != _ownRequestId) return;
            _isOpen = false;
            _ownRequestId = null;
            _shown = null;

            // ほかのモーダルに置き換えられた。そのモーダルを取り消さないよう、閉じたままにする
            // Replaced by another modal; stay closed so that modal is not cancelled
            if (!_modalService.IsLatestRequest(requestId)) Debug.LogWarning($"[CleanRoomYieldImprovementModalBridge] modal request {requestId} was replaced by another modal; the improvement modal stays closed");
        }

        private void Close()
        {
            var requestId = _ownRequestId;
            _isOpen = false;
            _ownRequestId = null;
            _shown = null;

            // 自分の要求が最新のときだけ取り消す（ほかのモーダルを巻き込まない）
            // Cancel only while our request is the latest (never another modal)
            if (requestId != null && _modalService.IsLatestRequest(requestId)) _modalService.CancelPendingRequest();
        }
    }
}
```

### Task D6: 確率の欄に「失敗率の改善方法」のボタンを置く

改善の行が1つ以上あるときだけ、確率の欄の最後の行に `PanelActionButton` を置き、押すと D5 の口 `ICleanRoomYieldImprovementCommands.Open()` を直接呼ぶ（ADR 0105 §4。押下を View から直接コマンドへ渡すのは `SpaceElevatorSectionView` と `MachineSectionView` の前例）。ボタンが OS カーソルと開く口を要るので、欄 → 文脈の3欄 → 文脈の工場／機械の区画 → 機械の工場の順に引数を足す。

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Ui/Screens/BlockInventory/Context/CleanRoomYieldSectionView.cs` を次の全文に替える。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Ui.Components.Controls;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Input.OsCursor;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Layout;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Text;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Common;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Context;
using Client.Ui.State.BlockInventory.Logic.CleanRoom;
using Client.Ui.State.Text;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using UniRx;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace Client.Ui.Screens.BlockInventory.Context
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 確率の欄: 最終の確率の行（露光は失敗、ダイシングは出力・Lv・失敗）と、改善の行があるときの「失敗率の改善方法」ボタン
    /// Odds section: final-odds rows (failure for exposure; output, levels and failure for dicing) plus the improvement button when rows exist
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class CleanRoomYieldSectionView : VisualElement
    {
        private readonly BlockInfoUnavailableLine _unavailable = new("clean-room-yield-fetch-state", LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldInfoLabel);
        private readonly ContextRowList _section = new("clean-room-yield-section", UiGap.Px2);
        private readonly List<LocalizedLabel> _labels = new();
        private readonly PanelActionButton _improvementOpen;

        public CleanRoomYieldSectionView(IUiOsCursor osCursor, ICleanRoomYieldImprovementCommands improvementCommands)
        {
            name = "clean-room-yield-section-view";

            // 押下は View が直接開く口へ渡す（Presenter は中継しない。SpaceElevatorSectionView と同じ）
            // The press goes straight from the view to the open entry (no presenter relay; same as SpaceElevatorSectionView)
            _improvementOpen = new PanelActionButton("clean-room-yield-improvement-open", new UiText(LocalizationKeys.Ui.BlockInventory.CleanRoomYieldImprovementOpen), osCursor);
            _improvementOpen.OnClicked.Subscribe(_ => improvementCommands.Open());
        }

        public void Render(SectionContent<CleanRoomYieldOdds> entry)
        {
            if (entry.TryGetUnavailable(out var fetchState))
            {
                _unavailable.RenderInto(this, fetchState);
                return;
            }
            // 取得不可でも在るでもない（欄が無い）まま届くのは結線の誤りなので知らせて戻る
            // Neither unavailable nor present (absent) means a wiring mistake, so report it and return
            if (!entry.TryGetPresent(out var odds))
            {
                Debug.LogError("[CleanRoomYieldSectionView] Render called with an absent entry; the caller must hide absent sections");
                return;
            }
            var lines = CleanRoomYieldLogic.Lines(odds);
            var rows = new List<VisualElement>();
            for (var i = 0; i < lines.Count; i++)
            {
                // 行数だけラベルを使い回し毎回差す
                // Reuse labels per line and set text each time
                if (i == _labels.Count) _labels.Add(NewLabel());
                _labels[i].name = lines[i].RowId;
                _labels[i].SetText(lines[i].Text);
                rows.Add(_labels[i]);
            }

            // 改善の行が1つ以上あるときだけ最後の行にボタンを置く（ADR 0105 §4）
            // Put the button as the last row only when at least one improvement row exists (ADR 0105 §4)
            if (odds.HasImprovements) rows.Add(_improvementOpen);
            _section.SetRows(rows);
            ContextRowList.MountOnly(this, _section.Stack);

            #region Internal

            LocalizedLabel NewLabel()
            {
                var label = new LocalizedLabel();
                label.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextXs);
                label.AddToClassList(UiTypographyClass.TextDefault);
                return label;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Ui.Content;
```

```csharp
    /// <summary>
    /// 文脈の区画の工場
    /// Factory of the context section (SectionStackSlot.Context); builds it for any blockType, which decides whether to show
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ContextSectionFactory : ISectionStackSectionFactory
    {
        private readonly GameContentPresentation _content;
        private readonly IBlockContextModel _context;
        private readonly IMachineSectionModel _machine;
        private readonly IUiOsCursor _osCursor;
        private readonly ICleanRoomYieldImprovementCommands _improvementCommands;

        public SectionStackSlot Slot => SectionStackSlot.Context;

        public ContextSectionFactory(GameContentPresentation content, IBlockContextModel context, IMachineSectionModel machine, IUiOsCursor osCursor, ICleanRoomYieldImprovementCommands improvementCommands)
        {
            _content = content;
            _context = context;
            _machine = machine;
            _osCursor = osCursor;
            _improvementCommands = improvementCommands;
        }

        public IBlockInventorySection Create(SectionStackSectionMount mount)
        {
            return new ContextSectionPresenter(new BlockContextSectionsView(_content, _osCursor, _improvementCommands), _context, _machine);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Ui.Content;
using Client.Ui.Foundation.Input.OsCursor;

    /// <summary>
    /// 機械の区画の工場
    /// Factory of the machine section (SectionStackSlot.Machine); commands go to the view, never the presenter
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class MachineSectionFactory : ISectionStackSectionFactory
    {
        private readonly IMachineSectionModel _machine;
        private readonly IBlockContextModel _context;
        private readonly IBlockSlotCommands _commands;
        private readonly GameContentPresentation _content;
        private readonly IMachineRecipeSelectCommand _recipeSelect;
        private readonly IUiOsCursor _osCursor;
        private readonly ICleanRoomYieldImprovementCommands _improvementCommands;

        public SectionStackSlot Slot => SectionStackSlot.Machine;

        public MachineSectionFactory(IMachineSectionModel machine, IBlockContextModel context, IBlockSlotCommands commands, GameContentPresentation content, IMachineRecipeSelectCommand recipeSelect, IUiOsCursor osCursor, ICleanRoomYieldImprovementCommands improvementCommands)
        {
            _machine = machine;
            _context = context;
            _commands = commands;
            _content = content;
            _recipeSelect = recipeSelect;
            _osCursor = osCursor;
            _improvementCommands = improvementCommands;
        }

        public IBlockInventorySection Create(SectionStackSectionMount mount)
        {
            return new MachineSectionPresenter(new MachineSectionView(mount.FillsPanelHeight, _content, _commands, _osCursor, _recipeSelect, _improvementCommands), _machine, _context);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 改善方法のモーダルを開いて記録する DSL を作る**

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Playtest/Operations/Ui/CleanRoom/PlaytestCleanRoomUiOps.cs` を作る（`.meta` は Unity が作る）。

```csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Client.Playtest.Operations.Ui
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 開いている室内機械の画面で「失敗率の改善方法」のモーダルを開き、中身を記録して撮り、閉じる
    /// On an open interior-machine screen, open the improvement modal, record and shoot its contents, then close it
    /// </summary>
    public static class PlaytestCleanRoomUiOps
    {
        private const float WaitSeconds = 10f;

        public static async UniTask CheckCleanRoomYieldImprovementModal(this PlaytestDriver p, string screenshotName)
        {
            // ボタンを押し、表の1行目が出るまで待つ
            // Press the button and wait for the first table row
            await p.UntilUiElement("clean-room-yield-improvement-open", WaitSeconds);
            await p.ClickUi("clean-room-yield-improvement-open");
            await p.UntilUiElement("modal-table-row-0", WaitSeconds);

            // 本文（今の値）と表を記録し、割合が出ていることを見る
            // Record the message (current values) and the table, and check shares are shown
            var message = (await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("modal-message")).Text;
            var table = (await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("modal-table")).Text;
            p.Note($"失敗率の改善方法: {message} || {table.Replace("\n", " | ")}");
            p.Assert(message.Contains("%") && table.Contains("%"), $"改善方法のモーダルに今の値と差分の割合が出る(本文={message})");
            await p.Screenshot(screenshotName);

            // 閉じるボタンで閉じ、モーダルが消えるまで待つ
            // Close with the close button and wait until the modal is gone
            await p.ClickUi("modal-button");
            var deadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartup + WaitSeconds;
            while ((await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("modal")).IsFound)
            {
                if (deadline < Time.realtimeSinceStartup)
                {
                    p.Assert(false, "改善方法のモーダルが閉じるボタンで閉じる");
                    return;
                }
                await UniTask.DelayFrame(2);
            }
            p.Assert(true, "改善方法のモーダルが閉じるボタンで閉じる");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// 足す清浄機の置き場（北の壁際で最初の1台の両隣から外へ。発電機1000・清浄機150なので6台まで満電）
// Where extra purifiers go (along the north wall outward from the first; generator 1000 and purifier 150 keep six at full power)
var extraPositions = new[] { new Vector3Int(3, 33, 7), new Vector3Int(5, 33, 7), new Vector3Int(2, 33, 7), new Vector3Int(6, 33, 7), new Vector3Int(1, 33, 7) };
var outsidePosition = new Vector3(4.5f, 33.5f, -4f);
var gasolineGuid = new Guid("019eded2-7454-76da-8943-84c4e7a59179");
var freeCost = new ConnectionLineRecord(Guid.Parse("872372d5-2998-4fb7-826c-593ceeafcfb2"), Array.Empty<ConnectToolMaterialCost>());

return PlaytestRunner.Run("cleanroom-purifier-units-to-next-class", new PlaytestRunOptions { Record = true }, async p =>
{
    await p.SkipOpeningSkitIfPlaying();

    await p.SetupFlatGround();
    UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<MapObjectGameObjectDatastore>().SetActive(false);
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    #region 密閉部屋と清浄機1台 / Sealed room with one purifier
    // 床y=32・天井y=36の全面と側壁y=33〜35の周回で内部7x7x3の部屋を作る（ドア無し・プレイヤーはワープで出入りする）
    // Full floor (y=32), ceiling (y=36) and perimeter walls (y=33-35) make a 7x7x3 interior; no door, the player warps in
    for (var x = 0; x <= 8; x++)
    for (var z = 0; z <= 8; z++)
    {
        await p.PlaceBlockDirect(WallName, new Vector3Int(x, 32, z), BlockDirection.North);
        await p.PlaceBlockDirect(WallName, new Vector3Int(x, 36, z), BlockDirection.North);
        if (x != 0 && x != 8 && z != 0 && z != 8) continue;
        for (var y = 33; y <= 35; y++) await p.PlaceBlockDirect(WallName, new Vector3Int(x, y, z), BlockDirection.North);
    }
    var generatorBlock = await p.PlaceBlockDirect("ガソリンエンジン発電機", new Vector3Int(-15, 32, -15), BlockDirection.North);
    var firstPurifier = await PlacePurifier(purifierPos);
    await p.WaitForCleanRoom(firstPurifier, true, 20f, "清浄機1台の密閉部屋にクラスが付いた");
    var startThreshold = await ReadThreshold();
    p.Assert(0 < startThreshold, $"最上位のクラスでなく上げる余地がある(閾値行={startThreshold})");
    #endregion
    #region (1) 清浄機の画面が次のクラスとあと何台かを出す / The purifier screen names the next class and how many more
    await OpenPurifierUi();
    await p.UntilUiElement("clean-room-air-filter-count", 10f);
    await p.UntilUiElement("clean-room-queried-air-filter", 10f);
    var headline = (await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("clean-room-headline")).Text;
    var section = (await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("clean-room-section")).Text;
    p.Note($"部屋欄(清浄機1台): {section.Replace("\n", " | ")}");

    // 日本語「クラスC（クラスBまであと2台）」・英語「Class C (2 more to class B)」の両方から読む
    // Read both the Japanese and English forms of the headline
    var units = Regex.Match(headline, @"(\d+)(?:台| more)");
    var next = Regex.Match(headline, @"クラス([^（）\s]+?)まで|to class ([^)\s]+)\)");
    var unitCount = units.Success ? int.Parse(units.Groups[1].Value) : 0;
    var nextClassName = next.Groups[1].Success ? next.Groups[1].Value : next.Groups[2].Value;
    p.Note($"見出しから読んだ値: あと{unitCount}台でクラス{nextClassName}");
    p.Assert(units.Success && next.Success, $"見出しに次のクラスとあと何台かが出る(見出し={headline})");
    p.Assert(0 < unitCount && unitCount <= extraPositions.Length, $"あと{unitCount}台が置き場の数({extraPositions.Length})以内");
    p.Assert((await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("clean-room-air-filter-count")).Text.Contains("1"), "台数の行が1台");
    p.Assert((await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("clean-room-queried-air-filter")).Text.Contains("%"), "この清浄機の電力と残量の行が出る");
    p.Assert(!ContainsConcentration(section) && !section.Contains("換気") && !section.Contains("Air change"), $"部屋欄に濃度と換気回数が無い(本文={section.Replace("\n", " | ")})");
    await p.Screenshot("01-purifier-units-to-next-class");
    await CloseUi();
    #endregion
    #region (2) 見出しの台数だけ足すと次のクラスへ上がる / Adding that many purifiers raises the room to the next class
    // 前の主張が落ちて台数が決まらないときは足さずに終える（失敗の主張は result.json に残っている）
    // When the earlier assertion failed and no count is known, stop here (the failed assertion is already in result.json)
    if (!units.Success || !next.Success || unitCount <= 0 || extraPositions.Length < unitCount) return;
    for (var i = 0; i < unitCount; i++) await PlacePurifier(extraPositions[i]);
    await p.WaitForCleanRoomClass(firstPurifier, startThreshold - 1, 30f, $"清浄機を{unitCount}台足して閾値行{startThreshold - 1}(クラス{nextClassName})になった");
    await OpenPurifierUi();
    await p.UntilUiElement("clean-room-air-filter-count", 10f);
    var raised = (await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("clean-room-headline")).Text;
    var raisedCount = (await PlaytestUiElementOps.FindUi("clean-room-air-filter-count")).Text;
    p.Note($"清浄機{1 + unitCount}台: 見出し={raised} 台数={raisedCount}");
    p.Assert(raised.StartsWith($"クラス{nextClassName}") || raised.StartsWith($"Class {nextClassName}"), $"見出しがクラス{nextClassName}になった(見出し={raised})");
    p.Assert(raisedCount.Contains((1 + unitCount).ToString()), $"台数の行が{1 + unitCount}台(行={raisedCount})");
    await p.Screenshot("02-purifier-next-class");
    await CloseUi();
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    #endregion

    #region Internal

    async UniTask<IBlock> PlacePurifier(Vector3Int position)
    {
        // フィルター8個を入れ、発電機を満タンにして室外の発電機から配線する
        // Load eight filters, top up the generator and wire it from the outdoor generator
        var block = await p.PlaceBlockDirect(PurifierName, position, BlockDirection.North);
        Core.Inventory.IOpenableInventory filterInventory = block.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
        var filterItemId = PlaytestItemOps.ResolveItemId("クリーンルームフィルター");
        var wired = false;
        await p.RunOnServer($"{position} の清浄機にフィルターを入れて配線する", () =>
        {
            filterInventory.SetItem(0, filterItemId, 8);
            generatorBlock.GetComponent<VanillaElectricGeneratorComponent>().AddLiquid(new FluidStack(200, MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(gasolineGuid)), default);
            wired = ElectricWireSystemUtil.TryConnectBothSides(generatorBlock.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>(), block.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>(), freeCost);
        });
        p.Assert(wired, $"電線 発電機→{position} の清浄機");
        return block;
    }

    async UniTask<int> ReadThreshold()
    {
        var threshold = -1;
        await p.RunOnServer("部屋の閾値行を読む", () =>
        {
            if (ServerContext.GetService<CleanRoomDatastore>().TryGetCleanRoom(firstPurifier, out var room)) threshold = room.ThresholdIndex;
        });
        return threshold;
    }

    async UniTask OpenPurifierUi()
    {
        // Fの射程は2mなので最初の清浄機の南面の1m手前に立ち、Altのカーソル照準で南面を狙ってFで開く
        // F reaches 2 m, so stand 1 m south of the first purifier and open it with F by aiming at that face via the Alt cursor
        p.WarpPlayer(new Vector3(4.5f, 33.5f, 6f));
        await p.Until(() => 32.6f < p.PlayerPosition.y && p.PlayerPosition.y < 33.1f, 5f, "室内の床に着地した");
        SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.LeftAlt);
        await p.AimAt(new Vector3(4.5f, 33.8f, 7f));
        await p.WaitSeconds(0.5f);
        await p.PressInteract();
        await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.SubInventory, 10f);
        SemanticInput.KeyUp(Key.LeftAlt);
        await p.UntilUiElement("clean-room-section", 10f);
    }

    async UniTask CloseUi() { await p.PressKey(Key.Tab); await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 10f); }
    bool ContainsConcentration(string text) => text.Contains("濃度") || text.Contains("不純物") || text.Contains("oncentration") || text.Contains("ppm");

    #endregion
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: テストを直す（今の振る舞いを新しい形で書く）**

`CleanRoomPendingDrawYieldInfoTest.cs` を全体で書き直す（加工時間とセーブ往復の確認は残し、確定済み抽選の組の確認を「今の条件の1組」の確認に替える。別役割の確定済み抽選のテストは wire から項目が消えるので消す）:

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using Game.Context;
using MessagePack;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Server.PacketTest.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     出力満杯で確定済み抽選が待っている間も確率は今の条件の1組だけで、加工時間は確定時の効果で決まることを固定する（裁定 2026-11-21）
    ///     Pins that while a fixed draw waits on full outputs the odds are a single set under current conditions, and that processing time is fixed by the draw-time effect (ruling 2026-11-21)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomPendingDrawYieldInfoTest
    {
        // テストの品質モジュールは tier1・効果1.0・時間のトレードオフ0.5（時間倍率1.5）
        // The test quality module is tier 1, effect 1.0, time tradeoff 0.5 (time multiplier 1.5)
        private const int TickCap = 4000;
        private const double Tolerance = 1e-5;
        private const int FailedDieSlot = FirstOutputSlot + 3;
        private const int FailedDieMaxStack = 1000000;
        private static readonly Guid TestQualityModuleItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000005");

        [TestCase(false)]
        [TestCase(true)]
        public void OddsFollowCurrentConditionsWhileADrawWaitsAndProcessingTimeStaysTest(bool saveReload)
        {
            var (packet, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = PlaceProcessMachine();
            IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent inventory = machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
            inventory.SetItem(FirstModuleSlot, MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(TestQualityModuleItemGuid), 1);
            Assert.IsTrue(WaitForClassA(serviceProvider.GetService<CleanRoomDatastore>(), filter, machine, TickCap));

            // 失敗ダイのスロットを満杯にしてウェハを入れ、待機中に抽選を確定させる。確率はクラスA×tier1 の1組
            // Fill the failed-die slot and load a wafer so idle fixes a draw; the odds are the single class-A tier-1 set
            inventory.SetItem(FailedDieSlot, ForUnitTestItemId.TestFailedDie, FailedDieMaxStack);
            SelectRecipeAndLoad(machine, ForUnitTestMachineRecipeId.CleanRoomDicingRecipe, ForUnitTestItemId.TestLayeredWafer, 1);
            AssertOdds(ReadDicing(packet, machine).Odds, new[] { 0.491749, 0.061316, 0d }, 0.446935);
            RunTicks(filter, machine, 3);
            var processor = machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent>();
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);

            // モジュールを外すと、確定済み抽選が待っていても確率は今の条件（クラスA・モジュール無し）の1組だけになる
            // Removing the module turns the odds into the single current set (class A, no module) even with a fixed draw waiting
            inventory.SetItem(FirstModuleSlot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
            RunTicks(filter, machine, 1);
            AssertOdds(ReadDicing(packet, machine).Odds, new[] { 0.17, 0d, 0d }, 0.83);

            if (saveReload)
            {
                // 部屋と機械を含むワールド全体を保存し、別DIで復元する（確定済み抽選はセーブに残る）
                // Save the whole world including the room and machine, then restore through another DI container (the fixed draw stays in the save)
                var filterPos = filter.BlockPositionInfo.OriginalPos;
                var machinePos = machine.BlockPositionInfo.OriginalPos;
                var before = Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(processor.GetSaveState());
                var text = SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.AssembleSaveJson(serviceProvider);
                (packet, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
                SaveLoadJsonTestHelper.LoadFromJson(serviceProvider, text);
                filter = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(filterPos);
                machine = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(machinePos);
                inventory = machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
                processor = machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent>();
                Assert.AreEqual(before, Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(processor.GetSaveState()));
                Assert.IsTrue(WaitForClassA(serviceProvider.GetService<CleanRoomDatastore>(), filter, machine, TickCap));

                // 復元直後は部屋効果の初回push前で1tickだけHaltedを経由するので、出力待ちのIdleへ戻るまで進める
                // Before the first room-effect push a restored machine passes one Halted tick, so advance until it is back to output-blocked Idle
                RunTicks(filter, machine, 2);
                Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);
                AssertOdds(ReadDicing(packet, machine).Odds, new[] { 0.17, 0d, 0d }, 0.83);
            }

            // 出力を空けると確定済みの抽選で加工が始まる。確率は今の条件のまま
            // Freeing the output starts work on the fixed draw; the odds stay at the current conditions
            inventory.SetItem(FailedDieSlot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
            RunTicks(filter, machine, 1);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);
            AssertOdds(ReadDicing(packet, machine).Odds, new[] { 0.17, 0d, 0d }, 0.83);

            // 要求電力ちょうどの1tickで進捗が 1/総tick になる。総tickは外す前の品質モジュールの時間倍率1.5で決まっている
            // One tick at exactly the requested power advances progress by 1/total; the total was fixed by the removed quality module's x1.5
            EnsureFilterWiredPower(filter);
            processor.SupplyExternalPower(processor.EffectiveRequestPower);
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            var totalTicks = Math.Round(1d / GetCommonMachineState(machine).ProcessingRate);
            Assert.AreEqual(Math.Round(GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(1) * 1.5d), totalTicks);
        }

        private static void RunTicks(IBlock filter, IBlock machine, int ticks)
        {
            for (var tick = 0; tick < ticks; tick++)
            {
                TopUpIpa(machine, 20);
                TickRoom(filter, machine);
            }
        }

        private static CleanRoomYieldDicingView ReadDicing(PacketResponseCreator packet, IBlock machine)
        {
            var request = new GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.RequestCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(machine.BlockInstanceId);
            var responseBytes = packet.GetPacketResponse(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(request), Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity.BoundPacketContext.Bind(1));
            var response = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack>(responseBytes[0]);
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Success, response.TryReadView(out var view), $"kind={response.Kind}");
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<CleanRoomYieldDicingView>(view);
            return (CleanRoomYieldDicingView)view;
        }

        private static void AssertOdds(DicingOddsMessagePack odds, double[] levelRates, double failedRate)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(300, odds.OutputCount);
            Assert.That(odds.LevelRates, Is.EqualTo(levelRates).Within(Tolerance));
            Assert.AreEqual(failedRate, odds.FailedRate, Tolerance);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        [Test]
        public void MalformedResponsesAreUnreadableWithWarningTest()
        {
            var noImprovements = new List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack>();

            // 判別子に対応する最終の内訳が欠けた応答（壊れた・版違いのwire）は、警告を出して読めない扱いにする
            // A response missing the final odds its discriminator names (broken or mismatched wire) warns and is unreadable
            var layerExposure = GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateLayerExposure(new LayerExposureOddsMessagePack(0.1), noImprovements);
            layerExposure.LayerExposureOdds = null;
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo\] LayerExposure response has no"));
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, layerExposure.TryReadView(out _));

            // wire を通しても同じ（入れ子が null のまま届く）
            // The same holds through the wire (the nested object arrives as null)
            var dicing = GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateDicing(new DicingOddsMessagePack(300, new[] { 0.63, 0.09, 0d }, 0.28), noImprovements);
            dicing.DicingOdds = null;
            var received = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack>(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(dicing));
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo\] Dicing response has no"));
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, received.TryReadView(out _));

            // ダイシングのLv別の最終割合が欠けた応答も読めない
            // A dicing response missing its final per-level rates is unreadable too
            var noLevelRates = GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack.CreateDicing(new DicingOddsMessagePack(300, null, 0.28), noImprovements);
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(@"\[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo\] Dicing response has no"));
            Assert.AreEqual(BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable, noLevelRates.TryReadView(out _));
        }
```

```csharp
    ///     Draw-detail query result; always exactly one of the per-kind types (no role, room not operable, with odds), and only the with-odds type carries numbers, always
    /// </summary>
    public abstract class CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport
    {
        // 種別はこのファイルの3つの型に閉じる
        // The kinds are closed to the three types in this file

        }

    public sealed class CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport : CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport
    {

        private CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport()
        {
        }

    // 部屋が稼働を許さない（未密閉・クラス不足）。停止理由は部屋の欄が出す
    // The room does not allow operation (not enclosed or class out); the room section shows the halt reason
    public sealed class CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport : CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport
    {
        public static readonly CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport Instance = new();

        private CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport()
        {
        }
    }

    // 数字あり（EUV・ダイシング）。今の条件での最終の内訳と、改善の一覧（並べる順）を必ず持つ
    // With odds (EUV, dicing): always carries the final odds under current conditions and the improvement list in display order
    public sealed class CleanRoomOddsYieldReport : CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport
    {
        public CleanRoomFinalOdds Odds { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> Improvements { get; }

        public CleanRoomOddsYieldReport(CleanRoomFinalOdds odds, IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> improvements)
        {
            Odds = odds;
            Improvements = improvements;
        }
    }
```

`CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent.cs` 直した後（C3 の全体から、`IMachinePendingRealizationReader` のフィールド・ctor 引数・`using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State;`、`GetPreview` の `FindPendingDraw`〈`#region Internal` ごと〉と `next` の変数を外す。ほかは同じ。全文を示す）:

```csharp
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     室内機械の選択工程について、次の抽選の最終の内訳と改善の差分を答える部品。抽選と同じ入力（選択レシピ・今の部屋の効果・装着モジュール）を読む
    ///     Answers the next draw's final odds and the improvement deltas for an interior machine's selected process, reading the draw's own inputs (selected recipe, current room effect, equipped modules)
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent : IBlockComponent
    {
        private readonly IMachineRecipeSelectorComponent _recipeSelector;
        private readonly MachineModuleEffectComponent _moduleEffectComponent;
        private readonly ICleanRoomEffectLookup _effectLookup;

        internal CleanRoomYieldPreviewComponent(IMachineRecipeSelectorComponent recipeSelector, MachineModuleEffectComponent moduleEffectComponent, ICleanRoomEffectLookup effectLookup)
        {
            _recipeSelector = recipeSelector;
            _moduleEffectComponent = moduleEffectComponent;
            _effectLookup = effectLookup;
        }

        public CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport GetPreview()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);

            // 未選択と役割表に無いレシピは数字を持たない
            // Unselected recipes and recipes outside the role tables carry no numbers
            if (!_recipeSelector.TryGetSelectedRecipe(out var recipe)) return CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport.Instance;
            if (!MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.TryGetRecipeRole(recipe.MachineRecipeGuid, out var role)) return CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport.Instance;

            // 部屋の効果は抽選と同じ持ち主（デコレータ）の読み口から読む。止まっている効果はクラス値を持たないので数字も改善も作らない
            // Read the room effect through the draw owner's (decorator's) read view; a halted effect has no class values, so neither numbers nor improvements are built
            if (!_effectLookup.CurrentEffect.TryGetClassYield(out var classYield)) return CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport.Instance;

            // 装着の集計と今の最終の内訳はここで1回だけ出し、候補選びと改善の計算へ渡す。出力待ちの確定済み抽選があっても今の条件の1組だけを答える
            // Aggregate the loadout and derive the current final odds once here, handing them to candidate selection and the improvement calculation; even with a fixed draw waiting, answer only the single current set
            var equipped = _moduleEffectComponent.CollectEffectiveModules();
            var moduleEffect = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(equipped);
            var current = CleanRoomFinalOdds.Of(role, CleanRoomYieldPreview.Evaluate(role, classYield, moduleEffect, null, out _));
            var candidates = CleanRoomQualityModuleCandidates.Select(_moduleEffectComponent, moduleEffect.HighestQualityModuleTier);
            var improvements = CleanRoomYieldImprovementCalculator.Compute(role, classYield, equipped, current, candidates);
            return new CleanRoomOddsYieldReport(current, improvements);
        }

        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }

        public void Destroy()
        {
            IsDestroy = true;
        }
    }
}
```

`CleanRoomYieldResponseFactory.cs` 直した後（全体。C4 の形から古い項目の写し〈`RequireSameRole`・`ToDicingMessagePack`〉を外す）:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.YieldPreview;
using Response = Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.GetCleanRoomYieldInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーの抽選の中身の報告を応答へ写す（クライアントは Game.Block の型を持たない）
    ///     Maps the server's draw-detail report onto the response, so the client never holds Game.Block types
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomYieldResponseFactory
    {
        public static Response Create(CleanRoomYieldPreviewReport report)
        {
            // 報告の種別と最終の内訳の型ごとに factory へ写す。数字を持たない種別は判別子だけ（停止理由は部屋欄が出す）
            // Map each report kind and final-odds type onto its factory; kinds without numbers carry only the discriminator (the room section shows the halt reason)
            return report switch
            {
                CleanRoomNoRoleYieldReport _ => Response.CreateNoRole(),
                CleanRoomNotOperableYieldReport _ => Response.CreateNotOperable(),
                CleanRoomOddsYieldReport { Odds: LayerExposureFinalOdds layer } withOdds => Response.CreateLayerExposure(new LayerExposureOddsMessagePack(layer.FailedRate), ToImprovementMessagePacks(withOdds.Improvements)),
                CleanRoomOddsYieldReport { Odds: DicingFinalOdds dicing } withOdds => Response.CreateDicing(new DicingOddsMessagePack(dicing.OutputCount, dicing.LevelRates.ToArray(), dicing.FailedRate), ToImprovementMessagePacks(withOdds.Improvements)),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(report), report.GetType().Name, "未対応の抽選の中身の報告 / Unsupported draw-detail report"),
            };

            #region Internal

            // 改善は並びのまま載せる
            // Improvements keep their order
            static List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> ToImprovementMessagePacks(IReadOnlyList<CleanRoomYieldImprovement> improvements)
            {
                return improvements.Select(ToImprovementMessagePack).ToList();
            }

            static CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack ToImprovementMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldImprovement improvement)
            {
                var levelDeltas = improvement.LevelRateDeltas.ToArray();
                return improvement switch
                {
                    CleanRoomRoomClassUpImprovement classUp => CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateRoomClassUp(classUp.TargetClassName, levelDeltas, classUp.FailedRateDelta),
                    CleanRoomAddQualityModuleImprovement addModule => CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.CreateAddQualityModule(addModule.ModuleTier, levelDeltas, addModule.FailedRateDelta),
                    _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(improvement), improvement.GetType().Name, "未対応の改善の種別 / Unsupported improvement kind"),
                };
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        [MessagePackObject]
        public class ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            // wire は判別子と役割ごとの入れ子が並ぶ形。その役割の入れ子だけが書かれ、他は null。組み立ては下の factory、読み出しは TryReadView だけ
            // The wire has a discriminator plus per-role nested objects; only that role's object is written and the rest stay null. Build only via the factories below and read only via TryReadView
            [Key(2)] public CleanRoomYieldResponseKind Kind { get; set; }

            // 画面に出す最終の内訳と、失敗率の改善方法の行（並べる順）。Key 3〜6 は外した項目の欠番
            // Final odds for the screen and the improvement rows in display order; keys 3-6 are retired gaps
            [Key(7)] public LayerExposureOddsMessagePack LayerExposureOdds { get; set; }
            [Key(8)] public DicingOddsMessagePack DicingOdds { get; set; }
            [Key(9)] public List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> Improvements { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack() { }

            private ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind kind)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                Kind = kind;
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateBlockNotFound()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.BlockNotFound);
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateUnsupportedTarget()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.UnsupportedTarget);
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateNoRole()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NoRole);
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateNotOperable()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NotOperable);
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateLayerExposure(LayerExposureOddsMessagePack odds, List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> improvements)
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.LayerExposure) { LayerExposureOdds = odds, Improvements = improvements };
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack CreateDicing(DicingOddsMessagePack odds, List<CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack> improvements)
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomYieldInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.Dicing) { DicingOdds = odds, Improvements = improvements };
            }

            // 判別子の読み分けは読み口1か所（CleanRoomYieldResponseReader）で行う
            // The single reader (CleanRoomYieldResponseReader) branches on the discriminator
            public BlockInfoReadResult TryReadView(out CleanRoomYieldView view)
            {
                return CleanRoomYieldResponseReader.Read(this, out view);
            }
```

`CleanRoomYieldResponseReader.cs` の `Read` 直した後（クラスの summary は「判別子と違う役割の欄や」を「判別子に要る入れ子の欠けや壊れた改善の一覧は」へ書き換える）:

```csharp
        public static BlockInfoReadResult Read(Response response, out CleanRoomYieldView view)
        {
            view = default;
            var kind = response.Kind;
            switch (kind)
            {
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NoRole:
                    view = CleanRoomYieldNoRoleView.Instance;
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.NotOperable:
                    view = CleanRoomYieldNotOperableView.Instance;
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.LayerExposure:
                    if (response.LayerExposureOdds == null) return WarnMissingNested();
                    if (!CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.AreReadable(response.Improvements, 0)) return WarnBrokenImprovements();
                    view = new CleanRoomYieldLayerExposureView(response.LayerExposureOdds, response.Improvements);
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.Dicing:
                    if (response.DicingOdds == null || response.DicingOdds.LevelRates == null) return WarnMissingNested();
                    if (!CleanRoomYieldImprovementMessagePack.AreReadable(response.Improvements, response.DicingOdds.LevelRates.Length)) return WarnBrokenImprovements();
                    view = new CleanRoomYieldDicingView(response.DicingOdds, response.Improvements);
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Success;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.BlockNotFound:
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.BlockNotFound;
                case CleanRoomYieldResponseKind.UnsupportedTarget:
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.UnsupportedTarget;
                default:
                    Debug.LogWarning($"Unreadable response kind: {kind}");
                    return BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable;
            }

            #region Internal

            // 外部から届いた wire の食い違いなので例外にせず、警告を出して読めない応答として扱う（ポーラーは値を捨てて再試行する）
            // A mismatch in wire data from outside, so warn instead of throwing and treat it as unreadable (the poller drops the value and retries)
            BlockInfoReadResult WarnMissingNested()
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo] {kind} response has no {kind} details; treating it as unreadable");
                return BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable;
            }

            BlockInfoReadResult WarnBrokenImprovements()
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[GetCleanRoomYieldInfo] {kind} response has broken improvements; treating it as unreadable");
                return BlockInfoReadResult.Unreadable;
            }

            #endregion
        }
```
